title: Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models
title_zh: 统一多模态模型的连续空间潜在推理
abstract: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) achieve remarkable success on diverse multimodal understanding and generation tasks, yet they still struggle to effectively leverage language-based chain-of-thought reasoning for image generation. As a result, existing reasoning-augmented UMMs often fail to inherit the test-time scaling and fine-grained controllability observed in large language models. We attribute this failure to a fundamental modality mismatch: reasoning is performed in a discrete token space, whereas image generation operates in a continuous space. To bridge this gap, we introduce a Latent Reasoning framework in Continuous space (LARC), which alleviates the token-level bottleneck by reasoning over continuous hidden states. Specifically, the training framework consists of two stages: (i) curriculum supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and (ii) information-gain reinforcement learning (RL). First, the curriculum SFT stage gradually converts token-level reasoning into latent reasoning. Subsequently, the information-gain RL stage self-evolves latent reasoning without ground truth supervision. Experiments across diverse text-to-image generation benchmarks show that LARC consistently improves generation quality, prompt following, and compositional fidelity. Notably, LARC achieves state-of-the-art performance on GenEval with a 7%p gain over BAGEL and demonstrates clear test-time scaling behavior, outperforming token-based generation under both parallel and sequential test-time scaling strategies.
summary_zh: 现有统一多模态模型难以利用离散语言推理指导图像生成，存在模态不匹配问题。
提出连续空间潜在推理框架LARC，通过课程SFT将推理从离散令牌转为连续隐状态，并用信息增益RL自我进化。
LARC显著提升生成质量与组合保真度，在GenEval上达到SOTA，并展现出明显的测试时缩放行为。
comment: Published as conference proceeding for NeurIPS 2026. Last two authors advised equally

title: Flide: Accelerating Decision Inference with Exact State Forking
title_zh: Flide：基于精确状态分叉加速决策推理
abstract: Decision models such as Jev have emerged as a highly promising paradigm for LLM agent systems, providing lightweight and reliable categorical reasoning for rapid System One execution. However, existing generation-oriented inference engines fail to support these workloads effectively, suffering from severe prefix recomputation overheads or distorted output probabilities. To address this challenge, we propose Flide, an efficient and exact inference engine that decouples the logical tree structure of a decision request from its physical execution within a single flattened token stream. Through ForkAttention, Flide navigates request dependencies using GPU-resident indices across both standard attention and recurrent Gated DeltaNet layers, guaranteeing in exact arithmetic that every query branch evaluates identically to an isolated forward pass. By expressing branch topologies directly in GPU-resident metadata, Flide accommodates diverse request mixtures with a compact set of pre-recorded execution graphs while enabling expanding agent histories to resume from checkpoints saved in earlier passes. Extensive evaluations on public hybrid and decision models demonstrate that Flide answers queries up to 9.5 times faster than vLLM and SGLang while staying closest to a float32 reference in total variation distance. By unifying physical execution throughput with mathematical exactness, Flide establishes a principled foundation for scalable, latency-critical decision intelligence in agent systems.
summary_zh: 现有推理引擎无法有效支持LLM agent决策模型，存在前缀重复计算开销大和输出概率失真问题。
提出Flide推理引擎，通过ForkAttention在单一扁平化token流中解耦逻辑树与物理执行，保证分支计算与独立前向传播精确一致。
实验表明，Flide比vLLM和SGLang快9.5倍，且输出概率最接近参考值，为agent决策推理奠定基础。

title: Latent Sparse Attention: Towards Subquadratic Ultra-Long Context Attention
title_zh: 潜空间稀疏注意力：迈向次二次超长上下文注意力
abstract: Agentic workflows are increasingly shifting towards long-horizon tasks, such as open-ended scientific work, where models benefit from long context windows. However, at ultra-long context (above 1M tokens), full attention is prohibitively expensive. A promising approach is sparse attention, in which a dedicated indexer selects a subset of keys for the attention. Yet current methods of indexing either still have quadratic cost in context size or lose accuracy at ultra-long context scale. We address this with Latent Sparse Attention (LSA), an efficient attention method that maintains accuracy at ultra-long context. In LSA, keys are hierarchically clustered in a learned latent space, and queries score the hierarchy of clusters instead of scoring every key, making prefill, decode and training faster at long context. We propose two variants, Distilled-LSA (D-LSA), which can be applied to pre-trained models via distillation, and Native-LSA (N-LSA), which is trained natively on the next-token loss alone. On GLM-5.3-FLASH (QWEN-3.8-27B) at 10M tokens, D-LSA speeds up one attention layer by 22.7x (72.4x) in prefill and 4.6x (42.5x) in decode over its original sparse attention (full attention), while keeping similar accuracy across a variety of tasks. N-LSA matches the accuracy of full attention with a training speedup of 1.6x per layer at 128k tokens. LSA offers practical and efficient attention for models to benefit from ultra-long context.
summary_zh: 超长上下文下全注意力成本过高，现有稀疏索引仍存二次复杂度或精度损失，提出潜空间稀疏注意力（LSA）以兼顾效率与精度。
LSA将键在学习的潜空间中层次聚类，查询仅对聚类层级打分而非所有键，从而加速长上下文的预填充、解码与训练。
提出D-LSA与N-LSA两种变体。在10M词元下D-LSA大幅加速且保精度；N-LSA在128k词元下匹配全注意力精度并实现1.6x训练加速。

title: Dittany: Contribution-Guided Repair Framework for MAS Applications
title_zh: Dittany：面向MAS应用的贡献引导修复框架
abstract: LLM-based multi-agent system (MAS) applications can produce useful intermediate results while leaving task requirements unsatisfied. Repairing such executions requires identifying the work still needed and the completed results that can support it. We present \tool, a contribution-guided runtime repair framework for MAS applications. \tool derives expected contributions and acceptance conditions from task requirements and method specifications, and connects their dependencies in a contribution graph. Runtime checks locate unmet conditions and establish which results remain usable. These results guide action-level correction when available inputs suffice, or graph-level recovery when prerequisites or unfinished work need revision. Both repair scopes retain validated contributions and check repaired outputs before subsequent work uses them. We evaluate \tool on 30 applications across six MAS frameworks and 9,000 tasks. It detects runtime failures with 88.28\% precision and 79.18\% recall, and achieves 84.76\% task accuracy, improving over Native execution by 26.74 percentage points and the strongest of four recovery baselines by 21.28 points. Estimated deployment token consumption is 17.92\% above Native, but 24.19\% below Reflexion and 13.05\% below Iterative Rollback. Ablation results show that combining the two repair scopes achieves higher accuracy and lower token consumption than graph-level repair alone.
summary_zh: 基于LLM的MAS应用常产出有用中间结果却未满足任务需求，需识别待完成工作与可用结果以修复执行。
提出Dittany框架，构建贡献图连接预期贡献与验收条件，通过运行时检查定位未满足条件与可用结果。
结合动作级与图级两种修复范围，保留已验证贡献。实验表明其任务准确率达84.76%，且Token消耗低于基线方法。

title: RoboArchitect: Automating the Design of Robotic Agents with Persistent Memory
title_zh: RoboArchitect：基于持久记忆的机器人智能体架构自动设计
abstract: Recent work shows that a frozen robot policy performs far better inside an agent harness, where control code decides when to query the policy, consult vision tools, or command the arm directly. Yet today these harnesses are built by hand and redesigned for each new robot or benchmark. We show that harness design can be automated, offering a strong alternative to finetuning on a novel setup. In RoboArchitect, a coding model observes a robot's rollouts, diagnoses failures, and iteratively revises the harness around the frozen policy. The harness evolves on a set of episodes for its optimization and is evaluated on held-out scenes and tasks. Without updating any model weights, RoboArchitect raises average success from 9.7% to 43.3% on unseen scenes (4.5x) and from 12.7% to 40.2% on unseen tasks (3.2x), across multiple benchmarks and policies. The gains are largest where the benchmark is far from the policy's training data: wrapping a general-purpose policy, the evolved harness yields a specialist that often outperforms even the finetuned version. Intuitive control strategies are automatically designed, such as lifting a jammed arm clear or reaching in horizontally when an obstacle blocks the way from above. The harness also evolves its own persistent memory, carrying learned experience, such as effective grasp depths, into later decisions. These results suggest that substantial headroom in robotic manipulation lies in the agent harness, and its design can be effectively automated and optimized without weight updates.
summary_zh: 现有机器人智能体架构需针对新场景手工构建，难以泛化。本文提出RoboArchitect，通过编码模型观察试错并迭代修正架构，实现架构设计自动化。
该方法在冻结策略基础上，让编码模型诊断失败并修正架构，且架构能演化出持久记忆，将有效经验带入后续决策，无需更新模型权重。
实验表明，该方法在未见场景和任务上成功率最高提升4.5倍；对通用策略演化出的专用架构甚至超越微调版本，证实了优化架构的巨大潜力。

title: DecisionRank: On-Policy Distillation for Decision-Model Rerankers
title_zh: DecisionRank：面向决策模型重排器的在线策略蒸馏
abstract: Decision models target structured tasks by directly predicting choices or scores, avoiding autoregressive decoding latency. However, transferring a generative LLM's ranking knowledge to a decision model remains challenging: the teacher expresses preferences through a ranked list of document ID sequences, while the student determines the ranking using scores from the first-token position. To bridge this gap, we introduce DecisionRank, a decision model trained through item-space on-policy distillation (OPD). Item-space OPD constructs the student's rollout by sorting its document scores into a ranked sequence. A generative teacher takes the resulting ranking list as inputs and provides conditional feedback to directly supervise those scores. Combined with offline ranking supervision, DecisionRank achieves state-of-the-art performance on both general and reasoning-intensive retrieval benchmarks such as TREC DL, BEIR, and BRIGHT. Across four benchmarks, item-space OPD consistently outperforms alternative training objectives. Even at 1.7B parameters, DecisionRank surpasses its 27B generative teacher on TREC DL19--23. At 8B, it outperforms its generative listwise counterpart while running $24.5\times$ faster on TREC DL and $16.7\times$ faster on BRIGHT.
summary_zh: 将生成式LLM的排序知识蒸馏至决策模型存在表达差异：教师通过文档ID序列表达偏好，学生依赖首词位置评分。
提出DecisionRank，通过项目空间在线策略蒸馏（OPD）构建学生排序序列，由生成式教师提供条件反馈直接监督评分。
结合离线监督，DecisionRank在多项检索基准达SOTA；1.7B模型超越27B教师，8B模型较生成式对位快16.7倍以上。

title: Where ADS Crashes Differ: A Harmonized Comparison Against Human Baselines
title_zh: 自动驾驶与人类驾驶事故类型差异的协调对比
abstract: Crash-rate comparisons between automated driving systems (ADS) and human drivers require an exposure denominator that only a few operators publish. We instead ask a composition question: given a crash, does the mix of crash types differ between ADS and human-driven vehicles? The question needs no mileage and can therefore cover every ADS operator. We assemble the NHTSA Standing General Order (SGO) ADS incident files across both file generations into 2,450 distinct in-scope incidents (2021-2026), of which 828 fall within the 2021-2024 window covered by the Crash Report Sampling System (CRSS), the national police-reported human comparator. A schema-constrained large language model (LLM) codes each SGO narrative into the CRSS crash-type taxonomy. Because SGO compels reporting far below the police-reporting threshold, we bracket reportability with an objective severity floor and a reasonable-person rubric, and claim a difference only where it survives both. Two composition differences hold under every reportability definition, tow definition and weighting of the human side, and under both definitions of driverless operation: turn-across-path crashes are under-represented among ADS crashes (0.23-0.46x the CRSS share under the primary driverless definition) and so are single-vehicle crashes (0.19-0.56x). In severity-floor rear-end crashes the ADS vehicle is the striking party at a quasi-induced-exposure ratio of 0.121 (95% CI [0.05, 0.23]) against a human baseline of 1.000. If the ADS vehicle is also struck more often than its exposure implies, this ratio overstates the ADS-human difference. We also document three pitfalls in the federal data: an operator-specific coding of driverless operation, a tow-away criterion confounded by fleet recovery practice, and an occupancy confound that accounts for about 42% of the apparent ADS-human severity gap.
summary_zh: 传统自动驾驶与人类驾驶事故率对比依赖里程数据，本文改为研究事故类型构成差异，无需里程数据即可覆盖所有运营商。
利用约束大语言模型（LLM）将自动驾驶事故叙述映射至人类事故分类体系，并通过严重性下限和理性人规则界定可报告性。
发现自动驾驶在转弯穿行和单车事故中占比显著偏低，且在追尾事故中多作为撞击方；同时指出了联邦数据中的三个陷阱。

title: Subquadratic Attention with a Hierarchical Tree-Structured Indexer
title_zh: 基于层次树结构索引器的次二次注意力机制
abstract: The quadratic scaling of attention is a fundamental bottleneck limiting the long-context capabilities of large language models (LLMs). A variety of approaches have attempted to circumvent this, but they either fail to match attention's expressiveness (e.g., sliding-window or linear attention variants with fixed-size state) or only achieve constant-factor speedups (e.g., sparse attention methods whose indexers themselves scale quadratically). In this paper, we derive an asymptotically subquadratic sparse attention method based on a hierarchical, tree-structured indexer, which we call Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA). ZHA constructs a tree of recursively compressed key summaries over the KV cache, which future queries traverse from the top down to retrieve a sparse subset of keys. Crucially, by iteratively growing the tree's depth, the total cost including routing and final attention grows sublinearly in sequence length, resulting in overall subquadratic (but superlinear) scaling for attention. We demonstrate that ZHA can be cheaply applied to existing pretrained models with only a short KL distillation training stage over a few billion tokens, and maintains performance on long-context retrieval and challenging reasoning, mathematical, and agentic coding evaluation tasks. Moreover, we show that our method is highly robust to tree geometry including very deep trees of up to 6 levels. Finally, we develop a detailed performance model and show that our approach scales subquadratically, dramatically outperforms competing methods beyond 1 million context, and ultimately has the potential to extend effective context windows to the hundreds of millions or billions of tokens.
summary_zh: LLM的二次注意力复杂度限制长上下文能力，现有方法或损失表达力或仅获常数级加速。
提出ZHA方法，用层次树结构索引器递归压缩KV cache，查询自顶向下检索稀疏键，实现次二次复杂度。
ZHA经少量KL蒸馏即可适配预训练模型，保持长文本与推理性能，在超百万上下文下显著优于现有方法。

title: Quantum 3xplorer: AI-Native Engine for Next-Generation Quantum Materials Modeling
title_zh: Quantum 3xplorer：面向下一代量子材料建模的AI原生引擎
abstract: Quantum-mechanical approaches, such as density functional theory (DFT), underpin much of modern computational materials science and are the primary source of data for AI-driven discovery. Yet the established electronic-structure codes today represent decades-old software architectures, making new physical models slow and costly to implement, validate, and deploy on emerging hardware. We present Quantum 3xplorer (Q3, pronounced "Quantum Explorer"), an AI-native quantum simulation engine written from scratch by AI coding agents under the direction and supervision of domain scientists. As a first and demanding validation case, we implement plane-wave pseudopotential DFT end to end: norm-conserving, ultrasoft, and projector-augmented-wave formalisms, spin polarization, DFT+U, and dispersion corrections, together with forces, stresses, structural relaxation, and electronic-structure analysis. Q3 reproduces established reference implementations, runs faster on a single core in representative benchmarks, and scales across GPU-accelerated supercomputers. It was developed in weeks rather than years. Its layered, physics-first architecture separates abstract quantum-mechanical concepts from their numerical representations, making its framework extendable beyond plane waves to other basis sets and levels of theory. Its inputs and outputs follow structured, schema-validated data standards, making every result AI-ready. Q3 is open source under Apache 2.0 and built to be reused, extended, and improved by the research community. Q3 points to a paradigm shift in how computational quantum science is done. Scientists define the physics, formulate the models, and set the criteria for validation; AI agents write, test, and optimize the code. The decades-long path from a new theory to a trusted, high-performance implementation can thus collapse to days, significantly accelerating scientific discovery.
summary_zh: 现有DFT软件架构陈旧，导致新物理模型在新兴硬件上实现与部署缓慢且昂贵。
提出AI原生量子模拟引擎Q3，由领域科学家指导AI编码代理从头构建，数周内完成开发。
Q3完整实现并验证了多种DFT方法，单核运行更快且支持GPU扩展，其架构易扩展且数据AI就绪。

title: From Scalar Games to Unconstrained Network Zero-Sum Games: Transfer Principles for Gradient-Based Learning
title_zh: 从标量博弈到无约束网络零和博弈：梯度学习的迁移原则
abstract: We show that, for a broad class of gradient-based learning rules, scalar zero-sum games form a complete test family for convergence in unconstrained network zero-sum games. Specifically, suppose a learning rule achieves last-iterate or time-average convergence on every scalar game of magnitude $a$ whenever $η\leq f(a)$, where $f$ is nonincreasing. Then the same guarantee holds on an arbitrary network zero-sum game with stacked game operator $\mathbf{G}$ whenever $η\leq f(\lVert\mathbf{G}\rVert_2)$. More generally, finite-time rate guarantees transfer mode by mode: the network response is bounded by the largest response of its scalar canonical games, and under compatible linear initialization conventions the worst-case finite-time network response is exactly the largest scalar canonical rate. Thus, understanding the learning dynamics on scalar games is sufficient to characterize universal convergence and worst-case rates over the corresponding class of network games. The result follows from the classical planar decomposition of real skew-symmetric game operators. Related mode-wise reasoning has appeared implicitly in spectral analyses of particular learning algorithms and in prior work using these decompositions for game representation and visualization; here we isolate the resulting transfer principle for gradient-based learning. We discuss implications for simplifying convergence analysis, time-average guarantees, low-dimensional geometric arguments, accelerated-method design, and worst-case numerical testing.
summary_zh: 针对无约束网络零和博弈的收敛性分析复杂问题，提出基于标量博弈的迁移原则，证明标量博弈构成收敛性的完备测试族。
证明学习规则在标量博弈上的收敛性保证可按模态迁移至网络, 网络最差情况下的有限时间响应由其最大标量典型博弈响应精确界定。
基于实斜对称博弈算子的平面分解，该迁移原则可简化收敛分析、加速方法设计与最差情况数值测试。

title: Think in 360°: Benchmarking and Bootstrapping Panoramic Video Reasoning
title_zh: 全景视频推理的基准测试与自举提升
abstract: A panoramic video captures all directions around the camera, but relevant evidence can appear in different directions and at different times. Understanding it requires models to connect observations across the viewing sphere and time. We introduce PanoVideoBench, the first manually annotated benchmark for comprehensive panoramic video understanding. Its 1,000 questions span five categories and 15 question types, with diagnostic annotations for target search and panoramic capabilities. Evaluation of 11 proprietary, open-source, and panoramic-specialized models identifies cross-view tracking and sphere-time evidence integration as their weakest capabilities. To strengthen these capabilities, we construct PanoVideoCoT, the first reasoning dataset grounded in real panoramic video, through sphere-time-grounded synthesis that converts verified panoramic observations and successful agentic explorations into 13,465 QA-CoT pairs. Starting from a general video MLLM, PanoVideoReasoner learns from this corpus through Panoramic CoT SFT and Evidence-Privileged On-Policy Self-Distillation, a panoramic instantiation of Vision-OPD's OPSD in which the teacher uses verified perspective views to guide student-generated trajectories. It reaches 55.7% on PanoVideoBench, improving the backbone by 12.5 points and the previous SOTA by 2.6. The gains concentrate on the same spatial, cross-view, and temporal capabilities exposed by the benchmark, showing that grounded sphere-time supervision can equip a general video MLLM with panoramic reasoning.
summary_zh: 全景视频理解需跨视角与时空关联，但现有模型缺乏评测基准与推理能力。
构建首个全景视频理解基准PanoVideoBench，揭示模型跨视角追踪与时空证据整合最弱。
提出PanoVideoCoT数据集与PanoVideoReasoner模型，通过时空监督使通用视频MLLM具备全景推理，刷新SOTA。

title: RAMA: Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Agent Routing with Episodic Memory for LEO Satellite Networks
title_zh: 基于情景记忆的检索增强多智能体LEO卫星网络路由
abstract: Low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellite networks present a challenging routing environment due to rapidly changing topology, traffic, and link conditions. Existing deep reinforcement learning (DRL) routing methods typically rely on current observations and information encoded in network weights, limiting their ability to exploit successful past experiences. We propose RAMA, a retrieval-augmented multi-agent DRL framework with Approximate Information State (AIS), in which each satellite combines its local observation, recent routing history, neighboring state information, and retrieved entries from a per-satellite episodic memory. Retrieved experiences are integrated through a Transformer-based decision network trained with AIS-based auxiliary objectives. With weights frozen in a 140-satellite Kepler constellation, RAMA reduces mean end-to-end latency by 13.4% and 99th-percentile latency by 66.7% relative to the state-of-theart double deep Q-network (DDQN) routing method, mainly by avoiding long detours. Updated online, RAMA remains stable while DDQN degrades. On the 1,584-satellite Starlink shell 1, the reduction in mean latency grows to 93.2%, and updating RAMA online lowers its mean latency by a further 25.5%. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of retrieval-augmented memory for scalable decentralized routing in LEO satellite networks.
summary_zh: LEO卫星网络拓扑多变，现有DRL路由难以利用历史成功经验。
提出RAMA框架，卫星结合局部观测与检索的情景记忆，经Transformer决策网络整合。
RAMA显著降低端到端延迟，在线更新稳定，验证了检索增强记忆的有效性。

title: CRoS: Causality Reward on Scrambled CoTs Improves Accuracy and Reasoning Faithfulness
title_zh: CRoS：基于打乱CoT的因果奖励提升准确性与推理忠实度
abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become the standard method for training language models to reason. However, RLVR typically relies solely on outcome correctness, which does not guarantee that the CoT causally contributes to the final answer. Without this connection, outcome rewards may fail to reinforce high-quality reasoning. Existing causality metrics assess CoT causality by perturbing the CoT, such as deleting reasoning steps or injecting errors, and measuring changes in the final answer. However, these perturbations inevitably alter information in each step. Consequently, high causality scores may reflect sensitivity to information changes introduced by perturbation rather than true causality. Such confounding effects further induce undesirable reasoning behaviors when these metrics are used as training rewards, including generating less informative CoTs and reducing exploration and self-correction. To address this problem, we propose CRoS (Causality Reward on Scrambled CoTs), a novel CoT causality metric that perturbs the order of reasoning steps without altering content, thereby preserving information within each step. On Reasoning Gym with Gemma-3-4B, CRoS outperforms existing causality and outcome rewards in out-of-domain accuracy, CoT quality, and CoT faithfulness. Specifically, CRoS achieves 46.8% accuracy on five unseen logic and games datasets, outperforming the strongest baseline (43.8%). It also achieves better CoT quality, consistently outperforming baselines in CoT-Pass@K from K=1 to 128, averaging 43.4% vs. 41.4%. For CoT faithfulness, CRoS achieves a hint acknowledgment score of 34.0% vs. 20.2%.
summary_zh: 现有RLVR仅依赖结果正确性，无法保证CoT对最终答案的因果贡献，且现有因果指标因扰动改变信息而产生混淆效应。
提出CRoS方法，通过打乱推理步骤顺序进行扰动而不改变内容，消除信息变化的混淆，更准确评估CoT因果性。
实验表明，CRoS在OOD准确率、CoT质量及忠实度上均优于现有基线，有效提升推理的探索与自我纠错能力。
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 14 tables. Project page: https://xxiaoyuuuu.github.io/CRoS-Page

title: REA: A Routed Embodied Agent Runtime for Asynchronous Brain-Cerebellum Control
title_zh: REA：面向异步脑-小脑控制的具身智能体路由运行时
abstract: Foundation models are becoming remarkably reliable at high-level reasoning, yet they remain too slow and costly to serve as fine-grained controllers. Conversely, fast policies like VLAs and whole-body controllers offer more efficient reflexes, but struggle to generalize. While pairing a deliberative brain (foundation models) with a reactive cerebellum (fast policies) seems natural for embodied systems, two obstacles remain: methods are built and scored on incompatible stacks, and their asynchronous coordination is difficult. For example, an agent that calls the VLA in the agentic loop can stall the fast execution, while a VLA that calls the agent on errors tends to re-trigger fallbacks repeatedly or completely miss silent failures. To address this, we propose REA (Routed Embodied Agent), a unified runtime where a deliberative System 2, an embodied router System 1 and reactive System 0 policies cooperate under a single golden rule - no running policy waits on the brain. Instead of querying the brain at each failure, REA employs a route memory that stores each policy's measured success ahead of time, a boundary-triggered judge gate that consults the brain on policy execution, and a shared-budget escalation ladder for bounded recovery. Evaluated on 3,000 test episodes across 60 LIBERO-Pro tasks, REA reaches 95.9% success and beats the best single-agent baseline in its own policy pool (94.7%) while reducing control steps by 25% and control time by 17%. In a separate 100-episode RoboTwin 2.0 study, REA achieves 84% success with VLA policies and 86% with VLA+code, compared with 80% for the strongest single VLA baseline MEDex. These results demonstrate learned and programmatic policies operating within the same runtime. REA also transfers to BEHAVIOR-1K and a real Unitree G1 humanoid, achieving the highest observed success among the compared methods.
summary_zh: 基础模型推理慢而快速策略泛化差，两者异步协调易导致执行停滞或反复回退，需解决异构栈融合与异步控制问题。
提出REA运行时，包含审慎System 2、路由System 1与反应System 0，遵循运行策略不等待大脑的黄金法则。
通过路由记忆、边界触发判断门与共享预算升级阶梯实现协调，在LIBERO-Pro等任务上超越基线并减少控制步数与时间。
实验表明REA成功融合学习与程序化策略，且可迁移至BEHAVIOR-1K及真实Unitree G1机器人。

title: CausalXRL: Explainable Reinforcement Learning through Causal Graph Reasoning
title_zh: CausalXRL：基于因果图推理的可解释强化学习
abstract: Reinforcement learning is a powerful paradigm for training autonomous agents and has achieved impressive performance in complex environments. However, this success often comes at the cost of interpretability, diminishing trust and complicating efforts to debug and improve agent behavior. To address these challenges, we introduce CausalXRL, a novel framework for explainable reinforcement learning (XRL). A key feature of CausalXRL is its use of causal graph reasoning, which provides transparent, structured, multi-level explanations of agent decision-making. We validate CausalXRL through comprehensive case studies and a two-part evaluation: (1) a quantitative analysis of explanation fidelity and causal-structure learning efficiency in benchmark RL environments, and (2) a qualitative expert study assessing explainability in the real-time strategy (RTS) benchmark MicroRTS. The quantitative results show that CausalXRL can provide faithful explanations while efficiently learning causal structures, and the qualitative expert study suggests that participants found CausalXRL useful for inspecting high-level RTS strategies.
summary_zh: 强化学习缺乏可解释性，导致难以调试和建立信任，需引入可解释强化学习（XRL）框架。
提出CausalXRL框架，利用因果图推理对智能体决策提供透明、结构化且多层次的解释。
定量实验表明该框架能高效学习因果结构并提供忠实解释；定性研究证实其有助于审查高层策略。
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 - full paper - main track
journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 306:158028-158044, 2026

title: An end-to-end CNN search for ultra-short-period planets in TESS: from the blend ceiling to the independent validation of TOI-6662 b
title_zh: 端到端CNN在TESS中搜索超短周期行星：从混合上限到独立验证TOI-6662 b
abstract: We trained a convolutional neural network to detect ultra-short-period planets in TESS photometry, following the procedure now standard in the field: synthetic transits as positives, eclipsing binaries as negatives. Measured that way it reaches an area under the ROC curve of 0.97. Keeping the same model and the same planets, but replacing the negatives with false positives that the TESS Follow-up Observing Program has actually rejected, the area falls to 0.50 -- the value of a random classifier. The conventional benchmark had been measuring a problem that does not exist. The reason is physical, and it bounds what is possible. Of 145 such false positives examined at pixel level, 42% are blends: eclipses belonging to a neighbouring star, diluted into the target aperture. Their light curves are indistinguishable from shallow transits, capping the attainable area at 1 - f/2 = 0.79. Retraining on real false positives reaches 0.80 +/- 0.06, confirming the ceiling independently. No classifier reading a single-band light curve can do better. A detector alone is the wrong instrument. We built CASCADE-USP, a pipeline chaining the network with difference-image centroid analysis, scene modelling with high-resolution imaging and the Gaia astrometric solution, supplying in sequence what the light curve lacks. Its output is a prioritisation, not a verdict: it records what evidence each candidate still needs. Only the classifier is domain-specific; the other stages apply to any transit candidate. Of 435 unresolved TESS candidates it isolates 20; 19 prove false positives, traced to causes invisible in TESS photometry. The twentieth is TOI-6662 b, an Earth-sized planet (0.94 +/- 0.03 Earth radii) orbiting an M dwarf every 7.05 hours. Our validation, independent of a concurrent one, agrees with it in planetary parameters and classification, closing the CASCADE procedure with an external check.
summary_zh: 传统CNN使用食双星作负样本检测超短周期行星，但换用真实误报后性能降至随机水平，因42%误报为邻星混合，致ROC上限仅为0.79。
单波段光曲线无法突破该上限，故构建CASCADE-USP流水线，将CNN与差分质心分析等结合，以补充光曲线缺失信息。
该流水线从435个候选体中筛选出20个，其中19个为误报，第20个为独立验证的地球大小行星TOI-6662 b，其轨道周期为7.05小时。
comment: 37 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to Experimental Astronomy

title: TradeWar: A Benchmark for Execution-Grounded Trade Negotiation with Adaptive LLM Agents
title_zh: TradeWar：基于执行反馈的自适应LLM贸易谈判基准
abstract: Multi-turn negotiation remains a challenging problem for large language model (LLM) agents. While LLMs can conduct natural-language dialogue, existing benchmarks predominantly assess only agreement rates, overlooking whether negotiated commitments actually create value once executed. To address this gap, we introduce TradeWar, a multi-country simulation benchmark that translates negotiation dialogues into concrete tariff and trade-share policies, enforces capacity and network constraints during settlement, and evaluates outcomes via an Economic Health Index (EHI). To solve this execution-grounded task, we propose TACTIC (Trade-aware Adaptive Consolidation and Theory-of-mind for International Commerce), an agent that iteratively refines its negotiation strategy across episodes-without updating base LLM weights-by leveraging prior experience, opponent behavior, and past settlement outcomes. Despite using zero-shot chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting, PromptLLM attains a 75% agreement rate but only 57.1 final EHI (*100), whereas TACTIC reaches 68.8. Across 20 sequential episodes and three seeds, TACTIC's final EHI improves from 58.2 to 73.2, compared with 65.2 for an ablation without cross-episode updates. Under technology-controls and energy-crisis shocks, TACTIC also exhibits smaller performance degradation than PromptLLM and MemoryLLM. These results indicate that CoT deliberation and interaction memory alone do not fully address delayed execution feedback, whereas settlement-grounded adaptation improves long-horizon negotiation in TradeWar.
summary_zh: 现有谈判基准仅评估协议率，忽视承诺执行后是否真正创造价值，无法衡量多轮谈判的实际成效。
提出TradeWar基准将谈判转化为关税与贸易政策，并在约束下结算评估；同时提出TACTIC代理，利用历史经验与对手行为迭代优化策略。
实验表明，仅靠CoT与交互记忆无法解决执行反馈延迟问题，基于结算反馈的自适应策略能显著提升长期谈判的经济健康指数。

title: AutoAnalysis: An automated, self-updating meta-analysis of human-AI collaboration
title_zh: 人机协作的自动化自更新元分析
abstract: As generative artificial intelligence (AI) becomes more capable and widely used, understanding when and how humans should work with these systems is becoming increasingly important. However, the empirical evidence in this space offers conflicting recommendations, which leaves individuals and organizations without clear guidance on when to combine human and AI capabilities. Existing meta-analyses can help reconcile these findings, but they require substantial manual effort and cannot readily incorporate new evidence as it emerges. To address this challenge, we introduce AutoAnalysis: an automated, self-updating meta-analysis of when humans and AI work better together, and when they work better alone. AutoAnalysis' most recent run synthesizes 1,955 effect sizes from 420 papers. Across this body of work, we found that, on average, human-AI combinations performed significantly better than humans alone, but they performed significantly worse than the better of humans or AI alone. These findings highlight the important distinction between improving human performance and achieving human-AI synergy and underscore the need to evaluate collaboration against both human and AI performance alone. As new studies emerge, AutoAnalysis will integrate their findings into the meta-analysis, providing cumulative evidence about when humans and AI perform better together and how human-AI performance varies across AI agents, tasks, and processes.
summary_zh: 人机协作实证结论冲突且缺乏明确指导，现有元分析需大量人工且难以及时纳入新证据。
提出 AutoAnalysis，一种自动化、自更新的元分析系统，持续整合新研究以评估人机协作效果。
发现人机组合显著优于仅人类，但逊于两者最优者，表明提升人类表现不等于实现人机协同。
comment: Please visit auto-analysis.dev to explore the data and view the most recent results

title: SecPO: Principled Adversarial Training for Prompt Injection Security
title_zh: SecPO：针对提示注入安全的原理性对抗训练
abstract: Recognized as a top threat to AI agents, prompt injection allows instructions from untrusted data (email, documents, websites) to manipulate the agent's operation. The existing best-defended LLM, Meta-SecAlign, is trained with the DPO loss but still suffers from attack success rates (ASRs) approaching 100% under adaptive prompt injections. One reason is that DPO anchors the model around the undefended reference model, which is insecure. We show an idealized reference model---an injection-invariant, utility-preserving oracle---can nevertheless be approximated, as its output distribution in training is interestingly accessible. This new observation motivates a theoretically principled SecPO loss. Another Meta-SecAlign shortcoming is that it trains on weak simulated attacks. We implement an efficient adversarial training (AT) pipeline that synthesizes strong injected inputs (best@240), and train the model on them. Our AT reduces ASRs by 1.5-14.5$\times$ across three SoTA adaptive attacks, compared with Meta-SecAlign; the SecPO loss reduces them by a further 2.4-4.6$\times$ compared with using DPO loss. In agentic workflows, our SecPO + AT Qwen3.6-27B is much more secure than Meta-SecAlign: 8.8% vs. 78.8% AgentDojo ASR@800 under the AttackerMovesSecond attack. Moreover, our defended model shows no noticeable reduction in benign utility in nine benchmarks covering agentic tool calling, instruction following, science, and math. We release our $\href{//github.com/Sizhe-Chen/SecPO}{\text{code}}$, $\href{//huggingface.co/datasets/Sizhe-Chen/Qwen3.6-27B-Instruct-SecPO-trainset}{\text{training data}}$ (with optimized injections from AT), and $\href{//huggingface.co/Sizhe-Chen/Qwen3.6-27B-Instruct-SecPO}{\text{model}}$.
summary_zh: 现有基于DPO的防御模型因依赖不安全参考模型且仅用弱攻击训练，在自适应提示注入下ASR仍近100%。
提出SecPO损失近似注入不变且保效用的理想参考模型，并构建高效对抗训练（AT）管道合成强注入样本。
SecPO与AT结合大幅降低ASR，且不损失良性效用，其Qwen3.6-27B模型安全性远超现有SOTA。

title: DAMI: Dual-Axis Memory Initialization for Enhanced Long-Context Retrieval in Gated Linear Attention
title_zh: DAMI：面向门控线性注意力长上下文检索的双轴记忆初始化
abstract: Linear attention scales linearly with sequence length, but its finite-state memory can limit long-context retrieval. In gated linear recurrences, memory retention depends on state decay, which is shaped jointly by gate parameters A_log and dt_bias and by input activations. In controlled Gated DeltaNet (GDN) experiments, both parameters remain highly correlated with their initial values after training, highlighting the importance of initialization. Therefore, we introduce Dual-Axis Memory Initialization (DAMI), which jointly configures these parameters before training. DAMI assigns geometric timescales across heads for varied retrieval distances and a low-high-low input-sensitivity profile across layers. A small activation sample calibrates the GDN-family implementation to match both behavioral targets without adding trainable parameters. Across GDN, KDA, GDN2, Mamba-2, and RWKV-7, DAMI improves average RULER-style retrieval accuracy by 5.29 to 16.71 percentage points over the corresponding random-initialization baselines. Performance on language modeling, commonsense reasoning, and 2K real-world retrieval remains broadly comparable to those baselines. Our code is available at https://speedai.com/research/dami.
summary_zh: 线性注意力有限状态记忆限制长上下文检索，且门控参数训练后与初始值高度相关，凸显初始化重要性。
提出DAMI方法，在训练前联合配置门控参数，为不同头分配几何时间尺度，为不同层设置低高低输入敏感度剖面。
DAMI在多种模型上使RULER检索准确率提升5.29至16.71个百分点，且其他任务性能与基线相当。

title: TwinPast: Benchmarking Historical Evidence Use in Streaming Video Understanding with Evidence Contrastive Video Pairs
title_zh: TwinPast：基于证据对比视频对的流视频历史证据使用评测
abstract: High accuracy on streaming video benchmarks does not establish whether a model uses visual history. Our review of OVO-Bench and StreamingBench finds that recent frames suffice for 32% of sampled historical questions, while models also answer many questions correctly from the question and options alone. We introduce TwinPast to test whether answers correctly follow changes in history, using 350 human-reviewed video pairs spanning five historical tasks. Each pair holds the recent video context, question, and ordered options fixed while changing critical historical evidence and the correct answer. Each video is evaluated independently, and PairAcc requires correct answers for both histories. We evaluate 34 model and input configurations. For Qwen3-VL-8B and DeepSeek-Flash, historical inputs improve performance on TwinPast, reversing the recent-frame advantage on existing benchmarks. The strongest evaluated streaming system reaches 49.14% PairAcc, compared with 66.57-91.43% for the evaluated general-purpose models. This gap persists across all five tasks. Case studies further show that models select states from the wrong time or contradict recorded event order despite retaining the relevant evidence. These findings highlight the need to connect historical memory and retrieval with reasoning that uses evidence according to the question's temporal references and event relations.
summary_zh: 现有流视频评测无法验证模型是否真正利用视觉历史，因近期帧或仅问题选项即可答对历史问题。
提出 TwinPast 基准，通过固定近期上下文与问题、仅改变关键历史证据构建350对对比视频，以 PairAcc 评估模型对历史变化的遵循能力。
实验表明流视频系统最强仅达 49.14% PairAcc，远逊于通用模型；模型常选错时间状态或违背事件顺序，需将历史记忆与推理结合。

title: Aligning MLLMs with the Latent Structure of Human Cognition via Behavior-Derived Semantic Dimensions
title_zh: 基于行为语义维度将MLLM与人类认知潜结构对齐
abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive performance across a wide range of reasoning tasks, yet it remains unclear whether their internal representations and decision criteria align with the latent structure of human cognition. In this work, we propose a novel framework to align MLLMs with the multidimensional mental representations underlying human similarity judgements. We build on a previously established behavior-derived semantic embedding space, in which objects are represented along 66 interpretable dimensions derived from 4.70 million human Odd-One-Out (O1O) judgements. For each triplet, we infer the most salient decision dimension and convert it into a dimension-grounded linguistic rationale. This enables MLLMs to learn both the final choice and a justification consistent with the inferred behavioral criterion. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves model consistency with human similarity judgements while retaining competitive performance on standard multimodal benchmarks. Furthermore, using searchlight Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA) on an independent fMRI Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD), we observe increased representational alignment between model and human. Ultimately, our findings point to a data-driven route for incorporating human cognitive structure into MLLMs alignment. The code is available \href{https://github.com/ening-open/cogalign}{here}.
summary_zh: MLLM的内部表征与人类认知潜结构是否对齐尚不明确，需探索有效对齐方法。
利用470万人类Odd-One-Out判断构建66维语义空间，提取显著决策维度并转化为语言依据，指导MLLM学习。
该方法提升了模型与人类判断的一致性及fMRI表征对齐度，且保持基准性能，提供了数据驱动的认知对齐路径。

title: Adaptive Coverage Algorithms for Mobile Ad Hoc Networks in Dynamic Worlds
title_zh: 动态世界中移动自组网的自适应覆盖算法
abstract: This paper extends an existing framework for the coordination of mobile agents in unknown worlds, by considering the possibility of dynamic instability. In the original problem, known as the Partially Observable Cooperative Guard Art Gallery Problem (POCGAGP) (arXiv:2512.09495), the multi-agent system must establish a communication network which completely covers an initially unknown constrained space. However, the POCGAGP fails to account for the unpredictability often seen in real-world deployment. To address this, the dynamic case (DPOCGAGP) introduces two settings which can influence the mobile network during deployment: Agent Loss and World Change, which represent dynamic changes to the world. Within this study, we present advancements to two state-of-the-art algorithms, the Centralized Agent-Directed Exploration for Network Coverage (CADENCE), and its decentralized analogue, DADENCE, to provide solutions in these cases. We then compare their performance against another state-of-the-art benchmark algorithm, and show that the adapted algorithms outperform across our benchmark test set, which comprises over 4500 test cases of varied size and structure.
summary_zh: 现有部分可观察协同守卫画廊问题未考虑现实部署的动态不稳定性，需解决该问题。
引入动态设置（智能体丢失与世界变化），并改进CADENCE与DADENCE两种算法。
在超4500个测试用例中，改进后的算法性能显著优于基准算法。
comment: 8 pages, 10 figures. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE MIT Undergraduate Research Technology Conference (URTC)

title: Completeness and Cost of Retrieval Structures for Multi-Tool Requests in LLM Agents
title_zh: LLM Agent多工具请求检索结构的完整性与成本
abstract: An agent that must call several tools to fulfill a request fails when the tool retriever omits any one of them, yet tool retrievers are mostly built and evaluated on queries requiring a single tool. We compare representatives of six retrieval structures (flat lexical and dense retrieval, LLM query decomposition, LLM-navigated hierarchies, server-then-tool matching, dependency graphs, and trained set-level retrievers) across two multi-tool testbeds: 345 AppWorld queries with expert dependency labels and 103 MCP-Bench tasks over 257 MCP tools. We measure completeness@k, the share of queries whose entire required tool set appears in the top k, alongside the LLM calls, tokens, and latency that each structure incurs at retrieval time. A motivating analysis on all 7,961 ToolRet queries shows that aggregate completeness mixes two regimes: completeness at 10 is .58 to .67 on single-target queries and .08 to .17 on queries with four or more targets, and the ordering of retrievers on single-target queries reverses on multi-target ones. Across the two testbeds, none of the compared structures that is untrained on the testbed and makes at most one LLM call per query completes more than 10% of AppWorld queries at k = 16. The two structures that do better incur different costs: a set-level retriever trained on 75 to 90 in-domain queries reaches .33 on AppWorld and .58 on MCP-Bench with no LLM calls, while an LLM-navigated hierarchy reaches .30 and .40 with a median of 31 to 38 LLM calls and about five minutes per query. Their failure modes also differ: the trained retriever mostly ranks the missing tools just below the cutoff, whereas the hierarchy finds the target API and stops before collecting its prerequisites. In a downstream check with the official AppWorld agent, tasks with a complete retrieved set succeeded 21 of 21 times, whereas incomplete ones succeeded 2 of 39 times.
summary_zh: 现有工具检索器多基于单工具查询评估，在多工具请求下常因遗漏工具而失败，且单/多工具场景下检索器优劣排序相反。
对比六种检索结构在两个多工具测试集上的完整性与成本，发现未训练且仅单次LLM调用的结构在k=16时完整性不足10%。
表现较好的两种结构代价迥异：训练后的集合级检索器无需LLM调用但需领域数据，LLM导航层级结构则需大量LLM调用与高延迟。

title: Statistical Foundations of Reinforcement Learning: A Non-Asymptotic Perspective
title_zh: 强化学习的非渐近统计基础
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) embodies a foundational paradigm for sequential decision-making in the face of uncertainty. The rapid growth of model complexity in emerging applications has significantly amplified the challenges of achieving data-efficient RL, particularly in sample-starved scenarios where data collection may be costly, time-consuming, or even high-stakes. Consequently, understanding and improving the data efficiency of RL algorithms has become a central problem of both fundamental theoretical interest and practical importance. Despite decades of research, the statistical underpinnings of RL remained remarkably underdeveloped until relatively recently, particularly in the finite-sample regimes most relevant to modern practice. Over the past few years, there has been a surge of activity advancing the frontiers of non-asymptotic statistical RL theory, drawing on ideas from high-dimensional statistics and probability, information theory, and statistical learning theory. In this monograph, we present a non-asymptotic treatment for RL based on tabular Markov decision processes, focusing on three canonical sampling mechanisms --- RL with a generative model, online RL, and offline RL --- together with two algorithmic paradigms: model-based and model-free approaches. Centered around non-asymptotic sample complexity analysis, our treatment emphasizes minimax-optimal algorithm design, particularly methods that attain statistical optimality without significant burn-in costs, as well as sharp statistical characterizations of several widely used RL algorithms. Whenever possible, we provide largely self-contained analyses together with intuitive explanations. We also briefly discuss several extensions, such as robust RL, competitive multi-agent RL, federated RL, uncertainty quantification, and RL from human feedback.
summary_zh: 数据匮乏场景下RL数据效率低，亟需在有限样本下建立统计理论以指导算法设计。
针对表格MDP，从生成模型、在线和离线三种采样机制及有/无模型两种范式进行非渐近分析。
提出极小极大最优算法设计，实现无显著预热代价的统计最优，并给出常用RL算法的精确刻画。

title: No More Import Errors: Constrained Decoding for Guaranteed Valid Imports in LLM-Generated Tests
title_zh: 约束解码确保LLM生成测试中的有效导入
abstract: One of the most common failure reasons of LLM-based test generation pipelines is import errors. Grammar constrained decoding can modify the probabilities of the LLM's final layer during token generation to guarantee valid imports. However, we find that it can lead to degenerate solutions, i.e., repetitive valid imports (import streaks) that exhaust the token budget before a test is generated. We propose Constrained Beam Decoding with Lookup (CBDL), a novel method that guarantees import validity while addressing import streaks by avoiding premature commitment to tokens that lead to repetitive imports. Because it operates at the decoding stage, CBDL can be integrated into existing LLM-based test generation pipelines. We implement CBDL for Python and Java and evaluate it on two test generation tasks, showing that generated tests have 100% valid imports, outperforming both static (RAG and LIBRO) and dynamic (Agentic Repair) import-validity approaches that leave 45%, 10%, and 43% of import errors unresolved. CBDL converts on average 14% of initial import errors into functionally correct tests, increasing overall test correctness by 1-4 percentage points over unconstrained generation. Even when import validity does not directly lead to a correct test, it allows agentic repair pipelines to allocate the repair budget to remaining errors, increasing correct tests by 2-7 percentage points for Python and 1-6 for Java. Finally, we show that a hybrid pipeline, where a small local model equipped with CBDL generates imports while the frontier GPT-5.2 model generates the test body, outperforms generating both with GPT-5.2 alone by 1-3 percentage points. Overall, CBDL removes a major bottleneck in LLM-based test generation: by guaranteeing import validity with a small overhead (16-21 seconds per test), it improves test correctness and enables cost-effective hybrid generation.
summary_zh: LLM生成测试常因导入错误失败，现有语法约束解码易导致重复导入耗尽token预算。
提出CBDL方法，在解码阶段避免过早提交重复导入token，保证导入有效且解决退化问题。
CBDL实现100%有效导入，优于现有静态和动态方法；并能提升测试正确率，优化修复预算分配。

title: META-Robot: Self-Cognition and Capability Scaling in Agentic Robots
title_zh: META-Robot：智能体机器人的自我认知与能力扩展
abstract: LLM-based robotic agent systems can generate programs for robot control, yet their generalization to new tasks often depends on elaborate scaffolding. Expanding their skill repertoires alone offers limited guidance on how to assess new capabilities or identify what remains beyond their reach. We introduce META-Robot, a framework that couples self cognition with capability scaling by expanding the criteria through which an agent evaluates and develops its skills. At its core, action-level predicates make execution outcomes explicit and available for LLM reasoning. The agent uses these assessments to identify its own limitations, extend relevant evaluation criteria, and guide the structured expansion of its skills. Proprioceptive feedback further grounds this process in the robot's physical state, enriching the evidence available for self-cognition. Experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate stronger overall task performance, generalization to new tasks, continued expansion of skills and evaluation criteria, and effective use of non-visual proprioceptive signals.
summary_zh: 基于LLM的机器人智能体泛化依赖复杂脚手架，仅扩充技能无法指导评估新能力或识别局限。
提出META-Robot框架，通过动作级谓词使执行结果显式化供LLM推理，结合本体感受反馈丰富自我认知证据。
实验表明该方法提升了任务泛化性能，实现了技能与评估标准的持续扩展，并有效利用了非视觉信号。

title: SketchMate: Agentic Geometric Reasoning for Zero-Shot Precision Insertion
title_zh: SketchMate：面向零样本精密插入的智能体几何推理
abstract: Inserting an unseen part requires sub-millimetre precision and the correct orientation of keyed features. Current zero-shot agentic manipulation methods built on vision-language models (VLMs) produce spatial outputs that are far too coarse for this. We propose to let a VLM build a sketch model of the task, i.e., a few geometric primitives and two mate frames, which a VLM agent measures with geometric tools in multi-view depth and which a standard planner and compliant controller execute. Because a sketch describes the parts independently of their placement, the robot needs to build it only once per task. A sketch memory stores each agent run and transfers the stored sketch to later placements by point-cloud registration, so that the VLM is called only for unfamiliar parts. After grasping the part, the robot inspects both mating faces at close range and corrects the sketch by shape matching. On 69 simulated insertion episodes, our method inserts 88% of the parts at the assembled pose in a strict kinematic test, while ReKep and MOKA with the same VLM insert none. On new placements of eight tasks, reusing one stored run inserts as many parts as calling the agent in each episode, and it produces the sketch in 3.4 s instead of about 90 s.
summary_zh: 零样本智能体操作方法的VLM空间输出过于粗糙，无法满足精密插入的亚毫米级精度需求。
提出让VLM构建几何草图模型，由智能体使用几何工具测量，再经规划器与柔顺控制器执行。
方法在仿真中插入成功率达88%，远超基线方法；复用草图记忆可将耗时从约90秒降至3.4秒。

title: Open-Weight MLLMs Cannot Compare What They Cannot Name
title_zh: 开源MLLM无法比较其无法命名的对象
abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly capable of understanding images and performing complex visual reasoning, suggesting the possibility of using them to automate biological image analysis. This need is becoming increasingly urgent as advances in technology continue to generate ever larger and more diverse microscopy datasets, already exceeding the scale at which manual visual analysis is feasible. With the final aim to use MLLMs for visual comparison of complex phenotypes, we investigate a very simple baseline: comparison of the size of body parts in synthetic images of ants. We find that state-of-the-art open-weight MLLMs fail for some body parts, but not for others, even though the comparison itself is visually trivial for all of them. We evaluate different in-context learning strategies and analyze performance on the related object recognition task. Our results suggest a recognition-driven grounding failure: structures that the models cannot recognize are instead associated with a recognizable semantic concept, impairing the grounding and comparison of both. Further analysis of the vision encoder is consistent with the hypothesis that fine-grained visual structure may be less well preserved without semantic support. Together, our results reveal a surprising limitation of current MLLMs: semantic recognition can gate simple visual comparisons that do not intrinsically require semantic understanding. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/kreshuklab/Open-Weight-MLLMs-Cannot-Compare-What-They-Cannot-Name
summary_zh: 生物学显微图像数据激增，亟需自动化分析，但当前开源MLLM在视觉比较任务上存在严重局限。
以合成蚂蚁图像的部位大小比较为基线测试，发现开源MLLM对无法识别的结构会产生语义错配，导致定位与比较失败。
揭示当前MLLM的惊人局限：语义识别会制约简单的视觉比较，且视觉编码器在缺乏语义支持时难以保留细粒度视觉结构。

title: RECAST: REconstruction of Chain-of-Thought via Auditable Structured Traces
title_zh: RECAST：基于可审计结构化轨迹的思维链重建
abstract: Large closed-source reasoning models expose only their final answers. The intermediate reasoning that produces those answers is hidden behind API surfaces, tool-call policies, and safety filters. Existing chain-of-thought (CoT) extraction methods assume a side channel: a visible reasoning field, a scratchpad carried through tool calls, or a signed/encrypted reasoning block. We reproduce three representative state-of-the-art extraction methods and find that, on Claude-Sonnet-5.5 accessed through the standard chat-completions interface, all three return zero CoT tokens. The failure is structural rather than a bug: the reasoning field is absent, named tool selection is rejected, free-text scratchpad arguments are filtered, and no replayable reasoning block is exposed. We therefore take a different route. We present RECAST, a reconstruction-based framework that conditions a decoder on the question and the target model's final answer, reconstructs a first-person structured rationale, cleans it, and builds SFT-ready data. To the best of our knowledge, RECAST is the first system to reconstruct CoT from frontier closed models such as Claude-Sonnet-5.5, GPT-6.1, and Gemini 3 without using hidden reasoning channels. We instantiate RECAST on Claude-Sonnet-5.5 and additionally obtain successful qualitative reconstructions on GPT-6.1 and Gemini 3 with the same answer-only protocol. The system is open-source and packaged as an agent skill: one prompt deploys it and runs the complete pipeline to produce SFT-ready CoT data. This preprint describes the system, its threat model, and a controlled artifact validation; it does not claim large-scale benchmark improvements.
summary_zh: 闭源推理模型隐藏中间推理过程，现有CoT提取方法依赖隐藏通道且在主流模型上完全失效。
提出RECAST框架，以问题和最终答案为条件，通过解码器重建第一人称结构化推理并生成SFT数据。
首次在不依赖隐藏通道下成功重建Claude等前沿闭源模型的CoT，并开源为可一键部署的agent技能。

title: What Standard Evaluations Hide About Detectors of Hijacked LLM Agents: Rare Attacks, Unseen Tools and Benchmark Transfer
title_zh: 标准评估对被劫持LLM代理检测器的隐藏问题
abstract: Detectors can flag hijacked large language model (LLM) agents from the traces of the tools they call. In the eleven evaluations we audited, attacks or anomalies make up 16% to 86% of the test samples, no evaluation varies that share, and six report no test on data from a second benchmark or source. We ask what such evaluations hide. On the AgentDrift and AgentDojo benchmarks we test trained detectors that read tool identities, behavior, call sequences, step embeddings or text, and a released LLM action monitor, AlignmentCheck, with thresholds fixed on training data or set by the monitor's released decision rule. First, at a 2% attack rate a detector with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.879 reaches a precision of 0.076, and the mix of negatives alone moves that precision between 0.039 and 0.117. Second, as tool coverage, the share of test tool calls whose tool was seen in training, falls, detector rankings cross near 50% coverage and reverse below it, because unseen tools map to inputs that training never reached. Dropout on tool inputs largely removes the reversal. Third, no detector trained on AgentDrift ranks AgentDojo traces better than chance (AUROC 0.47 to 0.52), including one that reaches 0.996 within AgentDojo. The monitor, trained on neither, reaches 0.930, but with its open backbone its released decision rule would still mostly raise false alerts at a 2% attack rate (precision 0.096). We turn these findings into a checklist for evaluating trace detectors.
summary_zh: 现有检测器评估未考虑真实低攻击率，导致2%攻击率下高AUROC检测器的精确度极低且随负样本波动。
测试集出现未见过工具时，检测器排名会反转；对工具输入使用Dropout可大幅消除此反转现象。
检测器跨基准测试泛化极差，在另一基准上表现近乎随机；据此提出评估轨迹检测器的核对清单。
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Code, data and every monitor call: https://github.com/Mahmoud-Abbasi-svg/agent-trace-detector-eval

title: Stepwise-Querying: Distilling Reasoning without Access to Teacher Chain-of-Thought
title_zh: 无教师思维链访问下的逐步查询推理蒸馏
abstract: Reasoning distillation is widely used to transfer the reasoning capabilities of large language models to smaller students through teacher-generated supervision. In the black-box setting, however, teachers may expose only final answers and brief solutions, leaving intermediate calculations and validity conditions unavailable and thus limiting the reasoning supervision available for distillation. We propose Stepwise Querying, which elicits step-specific explanations without requiring access to the teacher's internal chain-of-thought (CoT) traces. Independent queries to the same teacher request intermediate derivations, validity checks, and corrections for individual steps, the assembled solutions are then used for standard supervised fine-tuning. Across two teachers, two students, and four mathematics and code benchmarks, our method achieves the highest score in 14 of 16 comparisons with three baselines. We further introduce Stepwise Explanation Information Gain (SEIG), a diagnostic based on the log-ratio of a frozen student's probabilities of correct step completion under stepwise and global explanations. Analyses on GSM8K show that incorrect-answer trajectories can remain useful when they preserve valid intermediate reasoning, while further decomposition yields limited additional gains.
summary_zh: 黑箱推理蒸馏中教师仅暴露最终答案，缺乏中间步骤监督。提出逐步查询法，独立请求教师对各步骤提供推导与校验，无需访问其内部CoT。
将逐步查询组装的解答用于监督微调。在数学与代码基准上，该方法于16项对比中14项取得最高分，显著优于基线。
提出SEIG指标诊断逐步解释的信息增益。分析表明，保留有效中间推理的错误答案轨迹仍有用，而进一步分解收益有限。

title: Multimodal In-Context Learning with Explicit Rule Induction
title_zh: 基于显式规则归纳的多模态上下文学习
abstract: A central challenge in multimodal in-context learning (MICL) arises from tasks that are ill-defined without context and require uncovering the underlying rules from demonstrations. Existing methods predominantly treat MICL as direct input-output mapping, overlooking the importance of explicitly inducing and reasoning over such rules, limiting both performance and interpretability. We propose ERIM, Explicit Rule-Induction for Multimodal In-Context Learning, a unified framework that enhances MICL by explicitly inducing the latent rules governing demonstration samples. Leveraging the reasoning ability of multi-modal large language model (MLLM), ERIM constructs rule-centric MICL datasets, introduces explicit supervision for rule induction, and fine-tunes MLLM to perform explicit rule-induction via a two-stage training strategy that combines mixed cold-start supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments show consistent performance improvements across diverse MICL settings and demonstrate that correctly inducing underlying rules directly leads to stronger and more stable performance.
summary_zh: 多模态上下文学习常面临任务定义模糊问题，现有方法仅做输入输出映射，忽视显式规则归纳，导致性能与可解释性受限。
提出ERIM框架，利用MLLM推理能力构建规则中心数据集，并引入显式监督，通过混合冷启动SFT与RL两阶段训练微调模型。
实验表明，ERIM在多种设置下均提升性能，且正确归纳底层规则能直接带来更强、更稳定的表现。

title: Latent-Lens: Visual Perception in Small Language Models Through Latent Communication
title_zh: Latent-Lens：通过隐空间通信实现小语言模型的视觉感知
abstract: Bridging independent vision-language models (VLMs) and small language models (SLMs) in a modular multi-agent system typically forces them to exchange information as discrete text, which creates a lossy bottleneck for spatial and fine-grained details. This constraint is especially acute for SLMs, whose limited capacity makes them more reliant on the quality of the input signal. Recent latent-communication methods exchange states between language models. How a VLM can pass visual information to a separately pretrained text-only SLM though remains unexplored. We propose \textbf{Latent-Lens}, a lightweight codec that bridges the representation gap between a frozen VLM and a frozen SLM directly in latent space, enabling them to communicate purely through hidden states. The codec consists of a domain encoder that projects hidden states from the VLM into the SLM's embedding space, and an attention decoder formalised as a LoRA that teaches the SLM to attend to these visual prefixes, while training only ${\sim}1.6$M parameters (0.2\% of the combined model size). On visual question answering (CLEVR, GQA), Latent-Lens achieves $81.0\pm7.9$\% and $65.4\pm5.4$\%, compared with $58.3\pm5.7$\% and $61.8\pm1.0$\% for text communication with the same LoRA budget (+30.2--69.8pp relative to frozen text communication), while on image captioning (Flickr8k) it improves over the same baseline by +16.5 (+18.8 frozen). We also evaluate Latent-Lens with TinyLlama-1.1B and InternVL2-1B, which use different architectures, vocabularies, and hidden dimensions.
summary_zh: 模块化多智能体系统中，VLM与SLM通过离散文本交互会丢失空间与细粒度信息，且SLM容量有限更依赖输入信号质量。
提出Latent-Lens轻量级编解码器，在隐空间弥合冻结VLM与SLM的表征鸿沟，仅训练约1.6M参数即可实现纯隐状态通信。
在视觉问答与图像描述任务上，该方法相对文本通信基线显著提升，且在不同架构与词表的SLM和VLM上均具泛化性。

title: Do LLMs Know When They Are Wrong About Molecules? In-Context Property Prediction with Self-Reported Uncertainty
title_zh: LLM对分子的自我纠错能力：基于上下文的属性预测与不确定性
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are used in many domains, but molecular property prediction with them is still little explored. In this work we evaluate the capability of 7 frontier LLMs to predict molecular properties together with a self-reported uncertainty from in-context examples, and compare them with classical baselines trained on the same molecules. We use 4 datasets and screen each for contamination of the training data of the LLMs: three are clean, and the fourth, ESOL, is memorised by most of the models and serves as a comparison. On the clean datasets every LLM improves with the context, at 30 examples the most accurate one beats every baseline. The requested reasoning effort changes accuracy little. The self-reported uncertainty ranks the prediction errors weakly, with Spearman rank correlations of up to 0.46, about the level reached by the uncertainties of the baselines. Combining uncertainty and prediction, on lipophilicity the most certain half of the best LLM is the most accurate at small context sizes; on BACE and antiviral, and on lipophilicity at large context sizes, the best LLMs are on par with the best baseline. On the contaminated ESOL dataset the LLMs show no improvement with the context size, as expected for a memorised dataset, and their stated uncertainty is smaller on the molecules whose value they recall.
summary_zh: 分子属性预测中LLM探索较少，本文评估7种前沿LLM基于上下文示例的属性预测及自报不确定性，并与传统基线对比。
在无数据污染的3个数据集上，LLM随上下文示例增加而提升，30例时最优LLM超越所有基线；而在被记忆的ESOL数据集上，LLM无提升且对记忆分子不确定性更低。
LLM自报不确定性仅弱相关于预测误差（Spearman相关最高0.46），结合不确定性与预测时，最优LLM在部分任务和上下文规模下可媲美最佳基线。

title: Search When Needed, Proceed When Reliable: Metacognitive Reliability Supervision for Efficient Agentic Search
title_zh: 基于元认知可靠性监督的高效智能体搜索
abstract: Efficient agentic search requires large language models (LLMs) to determine whether they can reliably proceed with their current knowledge or need additional external evidence. Supervision based on final-answer correctness or trajectory-level feedback evaluates realized trajectory performance. However, observed trajectory performance is jointly shaped by stochastic generation, retrieval quality, and downstream reasoning. Such signals therefore provide only indirect evidence of how reliable the current decision state was and how retrieved evidence changed its reliability. An effective reward should encourage search when external information is needed and favor searches that contribute to the answer. To this end, we propose a metacognitive framework for training LLMs to make search decisions based on the reliability of their intermediate reasoning states. Our framework estimates the reliability of local conclusions to distinguish whether the current information supports proceeding without search from how much retrieved evidence improves that reliability. The current-state reliability score assesses whether the model can proceed without search. The search-action score measures how retrieved evidence changes estimated reliability. Together, these scores define a reliability-aware process reward for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), providing finer-grained supervision for search and no-search behavior. Experiments across seven question-answering benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off than strong agentic-search baselines. Our code and model checkpoints will be open-sourced.
summary_zh: 现有搜索监督信号受生成随机性等干扰，仅间接反映决策状态可靠性，无法精准指导搜索时机。
提出元认知框架，通过评估中间推理状态的局部结论可靠性，区分当前能否直接推进及检索证据带来的可靠性提升。
结合当前状态与搜索动作可靠性得分构建过程奖励用于GRPO训练，在七个QA基准上取得更优的准确率-效率权衡。

title: UpLoop: Training Looped Transformers via Upcycling at No Extra Pretraining Compute
title_zh: UpLoop：无额外计算开销的循环Transformer预训练
abstract: Looped language models can strengthen reasoning through repeated computation with shared weights, increasing execution depth without adding independent parameters. However, each additional pass increases training floating-point operations (FLOPs), making these gains more expensive to obtain. To address this cost, we propose UpLoop, a pretraining schedule that uses upcycling to train looped Transformers while exactly matching a standard dense baseline in final parameter count, total training tokens, and training FLOPs. Specifically, UpLoop begins with a shallow Transformer, progressively grows its depth by copying learned layers, and uses the computation saved early to support repeated execution of a shared middle block later in training. Experiments across model scales show improvements in language modeling and downstream performance, with the average score across 22 downstream tasks increasing from 22.99 to 27.52 at 1.3B parameters. These gains also extend to mathematical reasoning after supervised fine-tuning.
summary_zh: 循环语言模型通过共享权重增加计算深度以强化推理，但额外计算步骤会增加训练FLOPs开销。
提出UpLoop预训练方案，从浅层模型起步，通过复制层逐步增加深度，用前期节省的计算支持后期共享中间块的重复执行。
在参数量、训练token和FLOPs完全对齐基线时，1.3B模型下游任务平均分提升，且数学推理能力增强。

title: Evaluating Instrument-Centered AI Agents for Table-Top Science Experiments
title_zh: 桌面科学实验中仪器中心型AI智能体的评估
abstract: Reliable evaluation of AI agents for table-top science experiments has remained elusive because live instruments are hard to reset and share at scale, while instrument statefulness and safety constraints complicate evaluation. We introduce instrMCP and q-devBench, an evaluation stack for instrument-centered AI agents in table-top experiments. instrMCP connects coding agents to scientific instruments through the Model Context Protocol, serving as the instrument-access harness. q-devBench reconstructs 37 real experimental tasks from condensed-matter physics as virtual QCoDeS instruments covering quantum electronic transport, scanning probe imaging, and calibration workflows. q-devBench exposes reproducible failure modes in laboratory-agent systems while preserving realistic instrument-control workflows. Across a range of commercial coding-agent configurations, current systems already show substantial operational competence, satisfying 70-83% of measurement-related rubric criteria. The main bottleneck is scientific analysis, where performance falls to 28-46%. In an analysis-only ablation in which agents receive clean reference datasets without running the virtual measurement session, analysis performance improves substantially, closing roughly two thirds of the difference between the measurement and analysis scores. This suggests that much of the deficit arises from the measurement-session context, including tool-use overhead, longer context, measurement-planning decisions, and possible acquisition errors, while a residual scientific-reasoning gap remains. Together, instrMCP and q-devBench provide a practical sandbox for benchmarking, diagnosing, and improving laboratory AI harnesses, and establish a route from controlled virtual evaluation to future live-hardware validation.
summary_zh: 现有桌面实验AI智能体评估受限于仪器难重置与安全约束，提出instrMCP与q-devBench评估框架。
instrMCP通过MCP协议连接智能体与仪器；q-devBench重构37项凝聚态物理虚拟实验任务，暴露系统故障模式。
当前智能体测量操作达标70-83%，但科学分析仅28-46%；消融实验表明分析短板主要源于测量上下文干扰。
comment: 36 pages (26 main text + 10 supplemental material), 14 figures, 5 tables. Code: https://github.com/caidish/instrMCP and https://github.com/caidish/qdevbench

title: Nereus: A Large-Scale Underwater Dataset for Fine-Grained Attribute Understanding and Grounded Counting Perception
title_zh: Nereus：面向水下细粒度属性理解与定位计数感知的大规模数据集
abstract: Underwater imagery records rich ecological information and supports applications such as science communication, fishery monitoring, ecological conservation, and oceanographic research. Beyond general scene understanding, these applications require models to recognize fine-grained biological traits and reason over spatially grounded evidence. However, existing underwater datasets often provide coarse category labels, generic captions, or total-count supervision, which limits their use for organism-level analysis and ecological reasoning. We introduce Nereus, a large-scale dataset for Underwater Fine-grained Perception that jointly supports Fine-Grained Object Attribute Understanding and Grounded Counting Perception. Nereus contains 88K images and 2.68M question-answer pairs, including annotations for 136K marine organism objects across 2,690 species and 1,515 genera, as well as 65K point annotations and 67K grounded counting QA pairs. Experiments with representative multimodal models show that Nereus improves downstream adaptation over existing underwater-domain data and provides a foundation for future research on fine-grained marine perception.
summary_zh: 现有水下数据集多提供粗粒度标签或仅总数监督，难以支持细粒度生物属性分析与空间定位推理。
提出大规模水下数据集Nereus，包含88K图像与2.68M问答对，支持细粒度属性理解与定位计数感知。
实验表明，Nereus相比现有水下数据能更好提升多模态模型下游适应能力，为细粒度海洋感知奠定基础。
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track

title: GraphNIAH: A Benchmark for Long-Context Reasoning over Real-World Graphs
title_zh: GraphNIAH：基于真实世界图的长上下文推理基准
abstract: The needle-in-a-haystack (NIAH) benchmark was introduced as a test for measuring a model's ability to find small relevant facts within a very large body of input text. However, existing NIAH benchmarks each suffer from one or more of the following limitations: (1) reliance on synthetic data, so their evaluations may not generalize to real-world settings; (2) reuse of previously published datasets, leading to the risk of benchmark contamination; (3) dependence on manual annotation, which requires human effort to create and update data and is prone to future benchmark contamination; and (4) unrealistic simplification of long-context multi-hop reasoning where each next step is trivial given previous steps, while real-world reasoning often requires planning over multiple possible proof paths. To address these limitations, we introduce \Benchmark, a dynamic benchmark built from real citation relationships among scientific papers published after the evaluated models' knowledge cutoff date, which utilizes real-world information while ensuring no benchmark contamination. The fully automated benchmark construction pipeline samples representative subgraphs of the citation graph formed by these papers and converts each subgraph into a long-context QA example with a verifiable answer. We use GraphNIAH to evaluate eight LLMs from the GPT-5.6, Gemini-3, and Qwen3.5 families. We find that accuracy falls as questions require longer reasoning paths: at question depths of 16 and 32, the GPT-5.6 and Qwen3.5 models answer YES/NO questions no better than random guessing, mostly by answering NO; four of the eight models answer no counting example correctly, and the others model get worse as the subgraph size increases. These findings suggest that current LLMs often stop searching the citation relationships in their context before they reach the answer, even though every fact they need is in the context.
summary_zh: 现有NIAH基准存在依赖合成数据、数据污染风险及过度简化多跳推理等局限，需构建更真实的长上下文评估基准。
提出GraphNIAH基准，利用模型知识截止日期后的真实论文引用关系自动构建子图，生成无污染且可验证的长上下文QA样本。
实验表明，随着推理路径变长，GPT-5.6等模型表现接近随机猜测，说明当前LLM在长链推理中常过早停止搜索。

title: Does Reasoning Make Language Models Agree?
title_zh: 推理会让语言模型达成一致吗？
abstract: Language models face two opposing concerns: monoculture, in which models err in correlated ways, and multiplicity, in which equally accurate models make conflicting decisions. The rise of reasoning models has complicated this debate: On the one hand, reasoning may increase model agreement if models anchor on the same salient features or follow similar reasoning paths. On the other hand, stochastic reasoning traces may introduce additional branch points leading to more diverse predictions. We resolve this tension by distinguishing reasoning as an intervention from reasoning as an observed behavior. We compare agreement under controlled changes in reasoning effort with agreement across observed reasoning lengths, measuring both against the agreement expected from model accuracy. Across nine models from two developers and three classification tasks, enabling reasoning increases agreement between models evaluated on the same individuals. Yet the individuals who elicit longer reasoning traces receive less consistent predictions across models. Both patterns persist after accounting for differences in accuracy. Asking models to reason more thus promotes agreement, while observing them reason longer signals disagreement.
summary_zh: 语言模型面临错误同质化与准确但决策冲突的矛盾，推理模型因锚定相同特征或引入随机分支而使一致性影响不明。
本文将推理区分为干预手段与观测行为，通过控制推理努力程度与观测推理长度，对比模型间的一致性水平。
实验表明，启用推理会提升模型间一致性，但观测到更长推理的个体反而跨模型预测更不一致，该现象独立于准确率差异。

title: When the Past Shapes Action: Understanding Embodied Memory
title_zh: 具身记忆机制：从过去经验塑造智能体行动
abstract: Recent advances in generative foundation models have expanded the capabilities of embodied AI, enabling increasingly general navigation, manipulation, and long-horizon task execution. However, effective interaction with dynamic environments requires more than only strong perception and reasoning: agents must act with partial knowledge and retain, retrieve, and update information from past observations, actions, and experiences. This survey examines embodied memory as a mechanism for preserving decision-relevant information beyond the current observation. We organize existing approaches along two complementary dimensions: six fundamental memory requirements, spanning world-state persistence, task progress, belief maintenance, and experiential learning; and eight architectural categories, including recurrent states, fast weights, visual and symbolic representations, spatial memory, and experience-based systems. We analyze their capabilities and limitations, and examine how existing benchmarks evaluate memory-dependent behavior, distinguishing genuine use of historical information from general task performance. Finally, we identify open challenges in selecting relevant experiences, maintaining consistent beliefs in changing environments, and consolidating knowledge across episodes. Our analysis provides a framework for understanding memory as an essential component of reliable, adaptive, and lifelong-horizon embodied intelligence.
summary_zh: 具身智能在动态环境中交互时，需利用部分知识并从历史中存取信息，为此本文综述具身记忆机制。
沿六大基本记忆需求与八类架构维度组织现有方法，分析其能力与局限，并审视基准测试对记忆的评估。
指出选择相关经验与维持一致信念等开放挑战，为理解可靠、自适应的具身智能提供记忆分析框架。

title: The Ineliminable Anchor: Human Judgment as a Structural Requirement of Autonomous Artificial Intelligence Systems
title_zh: 自主AI系统中不可消除的人类判断锚点
abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) agents carry out longer chains of tasks, oversight must establish whether their behavior still serves an authorized goal. Here, we introduce the anchor: the point at which reference information and human-authorized standards enter an autonomous system. We argue that oversight design should first identify the reference needed to assess goal drift and whether the system's internal record can supply it, then decide who checks and how often, and finally specify who may revise the goal. Goal drift can be impossible to certify from a system's internal record. The missing reference must come from outside that record. Combining a reliability model of checkpoint spacing with evidence from training, execution, and multi-agent coordination, we develop a task taxonomy to guide anchor placement and decisions about which checks to automate. For AI systems that serve human purposes, human judgment is an ineliminable structural requirement in authorizing and revising the purposes and standards that govern autonomous operation, even when routine checking and execution are automated.
summary_zh: AI代理执行长任务链时易偏离授权目标，需引入包含参考信息与人类标准的锚点来实施监督。
仅靠系统内部记录无法确认目标漂移，必须引入外部参考，并依任务分类与可靠性模型指导锚点放置与自动化检查。
对于服务于人类目的的AI系统，即使常规检查与执行可自动化，人类判断仍是授权和修订目标的不可消除的结构要求。

title: Breaking Information Islands in Sparse Tuning via Small-World Connectivity
title_zh: 基于小世界连通性打破稀疏微调中的信息孤岛
abstract: Sparse tuning is widely used to adapt large language models due to its parameter efficiency. However, its effectiveness depends not only on the number of trainable parameters, but also on the feature-interaction topology of the sparse update's structural support. Limited or uneven connectivity in this support may isolate subsets of feature dimensions, forming information islands that restrict direct task-specific interactions through the trainable update. To address this issue, we propose Small-World Induced Fine-Tuning (SWIFT), a sparse tuning framework inspired by small-world connectivity. SWIFT combines block-diagonal sparse updates for local feature mixing with a fixed deterministic scattering permutation that routes the mixed outputs across feature groups without additional trainable parameters.
