Specifically, ANCHOR first estimates category-level mobility intent in a compact and stable semantic space, rather than predicting concrete POI entities directly. The inferred intent is then grounded into a candidate set by integrating three complementary sources of mobility evidence: category anchors, historical visit memory, and user preferences. Finally, a history-aware reranker selects the target POI by matching each candidate with the user's historical mobility patterns and current context. Experiments on three real-world check-in datasets show that ANCHOR consistently outperforms representative traditional, structure-enhanced, and LLM-based baselines on the reported metrics. Further analyses validate the effectiveness of semantic-to-entity grounding and show favorable trade-offs among candidate coverage, ranking quality, and inference efficiency.
summary_zh: 直接用LLM生成POI标识符不可靠，因POI稀疏且长尾，导致高层移动意图与具体POI间存在语义到实体的鸿沟。
提出ANCHOR框架，先在紧凑语义空间估计类别级意图，再结合类别锚点、历史记忆与用户偏好将其落地为候选集。
实验表明ANCHOR持续优于各类基线，验证了语义到实体落地的有效性，并在候选覆盖、排序质量与推理效率间取得良好平衡。
comment: Accepted by the 43rd IEEE International Conference on Data Engineering (ICDE 2027)

title: Compile Away Uncertainty: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Programmatic Compilation
title_zh: 通过程序化编译消除不确定性：自进化Agent技能框架
abstract: Self-evolving agent skills enable AI agents to accumulate and refine reusable procedural knowledge from interaction experience without updating model parameters. However, since such skills are typically represented as textual documents and executed through LLM reasoning, even previously learned procedures must be repeatedly interpreted and regenerated, introducing avoidable uncertainty into every execution. In contrast, program execution is deterministic and independently verifiable. Intuitively, transforming well-specified operations into executable programs can reduce reliance on LLM reasoning and, consequently, reduce execution uncertainty. Motivated by this intuition, we introduce SKillCompiler, a self-evolving skill framework that integrates programmatic compilation into the skill evolution process. Specifically, SkillCompiler adopts an executability-aware skill compilation strategy that decomposes skills into fine-grained operations, analyzes their executability, and constructs hybrid skill skeletons that retain LLM reasoning for context-dependent operations while compiling well-specified ones into validated programs. To avoid redundant program synthesis and enable executable knowledge to accumulate across evolving skills, we further design a program asset reuse mechanism that organizes validated programs as reusable assets, retrieves existing implementations whenever applicable, and synthesizes and verifies new programs only when necessary. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks and six model families demonstrate that SkillCompiler consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving up to 32.33\% improvement in task performance.
summary_zh: 现有自进化Agent技能以文本表示并依赖LLM推理执行，会反复引入不确定性。
提出SkillCompiler框架，将技能分解为细粒度操作，把定义明确的操作编译为确定性程序，上下文相关操作保留LLM推理。
设计程序资产复用机制以积累可执行知识，实验表明该方法在五项基准上最高提升32.33%性能。
设计程序资产复用机制以积累可执行知识，实验表明该方法在五项基准上最高提升32.33%性能。

title: Does Scaling Toward AGI Depend on What System-1 Lets System-2 Execute?
title_zh: 迈向AGI的扩展是否依赖System-1对System-2的执行控制？
abstract: Progress toward artificial general intelligence (AGI) has largely relied on scaling a resource-intensive executive, System-2, through larger models, more data and compute, longer reasoning, and more agents. We ask whether the next stage may come instead from co-designing it with System-1, a lightweight, semantically aware predictor that evaluates candidate interactions before execution, so that System-2 acts only on those worth their cost. Our answer is a qualified yes. We study \textit{conditional interaction}, a predict--gate--execute--update loop: System-1 estimates each candidate's utility, System-2 executes those admitted by an adaptive threshold, and the outcomes update System-1. The loop spans training, test-time reasoning, adaptive decision-making, and agentic tool use, with utility and cost defined by the application. Under ideal screening and equal execution costs, execution compute falls by a factor approaching $1/ρ_u$, where $ρ_u$ is the density of utility-relevant interactions (cost-weighted when costs differ); prediction errors, exploration, and distribution shift reduce the saving. We bound selection regret by predictor error and the utility margin. These results motivate our central hypothesis: $ρ_u$ is a measurable coordinate of scaling efficiency and makes informative compute a better description of scaling than total compute.
summary_zh: 当前AGI进展依赖高成本System-2扩展，本文提出将其与轻量级预测器System-1协同设计，以过滤低效交互。
提出条件交互循环：System-1评估候选效用，System-2仅执行通过自适应阈值的交互，并更新System-1。
理论证明计算量降幅趋近于效用相关交互密度的倒数，提出有效计算比总计算更能衡量扩展效率。

title: InterA11y: Interactive Web Accessibility Error Detection with LLM Agents
title_zh: InterA11y：基于LLM代理的交互式网页无障碍错误检测
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown potential to expand the coverage of web accessibility evaluation. However, current LLM-based checkers neglect much of the interactive and dynamic web contexts, resulting in limited coverage, high false discovery rates, and inconsistent performance across models. We present InterA11y, an agentic accessibility evaluation system that combines rubrics and interactive tools to support LLM agents in evaluating accessibility effectively. The rubrics decompose WCAG success criteria (SC) into testable aspects and guide agents in collecting and interpreting evidence. The interactive tools inspect or operate a webpage deterministically to collect evidence, such as focus appearances and error messages. We developed these rubrics and tools on 682 curated test cases grounded in established accessibility guidelines that target 10 commonly violated SC. We evaluated InterA11y on 197 expert-annotated cases sampled from 54 real webpages. Results show InterA11y achieves higher recall than the strongest evaluated LLM-driven baseline (79.0% vs. 44.4%), while maintaining comparable precision to best rule-based checkers (93.1% vs. 90.3-97.6%), with little variability between models. Further, when equipped with our interactive tools, general-purpose web agents detect more accessibility errors with fewer false positives and less token usage than without these tools.
summary_zh: 现有LLM无障碍检测器忽略动态交互上下文，导致覆盖率低、误报率高且模型表现不一。
提出InterA11y系统，结合评分规则与交互工具，引导LLM代理收集并解释网页交互证据。
该系统召回率远超LLM基线（79.0%对44.4%），精度媲美规则检测器，且降低通用代理的误报与开销。
comment: We release our code and data at https://github.com/jszh/InterA11y

title: Soei: Structured Observability of Evidence and Intent for Multi-Agent AI Software Engineering
title_zh: 多智能体AI软件工程的结构化可观测性系统Soei
abstract: AI coding agents now do long, multi-step and multi-session software work with little supervision. When a developer comes back to that work, the useful question is not what the model said but what was actually done, by whom, and whether it is finished. We study this in three parts. First, we verify Agenttrail, an open-source local observability tool for coding agents, against its source at commit e4ba2da: nine documented constants and mechanisms hold at file-and-line level, two event pipelines are never unified, and its Map service has an unauthenticated local mutation surface. Second, we run a prototype of our system on 45 real coding-agent sessions (102,233 records, 20,577 tool executions, 2,336 human-to-agent episodes). With a blind-audited classifier (precision 83.3% and 96.7%) we estimate that 23.4% (95% CI 17.1 to 35.7) of code-editing episodes end with no independent check after the last edit, and that 57.8% of to-dos the agent marked complete after editing had no proof in between. A 10-minute timing heuristic for session hand-offs recovers 6 of the 24 session pairs that content lineage links. 42% of sessions run longer than 24 hours, 48.1% of transcript bytes lie past a 2 MiB replay bound, and 1,326 records in 16 sessions contain credential-like strings. Third, we propose Soei (Structured Observability of Evidence and Intent): an acknowledgement-aware event schema, a hash-chained local ledger, a W3C PROV-aligned graph, calibrated inference for attribution and lineage, and a verification layer that keeps a claim of completion apart from proof. On the same corpus the ledger is 20% of raw size, holds no content or credentials, verifies at about 126k events/s, detects tampering and replays deterministically. We position the work against concurrent 2026 proposals and define autonomy levels with evidence gates and harness metrics baselined on our data.
summary_zh: AI编码智能体长期自主工作，开发者回归时难以确切了解实际执行情况、责任归属与完成状态。
基于45个真实会话数据审计发现，23.4%的代码编辑无独立检查，57.8%标记完成的任务缺乏证明，且存在凭证泄露与会话交接追踪困难等问题。
提出Soei系统，含确认感知事件模式、哈希链账本与对齐图等，账本仅占原大小20%且不含凭证，验证速度达126k事件/秒，可检测篡改并将完成声明与证明分离。

title: PathCowork: Learning from real-world pathology practice to build AI copilots
title_zh: PathCowork：从真实病理实践学习构建AI副驾驶
abstract: Medical AI learns from the answers doctors record, but rarely from how they interpret the evidence to reach them. Here we introduce PathCowork, a framework that turns pathologists' narrated examinations into supervision for visual grounding and procedures that guide diagnostic AI agents. Synchronized gaze, narration and navigation link visual findings to the process of interpreting them. Across 48 sessions from 16 pathologists, the platform captured 1,028 minutes of slide review. Using these data, we trained PathCowork-1T for server deployment and PathCowork-27B for local deployment, with improved visual grounding. Across five organ-specific evaluations, agents combining this grounding with recorded diagnostic procedures achieved primary task scores averaging 17.9 and 24.1 percentage points higher than Claude Code and Codex, respectively, with shorter processing times and lower inference costs. Compared to the state-of-the-art multiple-instance learning AIs, the PathCowork agent-proposed regions achieved higher prostate-grading scores with limited slide labels. PathCowork can also help construct pathology AI benchmarks where questions derived from the recordings identified difficulties in recognizing viewing context and rejecting inapplicable premises. In summary, PathCowork proposes a new paradigm to scale up the data collection and train pathology AI through transparent reasoning from diagnostic sessions, opening a path towards systems that learn directly from routine clinical practice.
summary_zh: 现有医学AI缺乏对医生推理过程的学习，本研究提出PathCowork框架，将病理医生的口述检查转化为视觉定位与诊断过程的监督信号。
基于48次病理阅片会话数据，训练出服务器与本地部署的PathCowork模型，提升了视觉定位能力，并构建了结合定位与诊断过程的AI agent。
该agent在五项器官评估中显著优于Claude Code和Codex，在前列腺分级上超越传统MIL模型，还能辅助构建病理AI基准测试。
comment: 56 pages, including supplementary information. Code, models and demonstration videos: https://github.com/zhihuanglab/PathCowork

title: ATLAS-Bench: An Agentic Tool-Use Benchmark for Local Area Search
title_zh: ATLAS-Bench：面向本地区域搜索的智能体工具使用基准
abstract: Reliable local search is essential for LLM agents to support everyday decisions and longer plans by finding places that meet users' needs at given times and locations. Yet existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of whether search results satisfy mandatory requirements, account for preferences, and ground factual and experiential judgments in place attributes and reviews. We introduce ATLAS-Bench, a benchmark of 1,200 queries across three regions, expanded from real search events using place attributes, reviews, and existing user profiles from the platform. Each query distinguishes mandatory requirements from preferences and factual conditions from subjective judgments, with supporting evidence and criteria for checking each requirement. Queries are validated through iterative assertion checks and cross-model review. We also introduce ATLASBox, a standardized evaluation environment with search tools and a fixed point-of-interest (POI) knowledge base. Given a query, timestamp, and location, an agent searches place attributes and reviews to recommend evidence-supported options or report that no place meets all mandatory requirements. We evaluate answer quality, trajectory quality, and execution cost. Across 14 configurations of 11 models, GPT-6-Luna achieves the highest constraint satisfaction rate among returned recommendations (71.5%) and factual accuracy (95.6%). However, it returns at least one acceptable recommendation for fewer satisfiable queries than GLM-5.3 (67.3% versus 85.3%). These results highlight the challenge of satisfying individual requirements while providing usable recommendations across queries.
summary_zh: 现有本地搜索基准缺乏对强制要求、偏好及事实与主观判断的覆盖，无法全面评估搜索结果满意度。
提出ATLAS-Bench基准与ATLASBox评估环境，基于真实搜索事件构建1200个查询，区分强制与偏好条件并提供验证证据。
对11个模型评估发现，GPT-6-Luna约束满足率最高，但GLM-5.3可用推荐覆盖率更广，凸显平衡个体约束与整体可用性的挑战。

title: Verifiable LLM-Guided Focal SMT Solving for Quantified Arrays
title_zh: 可验证的LLM引导聚焦SMT求解量化数组
abstract: Large language models can often identify useful semantic structure in formal artifacts, but their outputs cannot be trusted as proofs or solver decisions. We study whether LLMs can instead guide formal reasoning systems through a narrow, solver-verifiable interface. We instantiate this idea in quantified array SMT solving, where modern instantiation-based techniques can fail when key ground terms and equalities are hidden by auxiliary variables, axiom guards, and nested array terms. We observe that many instances are largely driven by a small set of focal ground terms or constraints, similar to the backdoor sets in SAT solving. Building on this, we present LinguaArray, a framework where an LLM proposes a small Semantic Focus Set (ground terms/constraints), while a conventional SMT solver remains the sole proof engine and certifies all results. LinguaArray uses these LLM-suggested, solver-validated finite sets to significantly enhance solver capability, solving additional satisfiable and unsatisfiable instances that the backend alone fails to solve. It interacts within a finite time and then falls back to the backend solver to mitigate potential regressions. Evaluation on 1015 SMT-LIB instances across five logics under 1200s timeout (including LLM latency) shows that LinguaArray solves up to 69.1% of instances and increases solved-instance counts by 105%--397% over the corresponding backends.
summary_zh: 量化数组SMT求解常因关键项被变量隐藏而失败，需寻找核心驱动项以提升求解效率。
提出LinguaArray框架，由LLM提议语义焦点集，SMT求解器验证并认证所有结果。
该框架显著增强求解能力，较原后端求解器增加105%--397%的求解实例数。

title: ARBITRA: Robust Document-Level ATT&CK Extraction via Multi-Expert Argumentation
title_zh: ARBITRA：基于多专家论证的鲁棒文档级ATT&CK提取
abstract: Cyber threat intelligence (CTI) reports describe adversary behavior in natural language, but converting them into structured MITRE ATT&CK mappings remains difficult: existing methods decompose reports to sentence-level granularity for extraction, while modern LLMs can work with full reports in a single pass but with noticeable performance degradation. We present ARBITRA, which orchestrates multiple role-specialized LLM experts that propose candidate ATT&CK entities from the full report, which are then verified through a per-candidate quantitative bipolar argumentation framework (QBAF) grounded in document evidence and rationales. We additionally construct reasoning-specialized corpora for fine-tuning so experts can act as effective participants during this verification process. Across ATT&CK extraction benchmarks, ARBITRA reaches a stronger precision-oriented operating point than sentence-level pipelines, recent LLM-based extraction systems, and frontier models including GPT-5.5. Under adversarial perturbations simulating conflicting TTP statements, cross-report contamination, and semantic poisoning, ARBITRA limits mean precision degradation to roughly half that of frontier-model baselines for a more robust extraction.
summary_zh: 现有ATT&CK提取方法受限于句子级粒度，而LLM直接处理全文会导致性能下降。
提出ARBITRA框架，调度多个角色专精的LLM专家提取候选实体，并用量化双极论证框架（QBAF）进行验证。
实验表明，ARBITRA精度优于现有方法及GPT-5.5等前沿模型，且在对抗扰动下精度下降约为基线一半，鲁棒性更强。
comment: 13 pages of main paper, 21 pages total, preprint

title: Diagnosing the Reference Gap: What Visual Scaffolds Can and Cannot Fix in Multimodal Reasoning
title_zh: 诊断参考间隙：视觉支架在多模态推理中的能与不能
abstract: Multimodal large language models can recognize visual content yet struggle to reason reliably over it across multiple steps. In counting, a model may see all objects but lose track of which ones it has counted. We argue that such failures, commonly attributed to perception, reveal a reference gap: the failure to bind language to the relevant visual entities, regions, or locations. Motivated by the theory of visual routines, we test whether external references such as numbering can narrow this gap. We introduce ReGap-Bench, a paired benchmark of five visual reasoning tasks in which the scene, question, and answer are fixed and only the reference varies. Results show that task-matched references improve accuracy by up to 25\%, while mismatched references provide little benefit or even hurt performance. These findings identify the reference gap as a bottleneck distinct from visual perception and show that constructing task-appropriate visual references can serve as a training-free visual skill for improving multimodal reasoning.
summary_zh: 多模态LLM在多步视觉推理中易出错，如计数时丢失跟踪，此问题源于语言未绑定视觉实体的参考间隙。
基于视觉例程理论，引入ReGap-Bench基准，通过仅改变外部参考（如编号）测试其对推理的影响。
匹配的参考可提升25%准确率，错配则无效甚至有害，表明构建合适参考是无需训练的推理提升技能。

title: Well-Specified and Well-Tested? Assessing SWE-bench-Style Datasets with a Self-Evolving Agent
title_zh: 基于自演化Agent的SWE-bench数据集质量评估
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on software engineering (SE) tasks, driving the need for high-quality datasets for reliable training and evaluation. SWE-bench-style datasets (SWE datasets) are widely used to evaluate LLM-based coding agents on real-world software issues, where task clarity and test coverage directly affect whether instances are solvable and verifiable. However, quality issues persist in existing SWE datasets, and manual annotation is costly and labor-intensive, motivating LLM-based annotation. Existing approaches typically rely on static, overly general rubrics, limiting their ability to handle diverse and nuanced scenarios and often yielding high false positive rates. In contrast, human annotators draw on accumulated experience to make context-aware judgments. Inspired by this, we propose ExLabel, an LLM-based, self-evolving, experience-guided assistant for task clarity and test coverage assessment in SWE datasets. ExLabel maintains an evolving experience bank that distills cross-instance knowledge into stable yet adaptive judgment criteria and reuses relevant experience to guide the assessment of new instances. For systematic evaluation, we construct SWE-TQ, a new benchmark spanning eight programming languages, by cleaning human annotations from SWE-bench and Multi-SWE-bench. Experiments with three backbone LLMs show that ExLabel achieves the best F1 across all settings, with relative improvements of 44.2%/49.9% and 24.0%/18.4% over the best baseline for task clarity and test coverage assessment on the Python/Multilingual subsets, respectively. Moreover, a coding model fine-tuned on SWE-rebench data filtered by ExLabel resolves 66.2% of issues on SWE-bench Verified, outperforming the model trained on data filtered by the best baseline by 14.5%.
summary_zh: 现有SWE数据集存在质量问题且人工标注成本高，静态规则标注假阳性率高，需更优的自动评估方法。
提出ExLabel，一种基于LLM的自演化经验引导标注助手，通过经验库积累并复用跨实例知识来指导评估。
构建新基准SWE-TQ，实验表明ExLabel在F1上显著优于基线；用其过滤数据微调的模型在SWE-bench Verified上解决率达66.2%。

title: How Specific Do I Need to Be? Effects of User Query Underspecification on Deep Research Agents
title_zh: 用户查询欠定对深度研究智能体的影响
abstract: Deep research agents (DRAs) conduct long-horizon reasoning, search, and literature synthesis to provide long-form answers to complex, domain-specific questions. These agents are typically trained and evaluated on fully specified user queries. However, real-world user queries can often be underspecified. We introduce UNDERSPEC-DR, a framework for systematically evaluating how underspecified queries affect agents' final answer quality and intermediate search behavior. Across three DRAs we evaluated, underspecification substantially reduces how well DRA's answers fulfill users' information needs, even though they remain grounded in cited evidence. Our analysis of intermediate search behavior suggests a possible explanation: DRAs conduct broader searches that draw less on the original user query but rely more on their learned prior during training, which can be misaligned with users' intent. Our findings reveal the vulnerability of current DRAs to underspecified user queries and inform future efforts to build DRAs that proactively recognize when additional user input is needed to reliably complete deep research tasks.
summary_zh: 现有深度研究智能体（DRA）多在完全明确的查询上评估，但真实查询常欠定，需评估此影响。
提出UNDERSPEC-DR框架，系统评估查询欠定对DRA最终答案质量及中间搜索行为的影响。
发现欠定查询使DRA答案难以满足用户需求，因其搜索更广且依赖训练先验；揭示了DRA的脆弱性。

title: OPERA: OPamp Design by an Expert-Taught Reasoning Agent, from Specifications to Layout
title_zh: OPERA：基于专家教导推理Agent的运放设计
abstract: Analog flows from specifications to a signed-off layout rarely run without manual iteration. Recent large language model (LLM) agents size circuits with optimizer loops over the device dimensions and stop at the schematic. We present OPERA (OPamp design by an Expert-taught Reasoning Agent), in which a general-purpose LLM agent designs CMOS opamps from specifications to post-layout sign-off with open-source tools. First, the designer teaches the agent the gm/ID method: map the specifications to transconductances and minimum currents, choose gm/ID per device role from characterized lookup tables, and size from equations, leaving a few knobs to search and an explainable design. Second, the agent learns the gLayout framework and taught layout practice, and writes a reusable layout generator that closes the layout and extraction loop at designer-approved gates. In SKY130, the agent designed a shared constant-gm bias and six opamps (5T, folded-cascode and telescopic OTAs; Miller, folded-cascode and telescopic two-stage) for fun >= 50 MHz, PM >= 60 degrees, SR 25 V/μs into 1 pF and a minimum dc gain of 30 to 60 dB. All six layouts are DRC-clean and LVS-matched, and their extracted netlists meet every target at all 15 PVT corners ( fun >= 53.7 MHz, PM >= 62.1 degrees, SR >= 27.9 V/μs). The benchmark netlists are released at https://github.com/AMPICLab/AMPICBench.
summary_zh: 模拟电路从规格到版图常需人工迭代，现有LLM agent仅优化器件尺寸且止于原理图。
提出OPERA，让通用LLM agent学习专家的gm/ID方法与gLayout框架，自动生成可复用版图并闭合提取环路。
在SKY130中设计6款运放，版图均无DRC错误且LVS匹配，提取网表在15个PVT角下均满足所有目标。

title: Conditional Information Flow and Neural Representability of One-Dimensional Rotated Cluster States
title_zh: 一维旋转簇态的条件信息流与神经表示性
abstract: I study how measurement outcomes can remain conditionally dependent over long distances while the underlying state carries only a small internal memory, using one-dimensional rotated cluster states, whose exact matrix product state (MPS) bond dimension is $D=2$ at every rotation angle. Using exact MPS contraction, I compute the conditional mutual information (CMI) of two readout protocols: the entanglement-swapping endpoint CMI decreases from one bit at $θ=0$ to zero at $θ=π/2$, whereas a stationary bulk readout of the locally equivalent conventional cluster state vanishes at both limits. As an exact control, the spin-1 AKLT chain obeys $I_m=(4/9)\,3^{-m}$, so its CMI length equals its two-point correlation length, for an identifiable but non-generic reason. I then compare learners on the same $N=64$, $θ=0.35$ target. A positive autoregressive GRU learns the computational-basis Born distribution from a few thousand samples, but an exactly computable Bell-basis readout shows that this distribution does not fix the phases. A complex RBM reaches the $N=8$ ground state under an exact objective, while a short generic recurrent variational Monte Carlo pilot is still improving when its runs end. As a positive control, an MPS-induced recurrent model whose hidden state is the bond vector reaches the ground state to near machine precision at $χ=2$, whereas a $χ=1$ control fails. These results show that long CMI does not require a large bond dimension, and that building the small virtual memory into the architecture greatly eases optimization.
summary_zh: 【问题→方法→结论】研究长程条件依赖与小内部记忆共存机制，利用一维旋转簇态精确MPS计算，发现长条件互信息无需大键维度。
【问题→方法→结论】对比不同神经网络学习同一量子态分布，正自回归GRU能学Born分布但无法固定相位，复杂RBM可求小系统基态。
【问题→方法→结论】探究虚拟记忆对模型优化的影响，将MPS键向量作隐藏状态引入循环模型，证实构建小虚拟记忆可极大简化优化。
comment: M.Sc. research paper, University of Waterloo (2026). 37 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables

title: AgentDecept: Benchmarking Deceptive Behavior in Tool-Using LLM Agents under Pressure
title_zh: 压力下工具使用LLM Agent的欺骗行为基准测试
abstract: LLM agents increasingly carry out multi-turn tasks across everyday applications, yet users often see only the agent's report rather than the observations, API calls, and state changes behind it. Existing deception benchmarks have studied long-horizon interactions and tool-use settings, but whether agents faithfully report their actions across realistic, stateful application workflows remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce AgentDecept, an executable benchmark for evaluating behavioral deception under pressure. AgentDecept contains 477 pressure variants derived from 257 source tasks across six pressure sources, each paired with a pressure-free counterpart. Interventions enter through event messages, task context, application state, tool responses, and service quotas, spanning explicit events and implicit task or environment changes. Our evidence-grounded protocol evaluates full trajectories by relating user-facing claims to time-ordered observations and executed outcomes, distinguishing falsification, concealment, and equivocation from honest failure and disclosed limitations. The resulting behavioral labels also provide a setting for testing existing activation-based probes. AgentDecept enables controlled analysis of when multi-turn agents' reports diverge from execution in realistic application interactions.
summary_zh: 现有欺骗基准未充分探究LLM Agent在真实应用工作流中是否如实报告其行为，为此提出AgentDecept基准。
该基准包含477个压力变体，干预通过事件消息、应用状态和工具响应等显式或隐式方式引入。
提出证据溯源协议评估轨迹，区分伪造、隐瞒与诚实失败，实现Agent报告与执行偏离的受控分析。

title: What is Work For? Labor, Politics, and Meaning in the Age of AI
title_zh: AI时代的工作意义：劳动、政治与价值
abstract: This paper investigates the role of work in providing meaning, purpose, community, and other non-monetary benefits. Using an original cross-national survey of 8,234 working-age adults across the UK, US, Denmark, and India, I study the factors that motivate people in their work, with an eye toward the future AI economic transformation. I find that 81% of respondents report being satisfied with their job, and a majority across all four countries are strongly motivated by the non-monetary components of their employment. Using an original "Work Values" Index, I show that one third of working respondents are motivated intrinsically by their job--valuing their role for its own sake. Nearly one quarter are driven by social and community-related aspects of their employment, 17% by social status, and just over one quarter by the transactional financial benefits of their job. Although a majority of people would leave their role if offered their current salary as a guaranteed income, one fifth of workers would stay even if offered up to 120% of their salary. Intrinsically motivated workers were disproportionately likely to refuse a basic income at any substitution level. Groups attached to their job for non-monetary reasons were also more likely to pursue volunteering or work-like activities if they received guaranteed income substitution but could no longer perform their role. Crucially, these non-monetary work motivations are evenly distributed across the income distribution and between white- and blue-collar workers. I argue that these findings have implications for managing the AI transition, understanding attitudes to AI, and making sense of policy preferences. Guaranteeing a basic income may indeed be necessary for managing any future AI labor shock, yet it could ultimately fail to compensate workers for any loss of the non-monetary benefits they derive from work.
summary_zh: 探究AI经济转型下工作的非货币收益，基于四国8234名成人调查，发现多数人受工作内在价值等非货币因素驱动。
构建“工作价值”指数量化动机分布，揭示三分之一受内在动机驱动，且该动机在收入与蓝白领间均匀分布。
分析基本收入替代下工作保留意愿，发现内在驱动者更拒收基本收入，为AI劳动力冲击与政策制定提供启示。

title: Cord: Confidence-Anchored Order Residual Decoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models
title_zh: 面向掩码扩散语言模型的置信度锚定残差解码方法
abstract: The decoding order of masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) can substantially affect generation quality, yet common decoders typically apply the same reveal rule throughout generation. Confidence provides a strong default, but it measures how decisively a position can be predicted now, not how useful revealing that position will be for subsequent decoding. We propose Cord, a lightweight prompt-conditioned policy that retains confidence decoding as a stable reference and learns when and how to depart from it through geometric residuals over generation direction, proximity to revealed context, and two-sided infilling. The residuals adapt to both the prompt and the evolving partial response. Rather than sampling a new policy action at every decoding step, Cord samples a single low-dimensional coefficient matrix per rollout, which induces an entire state-dependent reveal trajectory. This yields a contextual-bandit formulation trained directly from sequence-level rewards, without step-level credit assignment or backbone updates. Across three dLLMs and five reasoning, code, and constraint-satisfaction benchmarks, Cord improves average task success from 32.0% under confidence decoding to 48.2%, and further improves over the best per-domain fixed residual. Behavioral audits show that the learned residuals induce substantial, task-dependent changes in reveal locality and two-sided infilling. Cord adds only $0.53$M trainable parameters, requires no additional backbone forward passes, and incurs only 5.39% inference latency overhead.
summary_zh: 掩码扩散语言模型的解码顺序影响生成质量，现有置信度解码未考虑揭示位置对后续解码的效用，提出轻量级策略Cord解决此问题。
Cord以置信度解码为锚点，通过几何残差动态偏离，每次 rollout 采样单一系数矩阵生成完整轨迹，基于序列级奖励训练。
实验表明Cord将平均任务成功率从32.0%提升至48.2%，仅增0.53M参数和5.39%推理延迟，且无需修改主干网络。

title: Try Before You Evolve: Ranking-Scored Trials for Recursive Self-Improvement of Recommender Systems
title_zh: 先试后演进：基于排序评分试验的推荐系统递归自改进
abstract: Recommenders on Web platforms such as e-commerce and music streaming need their training recipes re-tuned for each dataset. Large language model (LLM) agents can now rewrite these recipes, enabling recursive self-improvement (RSI) of recommender systems. Existing agents propose one edit per round, fully retrain the recommender, and keep the edit only if its ranking quality improves. Unlike programs or patches that can be scored by execution, a recommender edit changes how the model is trained, which raises two challenges. First, ranking feedback is delayed: an edit's ranking quality is known only after full retraining, so much of the retraining budget goes to edits that are later discarded. Second, the signals available before retraining are unreliable: sampled training losses can look solved while full-ranking performance remains poor, and they are not comparable across edits that change the loss or sampler. We propose RecRSI, which generates diverse candidate edits from a diagnosis of the current model and selects one for full retraining using early ranking feedback: each candidate receives a short trial, the first steps of its full training run, scored by full-ranking NDCG@10 on held-out probe users. With two sequential recommenders on three datasets and the same number of full retrainings, RecRSI significantly outperforms existing self-evolving agents in every setting, and on both Amazon datasets reaches in its first round a ranking quality that none of them reaches in five.
summary_zh: 现有LLM agent递归改进推荐系统时，因排序反馈延迟和重训练前信号不可靠，导致大量算力浪费在无效编辑上。
提出RecRSI方法，先诊断当前模型生成多样候选编辑，再利用早期排序反馈对候选进行短试验打分，选出最优编辑进行完整重训练。
在同等完整重训练次数下，RecRSI显著优于现有自演进agent，且在Amazon数据集上首轮即达到其他方法五轮的排序质量。

title: RetroChessBench: A Benchmark for Reconstructing and Proving Chess Histories
title_zh: RetroChessBench：重建与证明国际象棋历史的基准
abstract: Frontier language models such as GPT 6 Astra have contributed to research mathematics, demonstrating substantial reasoning capabilities. Yet serious reasoning failures persist even in tasks governed by explicit rules. We demonstrate this in retrograde chess which is a playground for pure reasoning, where solvers reconstruct legal histories and distinguish possible events from forced ones. We introduce RetroChessBench, a 12-task benchmark covering exact-length constructions, unique endings, and exhaustive answer sets, with references, rubrics, and a terminal-reward environment. In two trials per task and condition, GPT 6 Astra High fails to produce the required final answer in 22/24 attempts without tools and 18/24 with code execution; mean terminal RL rewards are 14.75% and 27.19%, respectively. The examples identify faulty deductions: failed responses reject legal histories and treat temporary obstructions as permanent. Online retrograde archives often provide puzzles and final move sequences without detailed derivations. We hypothesize that limited exposure to these missing explanations in web-derived training data contributes to the observed reasoning failures. This questions how far frontier mathematical reasoning really generalizes beyond familiar solution patterns. Claims of general intelligence require evidence that models can transfer learnt principles to areas with few worked examples.
summary_zh: 前沿LLM在数学推理上表现优异，但在受明确规则约束的任务中仍存在严重推理失败。
提出RetroChessBench基准，包含12项逆推国际象棋任务，用于评估模型重建合法历史与区分可能事件的能力。
GPT 6 Astra在基准上成功率极低，常将临时阻碍视为永久；推测因训练数据缺乏详细推导导致泛化不足。
comment: 22 pages, 2 figures. Benchmark and RL environment: https://app.poindexterlabs.net/docs/retro-chess

title: MRC-MMAgent: Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Role Collaboration in Multimodal Tool-Using Agents
title_zh: 多角色协作多模态工具使用Agent的强化学习
abstract: Multimodal tool-using agents augment vision-language models with access to external information and capabilities, enabling them to solve knowledge-intensive and visually complex tasks that cannot be addressed using visual context alone. However, existing reinforcement learning pipelines largely train single-role agents to search and answer using terminal rewards, overlooking how humans inspect retrieved evidence, reformulate queries, and revise conclusions during search. Consequently, they fail to optimize this self-corrective process over complete interaction trajectories. We propose MRC-MMAgent, a multi-role collaborative reinforcement learning framework that incorporates trajectory assessment and continuation directly into the executable agent loop. First, the framework establishes a multi-role collaborative loop that integrates solving, inspection, and continuation, enabling the agent to acquire evidence through tools, evaluate the preceding trajectory, and resume problem solving when the current answer is insufficiently supported. Second, we introduce a role-coupled learning objective that combines task success, interaction validity, and successful correction with full-trajectory policy optimization across the decisions generated by all roles. Extensive experiments show that, using only the original baseline training set without constructing additional datasets, our method consistently outperforms the corresponding base models and achieves leading or highly competitive performance across benchmarks.
summary_zh: 现有单角色RL训练仅用终端奖励，未优化人类检索时检查、改写与自纠错的完整交互轨迹。
提出MRC-MMAgent框架，将求解、检查与继续的多角色协作循环直接嵌入Agent执行环路中。
设计角色耦合学习目标，结合任务成功、交互有效与成功纠错进行全轨迹策略优化，在多个基准上取得领先性能。

title: There Is No Free Lunch in RLVR: Every pass@1 Gain Has a pass@k Price
title_zh: RLVR无免费午餐：pass@1的提升必有pass@k的代价
abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) makes a language model solve more problems on the first try and fewer when given many tries: it raises pass@1 while the base model overtakes it at large sampling budget k. Is this a failure of RL to add reasoning, or a transient that more training removes? We settle the question with a theorem. The reversal is a price, and we compute its exact rate. Modeling RLVR as an exponential tilt of a base policy over strategies shared across prompts, we prove that under exclusive specialization every update that raises pass@1 strictly lowers the success of some prompt; a strictly positive price on prompts (Stiemke duality) is the exact condition, and being merely the best strategy on a prompt is provably not enough. When the loss reaches the hardest prompts, it forces a pass@k crossover, and the number of crossings is at most the sign variation of the shift in per-prompt success, a totally positive bound that is tight and that recovers the known single-crossover result as its order-preserving case. The crossover is not a bug to patch: a constrained update traces the exact pass@1 versus pass@k frontier, and removing the crossover entirely costs the entire pass@1 gain. The same tilt identity yields entropy collapse and the entropy-performance law with an identifiable exponent, unifying two literatures under one mechanism. Reinforcement cannot widen the reasoning frontier; it can only move along it, at a price we make measurable by a diagnostic that reads the bound, the order-preserving test, and the price from any evaluation log. There is no free lunch, only a price.
summary_zh: 【问题】RLVR提升pass@1却降低大采样预算下的pass@k，需探究此反转是缺陷还是必然代价。【方法】将RLVR建模为策略的指数倾斜并引入排他性特化假设进行理论证明。【结论】证明每次提升pass@1必降低部分提示的成功率，反转是必然代价而非可修复缺陷。
【问题】需确定pass@1与pass@k交叉反转的精确界限与条件。【方法】利用Stiemke对偶性分析逐提示成功率偏移的符号变差。【结论】交叉次数受符号变差的全正界严格限制，且完全消除交叉将丧失所有pass@1增益。
【问题】需揭示强化学习对推理能力边界及熵的影响机制。【方法】基于指数倾斜恒等式推导熵坍缩与性能定律。【结论】强化学习无法拓宽推理边界，只能沿边界移动；统一了熵与性能两大文献，并提供可测量的代价诊断方法。
comment: 19 pages, 4 figures. Code and verification package (34/34 automated checks): https://github.com/yliusci/no-free-lunch-rlvr

title: Federated Recommender Agents
title_zh: 联邦推荐智能体
abstract: LLM-powered recommender agents use reasoning and memory for personalization, but centralized access to user information raises privacy concerns, while isolated agents cannot learn from others' experiences. We formulate Federated Recommender Agents, a setting where local agents collaborate through natural-language knowledge while keeping interaction histories and personal memories local. We propose FedRecAgent, which enables this collaboration without updating LLM parameters. Its central challenge is determining which reasoning to integrate, since similar behavioral contexts can lead to different choices. FedRecAgent represents local experiences as Condition-Transition-Reasoning (C-T-R) units and hierarchically integrates reasoning by condition and transition. Within this structure, it consolidates related explanations and discriminates reasoning across alternative transitions. Each client maintains semantic and decision memories to capture preferences and conditional choice tendencies, guiding the retrieval and selection of shared reasoning for recommendation. Experiments across three domains under dense and sparse settings demonstrate improved recommendation performance over federated and LLM-based baselines, while ablations support the contributions of personalized memories and structured reasoning integration.
summary_zh: 集中式LLM推荐智能体存在隐私风险，而孤立智能体无法共享经验，故提出联邦推荐智能体设定，通过自然语言知识协作且保留本地记忆。
提出FedRecAgent，将本地经验表示为C-T-R单元，按条件与转移层次化整合推理，合并相关解释并区分不同替代转移的推理。
各客户端维护语义与决策记忆以引导共享推理的检索与选择，实验表明该方法在多领域下优于联邦及LLM基线，且无需更新LLM参数。

title: OpenFlyV2: An onboard vision-language-action model for aerial perception and navigation
title_zh: OpenFlyV2：面向空中感知与导航的机载视觉-语言-动作模型
abstract: Human cognition flexibly draws on a shared perceptual foundation to understand environments, attend to referenced entities, reason about spatial relationships, and act. Endowing aerial robots with an analogous functional organization remains challenging, as existing systems are often specialized for individual capabilities, dependent on offboard computation, or unable to sustain closed-loop operation on resource-constrained platforms. We present OpenFlyV2, a unified onboard vision-language-action architecture that uses a shared vision-language representation to support semantic understanding, language-grounded perception, spatial reasoning, and continuous aerial control within a single model. A compact action expert converts the shared multimodal context into short-horizon flight waypoints, while motion-aware temporal memory and action priors reduce the computational cost of closed-loop execution. We construct \dataset{}, a simulation-based dataset comprising approximately 70,000 navigation trajectories and 60,000 vision-language instruction--response pairs. OpenFlyV2 generates action chunks, each comprising 12 waypoints, entirely onboard at 10 Hz using an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. It transfers zero-shot from simulation to physical quadrotor flight, achieving a 48\% navigation success rate across four real-world environments without real-world aerial training data. Extensive results demonstrate that broad vision-language competence and continuous closed-loop flight can coexist within a single model on a resource-constrained aerial platform. Code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/Ideal-ljl/AeroBrain.
summary_zh: 现有空中机器人系统多专精单项能力且依赖外部计算，难以在资源受限平台维持闭环操作。
提出OpenFlyV2，用共享视觉-语言表征统一语义理解与空间推理，并通过紧凑动作专家与时间记忆降低计算开销。
模型在Jetson Orin NX上实现10Hz全机载闭环飞行，零样本迁移至真实四旋翼取得48%导航成功率。

title: What Does "Now" Mean to Your Computer-Use Agent? Stale Screenshots, Page Loads, and Which Check to Run Before a Click
title_zh: 计算机使用代理的“现在”含义：页面加载与点击前检查
abstract: Computer-use agents plan on a screenshot for several seconds and then click at a position on the screen; if the page has changed in the meantime, the click lands on an unintended element. Prior work treats the planning interval as the source of this risk. Measuring planned clicks on 31 public web pages, we find that the risk lies in page loading: 0.4% of clicks planned on fully loaded pages became stale within 30 seconds, against 17% of clicks planned in the first second after a page opened. On these pages, waiting about one second for network activity to stop removes most of this risk, yet the wait rules of eight of ten widely used open-source agents leave more than 1% of clicks stale. Commercial pages keep loading for longer: in the HTTP Archive's public crawl, 15% of 65 desktop booking and buying home pages went 500 ms without network requests within 3 seconds of their HTML being parsed, against 63% of 3,028 .gov pages, and 52% shifted their layout within 6.5 seconds of a network-idle wait capped at 3 seconds, against 8% (61% against 26% among pages recorded in full). Where a check before the click is needed, as before irreversible actions and on pages that are still loading, a pixel comparison verifies the target's position as accurately as a frontier vision-language model at one eighth of the latency, and a 4B model matches the frontier model in verifying whether the previous action succeeded. We release a benchmark generator, a break-even formula for when a check pays, and three rules for agent developers: https://github.com/multimodal-ai-engineering/preflight-bench
summary_zh: 代理因页面加载导致截图过时而误击，而非规划延迟；等待约1秒网络空闲可消除大部分风险，但多数开源代理的等待规则不足。
商业网页加载时间远长于.gov网页，在3秒网络空闲等待后仍有超半数发生布局偏移，增加了代理误操作的风险。
点击前需检查时，像素对比能以1/8延迟媲美前沿VLM的定位精度；4B模型可匹配前沿模型验证动作成功与否。
发布基准生成器、检查成本盈亏公式及三条代理开发规则。
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Code, benchmark generator and preregistrations: https://github.com/multimodal-ai-engineering/preflight-bench

title: WorldFlow: Joint Video and 3D Motion Prediction via Large-Scale Pretraining
title_zh: WorldFlow：基于大规模预训练的联合视频与3D运动预测
abstract: Predicting future physical states stands as a central challenge in embodied intelligence. Existing video world models leave 3D dynamics implicit, action-based formulations remain tied to specific robot configurations, and 3D motion prediction models use flow-only supervision, providing a limited learning signal for physical dynamics. To circumvent these limitations, we introduce \method{}, a generative world model that jointly predicts future video and query-based 3D trajectories. By parameterizing 3D motion as continuous displacement tokens aligned with the video grid, a unified Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) backbone jointly denoises both modalities under a rectified-flow objective. This formulation couples explicit geometric dynamics with visual evolution, effectively unlocking the physical commonsense embedded within pretrained video models. To empirically scale and validate this unified architecture, we train \method{} on a heterogeneous mixture of 1.44 million object-level samples spanning simulated and real-world domains. We further introduce WorldFlowBench, comprising 1,678 evaluation samples from 11 data sources across simulated and real-world interactions, including spatial reasoning tasks. Across all three evaluation sets, WorldFlow achieves the lowest average displacement error (ADE) and final displacement error (FDE) among the evaluated learning-based methods. Notably, on the challenging SpatialCog set, WorldFlow achieves an ADE of 0.060 m, a 54.2\% reduction compared with the strongest external baseline. It also reduces ADE and FDE by 55.9\% and 68.5\%, respectively, compared with its flow-only variant. Project page: https://worldflow-rbs.github.io/.
summary_zh: 现有视频世界模型隐式处理3D动态且受限于特定配置，仅用光流监督信号不足，需显式建模物理动态。
提出WorldFlow，用混合Transformer主干联合去噪视频与基于查询的3D轨迹，将3D运动参数化为与视频网格对齐的连续位移token。
在144万样本上预训练并在WorldFlowBench评估，ADE和FDE均达最优，空间推理集ADE降低54.2%，证实联合建模优势。

title: MemSteer: Turning User Histories into Supervision for Agent Memory Optimization
title_zh: MemSteer：将用户历史转化为Agent记忆优化的监督信号
abstract: An effective agent memory system should adapt to a user's history and task requirements. Human-annotated supervision can guide this adaptation by providing feedback for evaluating and improving memory designs. Yet suitable labels are rarely available for new user histories, and manually constructing QA pairs and supporting evidence is costly. We introduce MemSteer, which turns unlabeled user histories into question-answer (QA) supervision with supporting evidence for memory-design optimization. MemSteer constructs an evidence-grounded answer plan that specifies how facts across related records jointly support a reference answer. The plan guides question generation, while source-grounded auditing and blind answer recovery check the resulting annotations. To study the utility of this supervision, we develop MemSteer-Opt, which combines QA-based design evaluation with evidence-guided failure diagnosis to revise memory store, retrieval, and context construction without updating model parameters. Experiments on ATM-Bench and RHELM show that this supervision is competitive with official-QA-guided optimization. Relative to Base-BM25, MemSteer-Opt improves ATM-Bench Question Score by 13.4 points and RHELM accuracy by 4.1 and 6.6 points without and with external data, respectively. The supervision also benefits two existing optimizers on ATM-Bench, while new-user experiments demonstrate continued design optimization using supervision generated from the target histories.
summary_zh: 针对Agent记忆系统缺乏新用户历史标注且人工构建QA成本高的问题，提出MemSteer将无标签历史转化为带证据的QA监督。
MemSteer构建证据支撑的答案计划以引导问题生成，并通过源码审计和盲答恢复校验标注质量。
基于此监督开发MemSteer-Opt，无需更新模型参数即可诊断并修正记忆模块，在ATM-Bench和RHELM上显著提升性能。

title: SocialArena: Evaluating Social Intelligence in Large Language Models
title_zh: SocialArena：评估大语言模型的社会智能
abstract: We introduce SocialArena, a benchmark for systematically defining and evaluating the social intelligence of large language models (LLMs). Although LLMs are increasingly deployed in socially interactive applications such as mental health counseling, companionship chatbots, and educational tutoring, existing evaluations remain fragmented focusing on isolated capabilities or single scenarios and evaluation reliability is largely unverified. This work makes three main contributions to address these limitations. (1) We first propose a unified three-tier framework that defines social intelligence along three capability dimensions: role-playing ability, mental state reasoning, and behavioral reasoning. To operationalize this definition, we design a role-playing dialogue paradigm with explicit character thinking for evaluation, enabling simultaneous assessment of these capabilities in a manner that mirrors realistic human interactions. (2) To ensure diversity across social scenarios and thereby prevent evaluation conclusions from being confined to specific scenarios, we introduce the U-TRIMF framework, which guides us in synthesizing social contexts with broad coverage. (3) To obtain reliable evaluation, we invest $132.4K to recruit and train human annotators and adopt a human-annotated arena-style protocol, where annotators compare model responses and provide preference labels along with natural-language critiques. We hope that SocialArena can provide valuable insights and guidance for future LLM improvements.
summary_zh: 现有LLM社会智能评估碎片化且可靠性未验证，提出SocialArena基准以系统定义并评估该能力。
提出三层统一框架定义社会智能，并设计含显式角色思考的角色扮演对话范式以同步评估。
引入U-TRIMF框架合成多样化社交场景，并采用人工标注的竞技场协议确保评估可靠性。

title: Grounding Multimodal Reasoning with Evidence-Ablated Negatives
title_zh: 基于证据消融负样本的多模态推理基础对齐
abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a powerful tool for improving multimodal reasoning. However, standard outcome supervision suffers from credit assignment ambiguity, as a model may receive positive rewards by exploiting language priors or dataset shortcuts rather than grounding its reasoning in the requisite visual evidence. This makes high-quality negative responses critical, since effective negatives should remain plausible under the current policy while exposing the shortcut that should be suppressed. In this paper, we propose EVAN, a multimodal reinforcement learning framework utilizing EVidence-Ablated Negatives to train LMMs against their own language-prior failures. EVAN first identifies highly visually dependent examples using a scaled image information gain metric and preserves data diversity with a mixed-ranking strategy. It then constructs evidence-ablated images by masking the most discriminative image patches, eliciting plausible but visually ungrounded responses from the current policy. During policy optimization, these negative responses are incorporated as bounded auxiliary signals under the clean image, penalizing shortcut learning while maintaining RL stability. Experiments across challenging multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that EVAN mitigates modality imbalance and improves over strong RLVR baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/DawnLIU35/EVAN.git.
summary_zh: 多模态强化学习中，模型易利用语言先验等捷径获正奖励，导致视觉证据基础对齐模糊。
提出EVAN框架，通过缩放图像信息增益筛选视觉依赖样本，并遮蔽关键图像块构建证据消融负样本。
将负样本作为辅助信号惩罚捷径学习，实验表明EVAN缓解了模态失衡，显著优于强基线。

title: AgentHeal: Evaluating Goal-Preserving Resource Recovery of Web Agents under Access Barriers
title_zh: AgentHeal：评估Web代理在访问障碍下的目标保留资源恢复
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in automating complex information-seeking and transactional tasks across the open web. However, their real-world reliability remains limited by access barriers, such as dead links, authentication walls, rate limits, and anti-scraping defenses. These barriers block the primary execution path, causing agents to abort prematurely, loop indefinitely, or quietly compromise the user's original constraints. Existing evaluations either implicitly assume that target resources are freely accessible or focus on transient perturbations that simple retries can resolve, failing to capture scenarios where agents must actively reroute around impassable bottlenecks. To bridge this gap, this paper introduces AgentHeal, a comprehensive benchmark evaluating goal-preserving resource recovery, defined as the ability of web agents to detect non-transient access barriers, pivot to legitimate alternative sources, and fulfill the user's exact original objective. Spanning nine barrier families across a counterfactual sandbox and real-website replay, our experiments on leading LLM backbones show that average task success drops sharply from 89.4% to 43.7% under access barriers. Further analysis reveals that agents frequently fall for deceptive look-alikes, fail to escalate to users when necessary, violate access policies, or waste computation on futile retries, providing actionable diagnostics for developing resilient web agents.
summary_zh: Web代理常因死链等非暂时性访问障碍而中断或违背用户约束，现有评估未覆盖此场景。
本文提出AgentHeal基准，评估代理检测访问障碍并转向合法替代资源以完成目标的能力。
实验表明访问障碍使成功率骤降，代理易受欺骗或无效重试，为构建鲁棒代理提供诊断。
comment: Code and Dataset are available at https://github.com/Lzzzzzzzzzzy/AgentHeal

title: A Sequential Decision Framework for Evaluating LLM-Guided Search
title_zh: 评估LLM引导搜索的序贯决策框架
abstract: Recent systems applying retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and "deep research" iteratively generate queries, retrieve documents, and examine their contents, using the resulting information to guide subsequent search steps. When this process is carried out autonomously rather than by a human searcher, the system must make explicit decisions about which search trajectories to explore and what objective the search is intended to optimize. We introduce a simple framework for reasoning about such search policies, providing a principled approach to evaluation. The framework models the search environment as a set of ranked lists and represents behavior using two primitive actions: select, which advances judgment through an existing ranking, and spawn, which generates a new ranking through query generation or reformulation. Each action produces a document to inspect, yields information that updates the search state, and contributes a reward for a task-specific objective. Within this abstraction, a variety of existing retrieval strategies can be expressed as policies operating over a common environment, while common retrieval objectives can be represented through reward and weighting functions over the resulting search trajectory, and the resulting formulation admits a natural reinforcement learning interpretation. We illustrate the approach using high-recall information retrieval (HRIR), where the goal is to identify as many relevant documents as possible with limited judging effort, showing how the framework provides a unified way to describe and reason about strategies for both classical retrieval tasks and emerging LLM-guided search systems. Through experiments, we demonstrate that both the underlying retrieval method and the "deep research" policy employed can materially affect performance.
summary_zh: LLM引导的自主搜索需显式决定搜索轨迹与优化目标，缺乏原则性评估方法。
提出将搜索环境建模为排序列表，用select与spawn两原语动作表示行为的评估框架。
该框架统一了现有检索策略与目标，在HRIR任务中验证了底层检索与深度研究策略对效果的影响。

title: Beyond LLM Wrappers: Context Engineering and the Three-Engine Architecture for Reliable Financial AI
title_zh: 面向可靠金融AI的三引擎架构与上下文工程
abstract: Financial AI systems must support decision-bearing questions involving payments, collections, cash flow, and compliance while ensuring numerical accuracy, traceability, and auditability. Large language models (LLMs) enable natural language interaction but cannot independently guarantee reproducible calculations or evidence-grounded recommendations. We present a production-grounded architecture integrating three components: a financial knowledge graph for enterprise relationships, temporal context, and provenance; a deterministic optimization engine for financial calculations and decisions; and a multi-agent LLM layer for intent interpretation, task orchestration, explanation, and claim validation. A coordination layer, termed context engineering, selects, ranks, composes, and validates query-specific context across ERP systems, tools, and tenants. Based on observations from 15 deployments over approximately 11 months, single-agent pipelines exhibited hallucination rates of about 7-9% (5-10% across query types), including invented invoices and unsupported financial claims. Graph-backed multi-agent validation reduced observed rates to below 1%, although these findings are observational rather than causal. ERP data quality and tenant-specific schemas remained major implementation challenges. Reusable mappings, graph templates, and validation policies coincided with a reduction in deployment time from roughly six to two weeks. We argue that financial context engineering extends beyond text-centric retrieval-augmented generation by requiring structured relationships, temporal validity, exact numerical evidence, access controls, and validation against source records and solver outputs. We outline research challenges in evaluation, reproducibility, privacy, context quality, and cross-tenant generalization.
summary_zh: 金融AI需保证数值准确与可审计，但LLM无法独立保证计算可复现与证据支撑。
提出三引擎架构：金融知识图谱、确定性优化引擎与多智能体LLM层，结合上下文工程协调跨ERP查询。
观测表明，图支撑的多智能体验证将幻觉率从约7-9%降至1%以下，复用组件使部署时间从6周缩至2周。

title: PDScope: Breaking the Prefill-Decode Seesaw for Memory-Bound MoE Inference
title_zh: PDScope：打破内存受限MoE推理的预填充-解码跷跷板效应
abstract: Local deployment of MoE-based LLMs on CPU-GPU nodes is attractive for cost and privacy reasons, yet limited GPU memory forces most experts into CPU memory. Prefill is then compute-bound and benefits from aggressive GPU loading, while decode is I/O-bound and requires conservative PCIe transfers. These demands cannot be amortized under low batching---typical of local assistants and document tools---forcing phase-agnostic schedulers into a seesaw: favoring prefill's aggressive loading injects unmaskable I/O that stalls decode, while favoring decode's conservative transfers starves prefill's GPU of work. We observe that expert routing is predictable in phase-specific ways, allowing us to decouple the two phases and optimize prediction, scheduling, and execution independently for each phase. PDScope predicts expert activations to guide placement and prefetching, adapts these policies to each phase's bottleneck via cross-layer cost modeling, and compiles decisions into overhead-free pipelines using a static computation graph, cache prefetching, and zero-copy asynchronous I/O. On mainstream MoE models, PDScope achieves 2.5-10.3x higher prefill throughput and 2.1-6.1x higher decode throughput than existing systems, showing that phase-aware co-design unlocks efficient MoE inference under memory constraints and extends naturally to multi-batch settings.
summary_zh: 本地部署MoE大模型时，GPU显存受限导致专家多在CPU，低批次下预填充与解码阶段的I/O需求冲突引发跷跷板效应。
发现专家路由具阶段可预测性，PDScope据此解耦两阶段，通过跨层成本建模独立优化各阶段的预测、调度与执行。
结合静态计算图与异步I/O编译零开销流水线，在主流MoE模型上实现2.5-10.3倍预填充和2.1-6.1倍解码吞吐提升。

title: Goal-Aware Dynamic Multi-Agent Collaboration for Long-Horizon Tasks
title_zh: 面向长程任务的目标感知动态多智能体协作
abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly used to complete complex, long-horizon tasks without human intervention. To make progress toward the task goal, agents need to perform different duties, such as planning and verification, when needed. To understand how single agents manage these duties during long-horizon execution, we conduct a preliminary study. Our analysis shows that verification has the strongest association with task success, but often occurs late, leaving limited opportunities for correction. We also find that the proportion of duty-relevant information decreases as records from different duties accumulate in a shared context. These findings lead us to examine whether multi-agent systems (MAS) can address these problems by assigning duties to agents with separate contexts. Our analysis shows that this separation alone is insufficient. Agents can lose track of the overall goal and repeat prior investigations. They may also lack necessary background while receiving irrelevant information from others. To maintain goal awareness and coordinate collaboration as task needs change, we propose Goal-Aware Dynamic Multi-Agent Collaboration (GAD). It uses a growing execution graph to organize subtasks and their dependencies. To keep agents focused on their goals, each context retains the original instruction and the assigned task's goal and acceptance conditions. To adapt collaboration and information sharing during execution, agents can divide tasks into subtasks and specify dependencies based on execution evidence. These dependencies guide when agents work and which results they receive. Verification and recovery check subtask results and full task completion against their goals, providing feedback for repair when checks fail.
summary_zh: 单智能体处理长程任务时，验证常滞后且共享上下文中职责信息衰减，导致纠错机会少。
简单分离上下文的多智能体系统易丢失全局目标并重复探索，且易受无关信息干扰。
提出GAD方法，用执行图组织子任务，精简上下文保留目标，动态调整协作与信息共享，并引入验证与恢复机制。

title: Read More, Reason Deeper: Latent Workspaces for Long-Sequence Recommendation
title_zh: 长序列推荐中读取更多与推理更深的潜在工作空间
abstract: Long-sequence recommendation can improve along two axes: \emph{evidence scaling} exposes longer histories, while \emph{reasoning scaling} adds layers that interpret that evidence for a candidate. Existing models couple them: sequence encoders propagate every added event through depth, whereas one-shot selection prevents later layers from revisiting omitted evidence. We introduce the Latent Workspace Ranker (LWR), which keeps typed evidence in persistent banks and propagates a fixed-size candidate-local workspace. Each layer rereads the banks from its evolving workspace and archives compact post-interaction state, allowing history length and reasoning depth to grow independently. We compare four architectures across various history--depth configurations using evidence scaling at fixed depth, reasoning scaling at fixed 10K history, and their joint compute-efficient frontier. LWR leads all families at long histories, continues improving with reasoning compute, and converts additional training compute into quality gains at the fastest fitted rate on the joint frontier. At 10K history, it improves NE by 0.19% over HSTU while using 69.6% fewer forward GFLOP/request. It also outperforms existing baselines on two billion-scale ranking surfaces. These results show that separating addressable evidence from propagated state makes reading more and reasoning deeper independently controllable and jointly useful.
summary_zh: 现有长序列推荐模型将证据扩展与推理扩展耦合，导致历史长度与推理深度无法独立增长。
提出潜在工作空间排序器(LWR)，将可寻址证据存于持久库，通过固定大小工作空间逐层重读并归档状态，实现两者解耦。
LWR在长历史上表现最优，在10K历史下较HSTU提升NE 0.19%且计算量减少69.6%，并在十亿级排序面上超越基线。

title: Reasoning or Pattern Exploitation? Mechanistic Insights from RL-Trained Language Models
title_zh: 强化学习训练的语言模型：推理还是模式利用？
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly described as acquiring "reasoning" skills after reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. However, whether these gains reflect genuine reasoning or more superficial adaptations remains underexplored. In this work, we probe LLMs trained in a finite and exhaustively analyzable logical domain, namely Tic-Tac-Toe, and trace how internal representations evolve across reinforcement learning (RL) with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Quantitatively, RL yields high accuracy and robustness across prompt variations, suggesting the emergence of game reasoning. Mechanistic interpretability, however, paints a different picture: features extracted with sparse autoencoders (SAEs) reveal that models primarily adapt to rely more heavily on information already explicit in the prompt, such as whose turn it is, game progression and board occupancy. In comparison, high-level concepts like board symmetries and strategic forks remain weakly represented, raising concerns that reasoning benchmarks overestimate model abilities. This suggests that RL-driven "reasoning" may conflate task-specific adaptations to input information with reasoning ability. We provide, for the first time: (i) a systematic interpretability pipeline tracing representation dynamics across RL training in small-scale LLMs; (ii) an extension of SAE-based feature discovery to hypothesis-driven testing in a finite logical domain; and (iii) an interpretability-based demonstration that RL post-training neither adds nor removes concept information but reorganizes which features dominate the representation, with causal interventions locating the decision downstream of it, in the late-layer state.
summary_zh: 问题：RL训练后的LLM是否具备真正推理能力尚不明确，需探究其性能提升的本质。
方法：在井字棋逻辑域中，结合GRPO训练与稀疏自编码器（SAE）追踪模型表征动态。
结论：RL仅使模型更依赖提示中的浅层信息，高级策略概念仍弱；RL仅重组特征而非新增概念。

title: VEvo-Harness: Causally-Guarded Self-Evolving Harness for Agentic Image Generation
title_zh: VEvo-Harness：面向智能体图像生成的因果守护自演化系统
abstract: The central bottleneck in visual generation and editing has migrated from achieving pixel-level fidelity to satisfying densely constrained user specifications through increasingly agentic workflows. Prevailing agentic generation pipelines remain shallow generate-verify-rewrite loops treating VLM judgments as coarse visual feedback, either discarding repair experience or admitting ungated updates that poison skill library. With memorize and govern periods left open, they degrade into ungoverned iterators of repeated trial-and-error rather than continual self-evolving harness. Towards this issue, we present \textbf{VEvo-Harness}, the first causally-guarded continual self-evolving harness system for agentic visual generation. VEvo-Harness introduces four coupled innovations: (1) \textit{a visual traceback} that densifies sparse judgments into root-cause attributions with a hierarchical verification tree; (2) \textit{a visual continual governance} that admits only causally valid skill patches through counterfactual dual-arm image generation replay; (3) \textit{a lifecycle-managed harness state} that hierarchically distills root-cause-anchored episodes across working, experience, and pattern tiers into a persistent skill library of routable and causally verified capabilities; (4) \textit{a heterogeneous sandbox policy} that orchestrates a diverse action space of repair primitives, dynamically routing cost-aware interventions based on root causes to select the most effective strategy. VEvo-Harness surpasses state-of-the-art agentic methods and rivals proprietary generators (\textit{e.g.}, GPT-Image, Nano-Pro) while maintaining the continual harness evolution and generalization.
summary_zh: 现有智能体图像生成流程缺乏有效治理，易丢弃修复经验或引入无效更新，退化为无序试错迭代。
提出VEvo-Harness系统，通过视觉溯源定位根因，并利用反事实生成回放仅接纳因果有效的技能补丁。
系统结合生命周期状态管理与异构沙箱策略，持续演化技能库，性能超越现有方法并媲美专有生成器。

title: REALM: Identifying Minimal Task Assets for LLM Agents
title_zh: REALM：识别LLM代理的最小任务资产
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents often receive access to more files, accounts, and services than a task requires. Prompt injection turns this excess access into an opportunity to redirect execution toward unrelated resources. Applying least privilege therefore requires identifying the assets needed by a task, including assets whose identities emerge only during execution. We present REALM (Required Execution Assets Linked to a Mission), an approach to identifying and maintaining a task's required assets and their permitted uses. The approach represents required assets as Dependency Graph nodes, resolves prerequisite relationships, and admits newly discovered assets through source-scoped selection. It separates discovering an asset from authorizing its use, while preserving the agent's freedom to choose its computation. The REALM Builder maintains the selected grants and projects Asset Files; the Partial API Manager exposes resource-bound Partial APIs to the Agent inside a Task Container. Across 60 clean tasks and 560 injected cases in AgentDyn, it completes 40.0% and 36.4% of tasks and decreases ASR from 16.6% to 0.2% with qwen3.5-flash as the base model.
summary_zh: LLM代理常拥有超出任务所需的访问权限，易受提示注入攻击而越权访问无关资源，需实现最小权限控制。
提出REALM方法，以依赖图节点表示所需资产，解析先决关系并动态接纳新资产，分离资产发现与授权。
实验表明，REALM在AgentDyn上有效完成任务，并将攻击成功率从16.6%降至0.2%，显著提升安全性。

title: Clean Sheets and Checkpoints: Evidence Complexity for Certifying Sequential Agent Risk
title_zh: 序列智能体风险认证的证据复杂度研究
abstract: Dangerous-capability evaluations often test an AI agent from prepared states at ordered milestones. A clean sheet records no successes. What it certifies about a campaign of $B$ attempts depends on what a failed attempt erases. We model the task as a chain of $k$ milestones divided into checkpoint segments and ask how many zero audit responses certify, at level $α$, a completion probability of at most $ε$. For segments chosen before the audit, counting possible completion windows gives a certificate for any specified budget. The bound also covers adaptive deployment processes that follow the chain's transitions, provided their success probabilities after every complete history are capped by the corresponding audit success probabilities. The audit does not test this transport assumption. In rare-risk phase interiors, each segment is either rarely completed within the budget (active) or nearly always completed (free). The minimum expected number of zero responses is asymptotic to $\log(1/α)\,(B^a/(a!\,ε))^{1/K_A}$, where the $a$ active segments contain $K_A$ milestones and are those at least as long as a budget-dependent threshold. The certificate attains this constant. Every asymptotically optimal evaluator must divide its expected response count equally among active milestones in the limit, with a vanishing share elsewhere. Where a single segment passes from active to free, each of its milestones receives a smaller limiting share than an active milestone; a crossover-aware certificate attains the optimal constant. For selected segments with known or unqueried prefix steps, counting failed cycles can sharpen the certificate.
summary_zh: 针对AI智能体危险能力评估，需确定多少次零成功审计能以α水平认证其完成概率至多为ε。
将任务建模为含检查点段的里程碑链，通过计数完成窗口，为指定预算下的自适应部署提供认证上界。
推导出最小期望零响应数的渐近表达式，并证明交叉感知认证可达最优常数，计数失败循环可进一步锐化认证。

title: From Local Recovery to Unified Generation: Discovering Triple Set in Knowledge Graphs via Observation-Anchored Latent Diffusion
title_zh: 基于观测锚定潜在扩散的知识图谱三元组集预测
abstract: Triple set prediction (TSP) is to recover missing relational triples in a knowledge graph by predicting the triple set instead of isolated links. Existing approaches predominantly rely on the subgraph-based completion paradigm, where the original graph is first partitioned into local subgraphs which are then independently completed. Such a paradigm suffers from fragmented structural reasoning, limited cross subgraph dependency modeling, and missing predictions across subgraphs. This paper proposes LatentDiff, a novel unified latent generative framework for TSP, which reformulates knowledge graph completion as latent space graph generation. LatentDiff first learns a compact latent representation using a relation-aware residual-quantized knowledge graph autoencoder, which encodes the whole graph into relation-aware latent embeddings, quantizes them with chunked residual codebooks, and reconstructs triples through a factorized decoder. On top of this latent space, we introduce an observation-anchored latent graph diffusion model, where the target latent graph representation is perturbed toward the observed latent. The reverse process recovers missing triples through progressive latent denoising. Experiments on three benchmark datasets show that LatentDiff outperforms the SOTA in terms of F_{tsp} by 5.4 percentage points on average. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LKGDiff-44A5.
summary_zh: 现有子图补全范式存在结构推理碎片化与跨子图依赖建模受限问题，导致跨子图预测缺失。
提出LatentDiff框架，将知识图谱补全重构为潜在空间图生成，通过关系感知残差量化自编码器学习紧凑潜在表示。
引入观测锚定潜在图扩散模型，通过反向去噪过程恢复缺失三元组，平均F_tsp指标超SOTA 5.4个百分点。

title: PCM: A Proof-Carrying Message Protocol for Verifiable Multi-Agent Communication
title_zh: PCM：用于可验证多智能体通信的携证消息协议
abstract: When one AI agent tells another that "the tests passed" or "a person approved this refund", the receiver has only the sender's word. A2A and MCP authenticate the channel, but the sender is the party in doubt, so a prompt-injected agent can launder fabricated facts and authority through a multi-agent system. We present Proof-Carrying Messages (PCM), a protocol in which each claim carries evidence: records from an append-only Merkle log that the agent cannot write, with inclusion proofs, signed by an attesting signer the agent cannot control. Receivers check messages offline and give each claim a three-valued result: proven, unproven or failed. A claim that rests only on the agent's own report is never proven. Authority travels as grant chains rooted in a recorded human approval, and the chains can only narrow. We specify four claim types, a typed caveat algebra, replay rules that survive restarts, and strict readings that make independent verifiers agree, and we prove the resulting security properties. On a pre-specified benchmark of 926 messages from real runs, 712 of them lies in 16 classes, PCM accepts 10 lies, all of them stale evidence (1.4%, 95% CI 0.8-2.6%). Plain A2A accepts all 712, and models of six deployed protocols (A2A with signed Agent Cards, uAgents, RFC 9421, SCITT, AP2, Verifiable Intent) accept 504-712. Two independent verifiers agree on all 926 verdicts, and verification takes about 1 ms.
summary_zh: 多智能体系统中接收方无法验证消息真伪，易遭提示注入攻击散布伪造事实与授权。
提出携证消息协议PCM，要求声明附带仅追加Merkel日志记录与不可控签名等证据，支持离线验证。
实验表明PCM仅接受1.4%的过期谎言，远优于现有协议，且双验证器结果一致，耗时约1ms。
comment: 50 pages, 9 figures, 15 tables. Specification, conformance vectors, verifier and benchmark: https://github.com/Cygnux-Labs/PCM-protocol

title: HALO: Human-Grounded Granular Evaluation of Proactive Agents
title_zh: HALO：主动型智能体的人工细粒度评估
abstract: Proactive agents must decide whether, when, and how far to assist without an explicit request. Existing evaluations often rely on automated scores or binary verdicts, offering limited human diagnosis of evidence use and intervention quality. To address these gaps, we introduce HALO, Human-Grounded GrAnular EvaLuation of PrOactive Agents. HALO-Arena covers 4 proactive need types, Dependency, Blockage, Risk, and Opportunity, across 10 everyday domains and 50 personal environments. Scenarios require agents to retrieve evidence from structured databases or unstructured documents before judging whether assistance is warranted and choosing its scope. On HALO-Arena, we construct HALO-8K, a dataset of 8,000 responses from 10 models across 400 scenarios, annotated by 20 experts for action level, acceptability verdicts, and human diagnosis. For rejected responses, human diagnosis covers timing, intensity, and other issues. Recorded reasoning tokens and retrieval rounds measure the effort behind these responses. The best proprietary and open-source models achieve 72.88% and 56.63% acceptability, respectively. Our central finding is that over-proactivity is the dominant observed failure mode, with Premature timing or Excessive intensity accounting for 61.20% of rejected responses. Further analyses yield complementary findings on the balance between intervention and restraint, evidence acquisition, and the calibration of timing and intensity.
summary_zh: 现有主动型智能体评估缺乏人工诊断，无法细粒度衡量证据使用与干预质量。
提出HALO评估框架，构建涵盖4类需求与50种环境的HALO-Arena，并基于10个模型生成HALO-8K数据集，由专家标注干预时机与强度等。
实验发现最佳闭源与开源模型接受率分别为72.88%和56.63%；过度主动是主要失败模式，占拒绝响应的61.20%。

title: HERA: Assessing an Autonomous Agent for Quantum Device Measurement
title_zh: HERA：用于量子器件测量的自主智能体评估
abstract: Large language model agents have begun to carry out laboratory measurements, but their scientific conclusions are useful only if they hold up under scrutiny. Demonstrating this requires controlled studies because models are stochastic and the context a model is given steers its conclusions. Here we introduce HERA, an autonomous agent designed to carry out cryogenic transport measurements of quantum devices. HERA draws on a knowledge base curated by lab members that holds measurement protocols, software tools, and literature references. We assessed HERA with a blinded trial against an expert on the stacking order of two multilayer graphene devices, an ablation of its knowledge base, and hundreds of offline replays in which models designed the trial's central measurement without running it. HERA's conclusions matched the expert's sealed conclusions on both tested devices. The ablation and the replay studies measured the impact of the knowledge base across different models, showing that with it every model designed better measurements and reasoned more soundly. To test how readily HERA extends to a new problem, we tasked it with finding and characterizing superconductivity in a different material system. This required a few hours of expert time to develop a new experimental protocol, after which HERA did both autonomously. These results show that, with a knowledge base designed for the task, language model agents are capable of sound experimental science.
summary_zh: LLM agent 的科学结论需经严格审查，故需在受控条件下评估其可靠性。
提出 HERA agent 执行低温输运测量，结合实验室知识库，在盲测与消融实验中均得出与专家一致且更优的结论。
仅需少量专家时间更新协议，HERA 即可自主扩展至新体系并表征超导，证明 LLM agent 能胜任严谨实验科学。
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, plus Supplementary Information (7 figures, 6 tables); data and code at https://purl.stanford.edu/tv195gf3182 and https://github.com/sharpelab/hera-paper-data

title: Certified Access: Test-Time Compute on Conservative Physics-Structured AI Memory
title_zh: 保守物理结构AI记忆的测试时计算认证访问
abstract: Test-time compute mechanisms, such as retries, confidence-based escalation and non-local routing, are conventionally deployed as black-box additions to trained models. They typically add forward passes or halting heads, but give no structural account of what the extra compute buys or what it costs against the model's stability guarantees. We therefore propose a theoretical and empirical framework for test-time compute on a Latent Dynamics Model used as the memory. When an encoder's latent state $(q,p)$ is advanced by a damped symplectic (velocity-Verlet) step of a learned Hamiltonian, every mechanism that expands access has an exact phase-volume Jacobian, a bounded energy change and an exact latch-transport law. We split reachability failures into escape failures and reach failures. A Lorentz squeeze resolves escape failures by injecting bounded, re-absorbable energy. A gated canonical translation (a one-step channel across $C_T$) resolves reach failures at $\detJ=1$ exactly. We verify this certificate stack on a designed analytic testbed. Reaching just beyond $C_T$ with the squeeze requires energy that grows quadratically in the excess distance. The gated channel's energy cost equals the potential difference between its endpoints, which is zero on the matched channel measured here, and so does not grow with distance in this testbed. An untrained state-replacing map annihilates phase volume and erases stored charge, while the gated channel transports it. On a learned physics-structured memory, we show calibrated compute rationing and evaluate the scaling limits of non-local routing against a physics-free baseline. The main contribution is the formalization and verification of the certificate stack, not benchmark performance.
summary_zh: 现有测试时计算机制多为黑盒，无法说明额外计算对模型稳定性的影响与代价。
提出基于哈密顿辛步进潜动力模型的理论框架，证明扩展访问机制具有精确相体积雅可比行列式与有界能量变化。
引入Lorentz压缩与门控正则平移分别解决逃逸与可达失败，验证了认证栈并评估了非局部路由的缩放极限。
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026); Workshop: Long-Context Foundation Models

title: When Does Closed-Loop Curriculum Adaptation Help GRPO? An Analysis on Countdown
title_zh: 闭环课程自适应何时有助于GRPO？基于Countdown的分析
abstract: Reinforcement fine-tuning has become an effective post-training paradigm for improving the reasoning ability of large language models, but it remains sample-inefficient when the training distribution is mismatched to the model's current capability.
