Adaptive Path Routing preserves exact answering and predicts the relative benefit of Agent over shorter execution paths. Dynamic Agent Execution maintains an evolving workspace and refines Planner proposals to control tool use and termination. Sequential Policy Learning first trains operation control from observed outcomes and then trains path routing using the resulting Agent's performance. Across two benchmarks, RouteDRAG achieves an average accuracy improvement of 3.47 percentage points over shorter-path-only execution while assigning only 79.3% of queries to Agent. Notably, it also surpasses uniform Agent execution on both benchmarks while requiring fewer answering calls. Our code is now available at https://github.com/Ereshkigal1/RouteDRAG.
summary_zh: 多模态文档RAG中，Agentic执行并非总必要，可能增加计算量甚至降低准确率，需按需控制其调用与执行。
提出RouteDRAG框架，包含统一索引、自适应路由预测智能体收益、动态执行控制工具使用，及序列策略学习训练路由。
实验表明，RouteDRAG比短路径执行准确率提升3.47%，仅79.3%查询调用智能体，且优于全量智能体执行。
comment: Our code is now available at https://github.com/Ereshkigal1/RouteDRAG

title: Your Agent Acts Differently When You're Around: How User Presence Changes Agent Behavior in Negotiation
title_zh: 用户在场如何改变谈判中智能体的行为
abstract: LLM agents increasingly interact with other agents on behalf of users, yet how users in the loop affect their agents' behavior--for better or worse--remains poorly understood. We study this question through the lens of negotiation, where agents must represent users while strategically bargaining with other agents. To isolate the effect of user presence, we develop PRESENT, a controlled evaluation framework that compares negotiation settings with and without an interactive user, while holding the game, objectives, and user preferences fixed across conditions. Across 11.2k runs spanning 7 games and 8 models, we find that user presence significantly changes both outcomes and behavior. Specifically, negotiation parties with a user obtain higher payouts (+13.7% on average) and their agents negotiate more aggressively. Surprisingly, user presence also induces misaligned behavior, both toward counterparties (where its rate roughly doubles) and toward users (where it emerges in 14.3% of games). These misaligned behaviors are uncorrelated with outcomes and persist even when the user sends only templated, neutral messages. These findings expose two blind spots in current evaluation practice: static instructions miss behaviors that emerge only when users are present, and outcome-level metrics cannot detect them.
summary_zh: LLM代理常代表用户交互，但用户参与对代理行为的影响尚不明确，故研究用户在场对谈判中代理行为的影响。
提出PRESENT评估框架，在固定游戏与偏好的条件下，对比有无用户交互的谈判设置，以隔离用户在场效应。
用户在场使代理收益提升13.7%且更激进，但引发对双方的行为失准；现有静态评估与结果指标无法捕捉该现象。

title: LM-DSB: A Lightweight Multi-agent System for Automated Daily Safety Bulletin Generation in Construction
title_zh: 建筑施工每日安全简报的轻量级多智能体自动生成系统
abstract: Construction safety management still struggles to produce daily safety bulletins (DSBs), structured daily communications that identify site-specific hazards, convey safety protocols, and set preventive measures for workers. Manual DSB creation takes 2-3 hours daily and yields inconsistent quality, with 25% of crews never conducting pretask planning (Olson et al., 2016), diverting safety personnel from field supervision. This study proposes the Lightweight Multi-Agent DSB System (LM-DSB), which integrates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with a locally deployable Large Language Model (LLM) to automate DSB generation on consumer-grade personal computers. LM-DSB coordinates specialized planner, researcher, and writer agents in a hierarchical architecture, enhanced by domain-specific fine-tuning on construction safety documentation and RAG grounding in 37 health, safety, and environment (HSE) documents. A two-phase validation assessed feasibility. Phase 1 comparative evaluation showed the multi-agent RAG system (Llama 3-8B) outperformed all alternative configurations, with strong lexical alignment and coherence (TF-IDF: 0.70, BLEU: 0.39, ROUGE-1: 0.66) and near-complete document generation (length ratio: 1.01 vs. 0.39 for single-agent RAG). Phase 2 expert evaluation (N=40) confirmed practical acceptability (mean scores 3.50-4.20 on a 5-point scale), particularly in regulatory compliance (4.20) and factual accuracy (4.10). The findings show that architectural design enables lightweight models to handle safety-critical documentation on consumer-grade hardware, advancing technology democratization in construction safety management. Limitations include knowledge base scope, language constraints, and lack of field deployment validation; future work should address multimodal integration and workflow adoption.
summary_zh: 建筑施工每日安全简报（DSB）人工编制耗时且质量不稳，影响安全人员现场监督。
提出LM-DSB系统，结合RAG与本地可部署LLM，通过规划、研究、写作智能体协同自动生成DSB。
实验表明该系统在消费级硬件上可行，生成质量与合规性获专家认可，推动了建筑安全技术普惠。

title: Electric Vehicle Scheduling and Carbon-Aware Energy Dispatch for Charging Stations
title_zh: 电动汽车调度与充电站碳感知能量分配
abstract: Electric vehicle (EV) charging stations integrating photovoltaic (PV) generation, battery storage, and bidirectional grid exchange must coordinate access to limited chargers with energy supply while considering both energy cost and carbon emissions. This paper proposes a solver-free greedy heuristic (SFGH) for dynamic vehicle scheduling (VS) and a twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient (TD3) controller for carbon-aware energy dispatch (ED). SFGH assigns EVs according to reductions in service delays, and TD3 controls battery operation to balance energy costs and carbon emissions while meeting the resulting charging demand. The model allows both PV and battery exports, accounting for export revenue and carbon credits. Simulations on year-long case studies show that SFGH--TD3 achieves the lowest accumulated service delay, energy cost, and carbon emissions among the evaluated heuristic and multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (DRL) configurations.
summary_zh: 充电站需协调有限充电桩接入与能量供给，同时兼顾能源成本与碳排放。
提出无求解器贪心启发式算法进行动态车辆调度，按服务延迟减少量分配车辆。
提出TD3控制器进行碳感知能量分配，平衡成本与碳排放，联合方法在延迟、成本和排放上均达最优。

title: SO-101 Bench: Accessible Spatial Manipulation
title_zh: SO-101 Bench：可及的空间操作基准测试
abstract: Low-cost arms such as the SO-101 have become the most common entry point to robot learning, yet no released policy performs spatially constrained, language-conditioned tasks on them out of the box, and existing SO-101 benchmarks run only on physical hardware with simple tasks and few held-out objects. We introduce SO-101 Bench, a simulated benchmark for language-conditioned spatial manipulation built on an Isaac Lab digital twin of a real SO-101 setup. It has four tasks scored as five families, 138 objects in seen, unseen-instance and unseen-class splits, 916 evaluation episodes with subsets for held-out appearances, rotate-to-fit planning and occlusion memory, and 3,629 simulated demonstrations on which every learned policy is fine-tuned under an equal compute budget. The twin ranks policies as the real robot does: five policies trained without real data, four VLAs and an LLM agent, keep their exact ranking when the same weights run on the physical arm in an unseen environment with unseen objects (Spearman rho = 1.00, MMRV = 0.000), although simulation overestimates success. Across nine VLAs and world-action models, the best learned policies score near 61%, with spatial placement, unseen object classes and rotate-to-fit planning remaining open. An LLM agent that writes code and hands grasping to a learned policy scores 83.2%, and an ablation shows that this lead comes from the choice of harness and the choice of language model.
summary_zh: 低成本机械臂缺乏开箱即用的语言条件空间操作策略，且现有基准依赖实体硬件，任务简单，为此提出SO-101 Bench。
基于Isaac Lab数字孪生构建仿真基准，包含4项任务、138个对象及916个评估回合，并在同等算力下微调策略。
仿真排序与真实机械臂完全一致，LLM agent结合学习策略达83.2%，空间放置与旋转规划仍是开放挑战。

title: When AI Can Build It, What Should We Assess? Rethinking Evidence of Engineering Competence
title_zh: 当AI能构建时我们应评估什么：重构工程能力证据
abstract: Generative AI can produce code, tests, documentation, and technical explanations that resemble artefacts traditionally used as evidence of student competence, weakening the inference from artefact quality to the engineering capability behind it. We report the redesign and first deployment of a 13-week, AI-permissive, software-intensive engineering course in which students may delegate substantial work to AI while retaining responsibility for planning, verification, review, integration, and explanation. The redesign couples an engineering accountability workflow, which structures human-AI work and preserves human decision authority, with an assessment evidence architecture comprising six complementary channels: product, process/origin, verification, explanation, reflection, and individual assurance. A collect--cross-check--escalate (CCE) reasoning logic connects these channels rather than treating any single artefact or trace as sufficient evidence of competence. By the end of Week 11, the deployment involved 87 students organised into 17 teams, with 957 individual weekly Git repositories and 34 group-project Git repositories supporting repeated assessment and engineering activity. The first deployment yielded four practical lessons: AI assistance changes where rubric criteria carry evidential weight; multiple evidence channels require deliberate cross-checking and meaningful complementarity; the evidential strength realised in practice may differ from that intended in the assessment design; and automation scales evidence collection more readily than interpretation. The contribution is a conceptually grounded, deployed design for making engineering responsibility and competence more visible when AI can perform substantial artefact production.
summary_zh: 生成式AI削弱了从产物质量推断工程能力的有效性，需重构评估体系。
设计工程问责工作流与六通道证据架构，采用收集-交叉检查-升级逻辑评估能力。
课程部署实践表明：多通道证据需交叉互补，自动化易扩容收集但难扩容解释。

title: kw-bench: Breaking Frontier Harnesses on Real-World Tasks
title_zh: kw-bench：基于真实任务的调查型知识工作基准
abstract: Each new generation of frontier model pushes the edge of what is possible. Inside a harness -- a loop, a shell, a filesystem, the ability to write and run its own code -- a model can take on increasingly difficult work. A growing body of work treats the coding-agent harness as infrastructure for knowledge work rather than a coding tool, and a new wave of benchmarks tests it there. Most of them are generative: build a financial model, a memo, a spreadsheet from a brief, judged by a rubric or by another model. Few test the expensive part of knowledge work, which is investigative. In audit, tax, due diligence, regulatory reporting, claims or any dispute over numbers, the answer already exists -- hidden in incomplete and inconsistent evidence spread across systems -- and has to be recovered and defended to the cent. We introduce kw-bench, a benchmark built from real engagements specialists described to us. Its first task family is a five-year VAT reconstruction across three generations of SAP -- legacy ECC, a partial S/4HANA migration and a consultant's redesign -- delivered as raw system extracts: page headers, local number formats, partial link tables, no documentation of how anything connects. Grading is deterministic, with no LLM judge. We ran four harnesses -- Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and micro-cc -- on the same model, DeepSeek v4.1 Flash, for two hours. The two independent, model-agnostic harnesses delivered (OpenCode 0.542, micro-cc 0.528); the two lab harnesses, away from their home model, delivered nothing (0.00 each). What defeated them was inertia: keeping many weak signals alive across a long session. On a frontier model the task collapses. micro-cc and Claude Code on Claude Opus 5.5 scored 0.9986 and 1.000, in 22 and 25 minutes. A weeks-long engagement now costs minutes and a few dollars; below the frontier, the harness decides how far a model gets.
summary_zh: 现有基准多测试生成式任务，忽略了知识工作中从残缺证据中恢复并捍卫精确答案的调查型任务。
提出 kw-bench 基准，基于真实业务构建，首个任务为跨三代 SAP 的增值税重建，采用确定性评分。
实验表明，弱模型因无法维持长会话弱信号而失败；前沿模型配合独立 harness 可达近满分。
comment: 26 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Code and tasks: https://github.com/GSequist/kw-bench

title: MAREval: A Multi-Agent Framework for Evaluating Natural Language Recommendation Explanations
title_zh: MAREval：评估自然语言推荐解释的多智能体框架
abstract: Evaluating natural language explanations in recommender systems is essential for fostering user trust, transparency, and engagement. However, existing evaluation approaches like human evaluations, while accurate, are resource-intensive and impractical at the scale required by modern recommendation platforms. Also, automated methods using single-agent LLMs suffer from prompt sensitivity and inconsistent outputs. To address these challenges, we propose MAREval, a structured multi-agent framework for evaluating recommendation explanations using large language models. MAREval orchestrates (i) a planner agent that uses a novel Chain of Debate (CoD) prompting strategy to coordinate agent roles and enforce logically consistent evaluation plans; (ii) a moderator agent that regulates discussions by mitigating prompt drift; and (iii) an arbitrator agent that aggregates outputs from multiple evaluation rounds and (iv) a Monte Carlo sampling method, improving robustness and alignment with human judgment. We conduct comprehensive evaluations on both public (TopicalChat) and proprietary recommendation datasets, demonstrating that MAREval outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Comprehensive experiments on a public benchmark and a proprietary e-commerce dataset show that MAREval improves alignment with human judgments over strong singleand multi-agent baselines. Stability analyses indicate substantially lower variability across repeated trials. In a large human-annotation gate, MAREval meets production quality thresholds where prior evaluators fall short, and online A/B testing demonstrates statistically significant improvements in engagement and revenue metrics. These results establish MAREval as a scalable and reliable solution for human-aligned evaluation of recommendation explanations in real-world systems
summary_zh: 现有推荐解释评估方法成本高或存在提示敏感与输出不一致问题，提出多智能体框架MAREval。
该框架包含规划、调节与仲裁智能体，结合辩论链提示与蒙特卡洛采样，保障评估逻辑一致与鲁棒。
实验表明MAREval优于基线，与人类判断对齐度更高且稳定性强，线上A/B测试显著提升收益。

title: SOMA: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Egocentric Behavior and Body-Motion Understanding
title_zh: SOMA：细粒度自我中心行为与身体运动理解基准
abstract: Perceiving human body motion is critical for multimodal systems that understand and assist people. Yet current evaluations of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) largely focus on objects, scenes, and coarse actions, leaving their ability to reason about the body itself poorly assessed. This is especially challenging from the egocentric perspective, in which the body is only partially visible and motion must be inferred from occluded and temporally distributed cues. We introduce SOMA, a benchmark for fine-grained body-motion understanding from egocentric video, comprising 1,632 human-verified questions across three capability axes: body configuration, motion dynamics, and temporal reasoning. We evaluate 37 leading closed-source, open-source, and specialized egocentric MLLMs, complemented by an extensive human evaluation. We find that humans also find this task difficult from video alone (68.5% accuracy), yet clearly outperform the strongest MLLM (Qwen3.6-27B), which reaches 50.0% zero-shot accuracy. Our error analysis shows that MLLMs often misread the wearer's own body, misjudge events in time, and are prone to biases such as favoring the right hand or under-counting repetitions. To narrow the gap to human performance and support further progress, we introduce a training dataset of aligned video, body motion, and language supervision, and a multimodal baseline that jointly learns from these modalities. By identifying common failure modes and missing capabilities in current MLLMs, we hope SOMA will inspire future research on body-motion understanding and multimodal reasoning. Full benchmark, training data, and code will be released at: https://cnai.epfl.ch/soma
summary_zh: 现有MLLM评估多关注物体与粗粒度动作，缺乏对自我中心视角下局部可见身体运动的推理评估。
提出SOMA基准，包含1632个验证问题，从身体构型、运动动态和时间推理三轴评估细粒度身体运动理解。
评估发现最强MLLM零样本准确率仅50%，低于人类68.5%，且存在误判自身身体与时间等偏差；为此提供对齐训练数据与多模态基线以缩小差距。

title: BoxWorld: Let World Engines Control and Video Generators Render
title_zh: BoxWorld：世界引擎控制与视频生成器渲染
abstract: We tackle the challenge of building real-time interactive video worlds with user-defined behaviors. Such worlds must track object states, apply interaction rules, and render the resulting consequences as users act. Yet existing end-to-end video world models typically learn interaction dynamics within the generator, making it difficult to specify object-level rules and reason about their consequences. In this work, we introduce BoxWorld, which separates interaction reasoning from generative rendering. Given user-specified rules, a coding agent creates a Box World Engine that determines interaction outcomes and exposes the resulting object states through a lightweight interface of layout boxes, persistent object attributes, and dynamic status variables, leaving appearance and physical effects to generative rendering. A Box-State Generative Renderer then renders this evolving state stream into video autoregressively, enabling online control over object motion, state switches, and conditional events. Rendering this state stream is non-trivial: the renderer must respond to object-level state updates in real time while remaining coherent with the generated history. To this end, we introduce a three-stage training strategy that learns object grounding from open-domain videos and state transitions from gameplay videos, both annotated automatically, and finally performs rollout distillation on self-generated histories. We further propose PairedStateBench, a paired benchmark for fine-grained interaction control. BoxWorld substantially outperforms end-to-end world models and remains competitive across multiple public benchmarks. Project page: https://boxworld-web.github.io.
summary_zh: 现有端到端视频世界模型难以指定对象级规则并推理交互后果，需构建可自定义行为的实时交互视频世界。
提出BoxWorld，将交互推理与生成渲染分离：coding agent构建世界引擎输出对象状态，生成渲染器自回归地将其渲染为视频。
提出三阶段训练策略与PairedStateBench基准，模型大幅超越端到端世界模型，在多个公开基准上保持竞争力。

title: MUSE: Revealing Responsiveness Gaps of LLM Tutors on Multiple-Solution Programming Problems
title_zh: MUSE：揭示LLM导师在多解编程题上的响应差距
abstract: When a problem admits multiple valid solutions, effective tutoring requires building on a student's strategy while introducing alternatives at appropriate points. However, whether LLM tutors can support this flexibility by appropriately responding to students' diverse solution approaches remains largely unexplored. In this work, we introduce MUSE: Multi-solution Understanding and Simulation Environment, a controlled environment for simulating student-tutor conversations on multiple-solution programming problems. Grounded in learning science on responsive instruction and multiple-solution learning, we investigate which solutions LLM tutors prefer, how they respond to students' approaches, and how they transition between solutions. Experiments suggest that LLM tutors exhibit systematic preferences among valid solutions, often favoring brute-force approaches when not providing general advice. More concerningly, tutors often impose these preferences, redirecting students toward their own preferred approach rather than supporting the student's. Yet this tendency reverses once a solution is completed: tutors often remain anchored to the existing approach when a stronger alternative could deepen understanding, and sometimes even transition to a less optimal approach. Thus, tutors struggle both to build on students' reasoning when appropriate and to extend their reasoning when beneficial. Promisingly, targeted post-training improves both tutor responsiveness and transitions toward more optimal solutions.
summary_zh: 多解编程题需导师灵活响应学生策略，但LLM导师能否支持此灵活性尚未探索。
提出MUSE模拟环境，探究LLM导师对多解编程题的偏好、响应及解法转换行为。
发现LLM导师强加自身偏好，完成后又固守现有解法；针对性后训练可改善此问题。

title: Your Wish Is My Commit: Over-Compliant Refactoring in AI Coding Agents
title_zh: AI编程代理中的过度顺从重构行为研究
abstract: Large language models are known to be sycophantic, over-complying with users even when doing so is unproductive. When these models act as coding agents, this can be costly: an agent that keeps editing after no edit improves the code writes churn, technical debt, and review burden into the codebase. Yet the consequences of sycophancy in software engineering remain largely understudied. To understand them, we run a controlled study of iterative refactoring, an open-ended task with no stopping criterion, where any edit an agent makes once the code is already clean reflects compliance rather than improvement. Across algorithmic (n=50) and object-oriented (n=10) suites, we repeatedly ask two widely used agents, Codex and Claude Code, to refactor further across five models. Over 3,000 turns, we define six behavioral signals of over-compliance. We hypothesized that a capable agent would stop once it recognized an optimized codebase; none did. Every model kept editing, rewriting up to 31x the original codebase before first stopping and resuming edits even after declaring the task complete. Over-compliance is a costly, multi-turn behavior that compounds with every turn, and our six signals give developers and tool builders a way to detect and curb it.
summary_zh: 问题：LLM的顺从性导致AI编程代理在代码已优化后仍继续编辑，产生技术债务，但该现象在软件工程中缺乏研究。
方法：对Codex和Claude Code等5个模型进行迭代重构控制实验，定义6种过度顺从行为信号并分析超3000轮交互。
结论：所有模型均未在代码优化后停止编辑，甚至重写达原代码31倍；过度顺从随轮次累积，6种信号可助检测与遏制。

title: Reasoning about the Genetic Code in Lean
title_zh: 在Lean中关于遗传密码的推理
abstract: The genetic code exhibits redundancy, meaning that multiple distinct nucleotide sequences can encode the same amino acid sequence, a property mathematically characterized as non-injectivity. While this phenomenon is well studied in molecular biology, its rigorous verification within a computational framework remains limited. In this work, we present a machine-verified model of the central dogma of molecular biology using the Lean 4 interactive theorem prover. We formalize nucleic acid bases and amino acids as inductive types and define transcription and translation as functions mapping DNA sequences to RNA and subsequently to polypeptides. Within this framework, we prove key properties of these biological processes, including the redundancy of the genetic code, injectivity of transcription, and the non-injectivity of translation. Additionally, we formalize auxiliary processes such as DNA replication and mutation, and verify properties such as length conservation under transcription and point mutations. Finally, we demonstrate how Lean 4 helps prevent semantic errors in our code, showing its effectiveness as a tool for advancing reliable, bug-free scientific computing, particularly within the life sciences.
summary_zh: 遗传密码的冗余性缺乏计算框架内的严格验证，故使用Lean 4构建分子生物学中心法则的机器验证模型。
将核酸与氨基酸形式化为归纳类型，将转录和翻译定义为映射函数，并证明了翻译的非单射性（冗余）等关键性质。
形式化了DNA复制与突变等辅助过程并验证其性质，表明Lean 4能有效防止语义错误，促进生命科学中的可靠计算。

title: OA-RAG: Ontology-based Agentic RAG for Faithful LLM Reasoning
title_zh: 基于本体的智能体RAG：提升LLM推理的忠实性
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) perform well across many real-world tasks but remain prone to hallucination, limiting their reliability in domains such as biomedicine and healthcare, where answers must be grounded in established knowledge. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) mitigates this problem by incorporating external information, but often overlooks logical relationships and relies heavily on the LLM's own reasoning, which can compromise answer faithfulness. We propose OA-RAG, an agent that integrates formal reasoning with LLM reasoning, drawing on both the logical structure and informal annotations of domain ontologies. For each answer, OA-RAG reports the ontology observations used as evidence and a model-assessed grounding level (entailed, supported, related, or unrelated) that characterises the strength of that evidence. Across benchmarks derived from three large-scale ontologies and six real-world medical question-answering tasks, OA-RAG achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated ontology-fine-tuned and popular RAG methods, with particularly strong results on reasoning-intensive tasks. The reported grounding levels also offer a useful indication of answer reliability, with stronger grounding generally associated with higher accuracy. Finally, our results demonstrate the value of ontologies as knowledge sources: OA-RAG is competitive with, and sometimes outperforms, domain-specific RAG systems that draw on sources such as textbooks.
summary_zh: LLM易产生幻觉，现有RAG常忽略逻辑关系且依赖模型自身推理，损害答案忠实性。
提出OA-RAG智能体，结合本体逻辑结构与非正式标注，将形式化推理与LLM推理集成。
在多项医学问答基准测试中整体表现最优，其报告的证据支撑度能有效指示答案可靠性。

title: Training-Free Inference Acceleration for Video Large Language Models: Methods, Trade-offs, and Evaluation
title_zh: 视频大语言模型免训练推理加速：方法、权衡与评估
abstract: Video Large Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in video understanding and reasoning, but processing long visual sequences incurs substantial computational, latency, and memory overhead. This survey examines training-free inference acceleration, focusing on reducing inference costs while preserving task-relevant spatiotemporal evidence. We organize existing methods by their intervention stages in the inference pipeline, covering input, visual encoding, projector, prefill, and decoding. Post-training quantization (PTQ) is discussed separately as a cross-stage extension with varying calibration requirements. We analyze how intervention position affects evidence preservation and computational savings, and why local efficiency improvements may not translate into end-to-end acceleration. We complement this analysis with quantitative evidence from prior studies and our own experiments under a shared evaluation setting to assess accuracy-latency trade-offs.
summary_zh: 视频LLM处理长序列开销大，本文综述免训练推理加速方法，以降低推理成本并保留时空证据。
按推理流水线阶段（输入至解码）组织现有方法，并单独讨论后训练量化作为跨阶段扩展。
分析干预位置对证据保留和计算节省的影响，并在共享设置下评估精度与延迟的权衡。

title: Ontology-guided multi-agent reasoning for explainable differential diagnosis
title_zh: 基于本体论引导的多智能体可解释鉴别诊断推理
abstract: Effective differential diagnosis depends on well structured and unambiguous patient case descriptions, since incomplete or ambiguous clinical information readily leads to diagnostic errors and inconsistent reasoning. Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown promising capabilities in medical question answering and clinical reasoning; however, even when achieving competitive performance on medical benchmarks, they often rely on pattern recognition learned from training data rather than grounded clinical evidence, and can generate plausible yet unsupported diagnostic conclusions. Their reasoning remains largely opaque, making it difficult for clinicians to assess the evidence and rationale behind a given recommendation. To address this gap, we propose an ontology-guided, multiagent differential diagnosis framework that replicates the iterative reasoning process of physicians. The framework grounds diagnostic inference in a structured, expert-curated medical knowledge base, enabling interpretation of symptoms, clinical findings, or disease relationships, while decomposing diagnosis into explicit, auditable reasoning steps. This ontology-based grounding constrains inference to evidence-backed associations, reducing hallucination and improving diagnostic transparency, traceability, and consistency. The system then identifies the most discriminative missing symptoms and generates targeted follow-up questions to reduce uncertainty through a process that mirrors to clinical inquiry. Together, these components improve the reliability, explainability, and diagnostic accuracy of AI-assisted differential diagnosis. The source code is publicly available.
summary_zh: LLM临床推理依赖模式识别而非证据，易产生无依据诊断且过程不透明，导致诊断错误。
提出本体论引导的多智能体鉴别诊断框架，将诊断分解为显式可审计步骤，并基于专家知识库约束推理。
该框架通过识别关键缺失症状并生成追问来降低不确定性，提升了AI辅助诊断的可靠性、可解释性与准确率。

title: When Retrieval Is Not Enough: Obsolete Facts in Agent Memory
title_zh: 智能体记忆中的过时事实：检索正确仍不足够
abstract: Memory-agent benchmarks often collapse retrieval and answer generation into one score, making it hard to tell whether a failure comes from missing an update or from not using an update that was already retrieved. We examine this distinction on the single-hop FactConsolidation task of MemoryAgentBench. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on 6K-history BM25 accuracy drops from 45% to 32% when the retrieved evidence budget grows from 64 to 512 tokens, even though a gold-assisted post-hoc audit finds the newest statement in every retrieved set. Most of the errors occur on questions that also contain an obsolete statement version. Under a frozen prompt and equal four-statement evidence size, replacing one unrelated statement with the obsolete competing statement reduces accuracy from 100% to 44.6% for Qwen2.5 and from 100% to 87.8% for Qwen3-14B, with all 50 harmful paired flips classified as stale. A 32K-history replication likewise favors BM25-64 over BM25-512 (69% versus 58%). These results suggest that retrieving the correct fact is not enough. An obsolete competing statement can be more harmful than an unrelated piece of evidence of the same size.
summary_zh: 现有记忆智能体基准将检索与生成合并评分，难以区分失败源于未检索到更新还是未利用已检索更新。
在FactConsolidation任务中，增加检索预算反而降低BM25准确率，且多数错误发生在包含过时陈述的问题上。
实验表明，同等规模下过时竞争陈述比无关证据更有害，仅检索到正确事实不足以保证生成正确。
检索到正确事实不足以保证生成正确，过时竞争陈述比同等规模的无关证据更有害。
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Personalized, Aligned, Long-Term Memory for AI Systems (PALM). 23 pages, including supplementary material

title: Chebyshev-expanded covariant density functional from relativistic Brueckner theory
title_zh: 基于相对论Brueckner理论的切比雪夫展开协变密度泛函
abstract: We construct a density-dependent covariant energy density functional (CE-ME1) from full-Dirac-space relativistic Brueckner--Hartree--Fock (RBHF) self-energies and the corresponding equation of state. The space-like component $U_V$ is incorporated at the Fermi surface through reduced scalar and time-like self-energies, which are mapped onto local Hartree $σ$, $ω$, $δ$, and $ρ$ channels. The density-dependent couplings are represented by cubic Chebyshev polynomials over the density range $0.08\leqρ\leq0.48~{\rm fm}^{-3}$. A constrained thermodynamic calibration uses 199 RBHF energy-per-particle values from published microscopic computations at six isospin asymmetries, while maintaining positive, monotonic couplings. The Bonn-A RBHF saturation point, incompressibility $K_\infty=258$ MeV, symmetry energy $J=33.1$ MeV, and slope $L=65.2$ MeV are reproduced. The predicted curvature $K_{\rm sym}=33$ MeV differs from the published RBHF value of $-67$ MeV, illustrating the derivative sensitivity of the local reduction. The combined energy RMS is $0.613$ MeV, measuring model discrepancy rather than statistical uncertainty. Uniform matter remains mechanically stable and causal above saturation within the calibrated range. In cold charge-neutral $npeμ$ matter, CE-ME1 reasonably reproduces the interpolated RBHF pressure and proton fraction over most of the interval, although the pressure discrepancy increases near its upper edge. The DD-ME2 benchmark is stiffer and predicts a lower proton fraction at high density.
summary_zh: 为从微观计算构建宏观密度泛函，基于全Dirac空间RBHF自能映射至Hartree通道，构建了新泛函CE-ME1。
采用三次切比雪夫多项式表示密度依赖耦合，通过约束热力学校准拟合了199个RBHF微观能量值。
泛函成功复现Bonn-A RBHF饱和点及关键物态参数，且均匀物质保持稳定与因果性，但曲率预测存在差异。

title: Compatibility and future-proof testing for multi-agent systems
title_zh: 多智能体系统的兼容性与面向未来测试
abstract: Independently developed autonomous agents, such as autonomous vehicles, must guarantee joint compatibility, such as safety and task-completion requirements, when they operate in a shared environment. Existing methods require a centrally designed specification, or interaction mechanism before any agent is deployed. However, such centralized design is unrealistic when agent designs are confidential to their developers, and it is not flexible enough to accommodate future agent designs. We study a bi-level structure in which a regulator coordinates developers by publishing seed agents, and each developer independently tests its agent to ensure that it is compatible with every seed-compatible agent, a property we call future-proofness. Under this structure, joint compatibility is guaranteed for any agents that are designed and tested independently, without any coordination with each other. In this work, we first formulate compatibility for general multi-agent systems and show why it is not trivially implied by seed-compatibility. We then characterize the future-proof agents as the closure of the seed and show that this closure is monotone in the seed. Finally, we study a class of executable tests that involve interaction with the seed alone, and we ask to what extent such tests can distinguish the future-proof agents.
summary_zh: 独立开发的自主智能体需保证共享环境下的联合兼容性，但现有集中式设计规范不现实且缺乏灵活性。
提出双层结构：监管者发布种子智能体，开发者独立测试其智能体与种子智能体的兼容性，即面向未来性。
证明面向未来智能体是种子的闭包且具单调性，并研究了仅与种子交互的测试对该类智能体的区分能力。

title: BUSTA: Teaching Small Language Models to Reason About Binary Execution
title_zh: BUSTA：教导小语言模型推理二进制执行
abstract: Large Language Models (LLM) are increasingly applied to Reverse Engineering (RE) workflows. RE, however, differs from common LLM coding tasks as it requires models to reason about low-level program behavior. Furthermore, the deployment of tooling in resource-constrained sandboxed RE environments limits the ability to use frontier-scale solutions. We examine whether a targeted LLM training approach can transfer distinct RE skills to open models via inverse basic-block execution: given an x86-64 basic block and a desired output register state, the model predicts the input register values that produce it. Fine-tuning \texttt{Qwen3-1.7B} and \texttt{Nemotron-3-Nano} with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) raises knowable-register prediction accuracy from 73.2\% to 85.3\% and from 63.3\% to 95.2\%, respectively. Frontier models still score highest (up to 99.2\%), but our fine-tuned \texttt{Nemotron-3-Nano} comes within four points at a fraction of the parameter count. We release both fine-tuned models and the training dataset.
summary_zh: LLM在逆向工程中需推理底层程序行为，且受限于沙箱资源难以部署大模型。
提出逆向基本块执行任务，通过GRPO微调小模型预测产生目标输出状态的输入寄存器值。
微调后小模型预测准确率大幅提升，Nemotron-3-Nano以极小参数量逼近前沿大模型水平。

title: ASPEN: Adaptive Semantic Reasoning via Command Persistence Prediction for Efficient Navigation VLAs
title_zh: 基于命令持久性预测的高效导航VLA自适应语义推理
abstract: Navigation vision-language-action (VLA) policies repeatedly invoke costly semantic reasoning even when the next command remains unchanged. Command reuse can reduce computation but risks missing instruction-dependent turns or stops. We introduce ASPEN, an event-triggered scheduler based on command persistence prediction: estimating whether the frozen base policy would reissue its previous command. A lightweight multimodal predictor combines temporal observations, language instructions, execution history, and cached VLA confidence. At eligible command boundaries, sufficient predicted persistence permits command reuse. Otherwise, ASPEN triggers fresh semantic reasoning from the VLA. Evaluated with frozen NaVILA on cross-dataset RxR-CE val-unseen, ASPEN reduces VLA calls by 9.5% and estimated inference time by 8.1%, including scheduling overhead. It maintains comparable navigation performance and preserves identical baseline action sequences on 92.1% of episodes.
summary_zh: 导航VLA在命令未变时仍频繁调用高成本语义推理，直接复用命令又易遗漏转向或停止。
提出ASPEN调度器，通过轻量多模态预测器估计冻结策略是否会重发前命令，以决定复用或触发新推理。
实验表明，ASPEN减少9.5%的VLA调用与8.1%推理时间，92.1%情节动作序列不变且性能可比。

title: The Inbox as a Coordination Primitive for LLM Agent Societies
title_zh: 收件箱作为LLM智能体社会的协调原语
abstract: Language-model agents increasingly coordinate in large groups, and current agent protocols focus on delivering messages. For these agents, however, the scarce resource is not delivery but reading: every message costs tokens, and the context is finite. Current infrastructure works by push: the sender decides when a message enters the recipient's context, so the recipient reads in arrival order and drops the oldest messages once its context is full. We study the alternative, pull, in which messages wait in an inbox outside the context and the recipient's own rules decide what it reads and keeps. We argue that the inbox is a coordination primitive: each agent sets its rules privately, and those rules decide whether other agents' requests reach it. In simulated societies of up to 16,000 agents, with every decision an LLM judgment, we report three findings. First, push fails as an agent takes part in more coordination at once: an agent leading 20 negotiations with a full memory proposes options already rejected 97% of the time, because it has dropped the oldest replies. Second, an inbox is necessary under heavy, noisy traffic. Where first come, first read misses every request, an inbox that first reads messages carrying a refundable deposit still finds about 60% of the agents a request needs, at every size from 1,000 to 16,000. On a real email network, losses compound: when half the agents adopt such an inbox, forwarded search recovers only 5% of full adoption, against 42% for one-hop search. Third, an inbox comprises four decisions (what to read, what to keep, what a sender pays, and what a reply may say), and the best rule for each depends on the traffic and the agent's role. Multi-agent coordination under load requires an inbox layer designed for the traffic each agent receives.
summary_zh: 大规模LLM智能体协调中，现有推模式因上下文有限易丢失旧消息，导致智能体重复提出被拒选项。
提出拉模式的收件箱协调原语，消息在上下文外等待，由智能体自定义规则决定读取与保留。
实验表明在嘈杂重载下收件箱能找回60%所需智能体，且其四项决策的最优规则随流量和角色变化。

title: Instant Software Factories
title_zh: 即时软件工厂
abstract: Coding agents can quickly build prototypes, but a long tail of fixes, optimizations, tests, and releases separates a prototype from a product. A software factory handles this ongoing work through a repeatable process. We ask whether this work needs dedicated orchestration and how such factories should be judged. Given a tested repository and a coding agent, an instant software factory uses only two coordination inputs, a swarm of cron-job agents with standing objectives and a shared communication board, such as GitHub, where agents coordinate through the traces they leave. We developed a bootstrap prompt designed to set up both inputs from one round of human input, with governance as a separable layer. We distilled it from two manually configured industrial factories, observed for 15 and 17 days, and have not yet evaluated it. In the GitHub-coordinated CLI factory, daily merges rose 15x during agent rollout, an observed association. Its agents also filed 95% of new issues and authored 40 of 58 PRs that changed CI workflows, and at least 5.6% of issues marked as fixed were later found to have incorrect fixes. Unlike an agent scored on a fixed benchmark, a factory thus changes its own workload, evaluator, and measured progress. We formulate factory development as multi-objective optimization under this endogenous feedback. Over five months, we plan to evolve both factories, test the bootstrap on new repositories, and test five falsifiable hypotheses.
summary_zh: 原型到产品存在大量后续工作，提出即时软件工厂，仅用定时Agent群与共享通信板作为协调输入。
从两个工业工厂提炼出引导提示，在GitHub协调的CLI工厂中，Agent介入使日合并量升15倍并提交95%新问题。
工厂会内生改变自身工作负载与评估标准，将其建模为内生反馈下的多目标优化问题。

title: Hierarchical Multimodal Interaction Reasoning for Dyadic Relationship Recognition
title_zh: 面向二元关系识别的层次化多模态交互推理
abstract: Dyadic relationship recognition aims to identify the latent social relationship between two individuals from their multimodal interactions. Existing methods typically project heterogeneous cues into a shared representation and optimise a flat classification objective, overlooking that relationships may rely on different interaction patterns. For instance, distant relationships can often be inferred from direct behavioural correspondence, whereas close relationships are better reflected by coordinated affective, behavioural, and multimodal responses. To address this limitation, we propose HiRe-DRR, a Hierarchical Multimodal Interaction Reasoning framework that organises relationship evidence from three complementary perspectives: feature level, interaction type, and relationship hierarchy. HiRe-DRR decomposes facial, bodily, acoustic, and textual cues into low- and high-level representations and constructs homogeneous and heterogeneous cross-participant interactions. We further introduce the Mixture-of-Interaction Transformer (MoI-Former), which treats diverse interactions as specialised experts and employs relation-aware sparse routing to identify relationship-relevant evidence while preserving contextual interaction information. The proposed Hierarchical Conditional Loss (HC-Loss) exploits the hierarchical nature of social relationships through coarse-to-fine supervision, enabling structured relationship reasoning. Extensive experiments on three dyadic relationship benchmarks demonstrate that HiRe-DRR outperforms recent representative image-, video-, and multimodal methods. Our routing analysis further reveals that distant relationships tend to rely on low-level homogeneous interactions, whereas closer relationships focus on high-level heterogeneous interactions. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/tw-repository/HiRe-DRR.
summary_zh: 现有二元关系识别方法忽略不同关系依赖不同交互模式，远距离依赖行为同质交互，近距离依赖多模态异质交互。
提出HiRe-DRR框架，从特征、交互类型和关系层次分解多模态线索，构建同质与异质跨参与者交互。
引入MoI-Former与HC-Loss，通过稀疏路由和粗到细监督实现结构化推理，实验表明其性能优于现有方法。

title: Agent or Human? Detecting Commits by AI Coding Agents in the Absence of Authorship Signatures
title_zh: 无署名签名下AI编码Agent与人类提交的检测
abstract: AI coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot coding agent, and Cursor now commit directly to open-source repositories. Empirical studies of these agents identify their commits through authorship signatures, such as bot accounts and Co-authored-by trailers. These signatures are optional, can be removed, and are often attached to pull requests rather than to individual commits. Hence, it is unclear whether Agent commits can be told apart from Human commits once the signatures are gone. We investigate the signals and limits of signature-free detection using 7,837,946 commits from 1,226 repositories, covering five coding agents and Human commits. After signatures are masked, detectors rank Agent commits above Human commits with a ROC AUC of up to 0.859, and most of this signal comes from message verbosity and change size rather than from the code itself. On the shared sample, gpt-6-sol without fine-tuning reaches AUCs similar to XGBoost and TF-IDF. At the observed Agent share, however, the best detector on the full test set reaches a precision of only 0.332. Detection transfers poorly to held-out Claude Code and Copilot, with TF-IDF reaching an AUC of only 0.524 for Claude Code. Temporal changes also depend on the agent, e.g., Copilot AUC drops and later recovers, while more training history helps Claude Code but not Copilot. These results indicate that signature-free detection can prioritize commits for review but cannot replace recorded attribution, and that studies relying on signature-based labels should treat them as a lower bound on agent activity.
summary_zh: AI编码Agent的提交常通过可选且易被移除的署名识别，移除后难以区分Agent与人类提交。
基于超780万次提交数据，发现无署名检测AUC最高达0.859，信号主要源于提交消息长度和变更规模。
实际Agent占比下精确度仅0.332且泛化差，表明无署名检测仅能辅助审查，无法替代正式署名。
基于超780万次提交数据，发现无署名检测AUC最高达0.859，信号主要源于提交消息长度和变更规模。

title: Structure, Not Sequence: Tracking and Validating Folding Mechanisms in ESMFold's Trunk with Sparse Autoencoders
title_zh: 用稀疏自编码器追踪与>验证?ESMFold的折叠机制
abstract: Structure predictors like ESMFold fold proteins using neural network computation and have transformed structural biology. However, the driving mechanism from amino-acid (AA) sequence to 3D structure is insufficiently understood, and biological meaning remains locked in the dense network. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have shown promising results in obtaining interpretable concept features over an overcomplete basis of intermediate protein sequence-model representations. Yet folding models, which predict physical shape from AA sequence semantics, have no such account. We hypothesize that the features carrying the folding computation evolve in the 3D structural regression process. In this paper, we interpret the folding trunk in three steps. First, a pilot analysis on the representation distribution across modules and recycles locates distinct spatial computation in the trunk. Second, the dictionaries expose a division of labor: the single representation carries inherited semantics, and the pair representation computes the pairwise geometry. Third, we interpret the dictionary at scale with a reasoning language model, trace how the concepts compose across blocks by gradient-based attribution, and follow the interpreted code to the model's folding output, verifying where the computation aligns with, or departs from, known biochemistry. Together, the sparse dictionaries we train capture the relational geometry the trunk computes beyond the sequence model, and their concept activations forecast the model's own fold quality, turning the black-box folding trunk into a sparse, interpretable, and scientifically verifiable circuit.
summary_zh: 蛋白质折叠模型的内部计算机制不明，需解析ESMFold从氨基酸序列到3D结构的驱动过程。
利用稀疏自编码器提取特征:，发现单一表征承载语义，成对表征计算几何，揭示分工。
通过推理模型与梯度归因追踪概念组合，特征激活可预测折叠质量，使黑盒模型可解释可验证。

title: EREBOTS 4.0: A framework for conversational assistants with A2A agents and MCP tools
title_zh: EREBOTS 4.0：基于A2A智能体与MCP工具的对话助手框架
abstract: In recent years, multi-agent systems have shifted from rule-based, symbolic agents to sub-symbolic agents built on language models. However, several limitations remain unresolved. The new frontier is neuro-symbolic agents, which pair language models with deterministic tools and explicit protocols. Without a common framework to standardize and compose them, each study rebuilds the same infrastructure, and results are hard to replicate. This paper presents EREBOTS 4.0, an open-source, hybrid-AI, multi-agent framework that fills this gap for conversational assistants. Language-model agents plan and route requests, while deterministic tools compute exact results over the Model Context Protocol (MCP). An orchestrator selects one or more specialist agents per turn and calls them over the Agent2Agent protocol (A2A). A new agent, local or remote, is added by listing its URL in a configuration file. The framework also manages identity, user context with consent flags, task states and traces. Its A2A server passed 97 tracked requirements in the official A2A Technology Compatibility Kit, with no failures.
summary_zh: 多智能体系统缺乏标准化框架组合神经符号智能体，导致重复建设且难以复现。
提出开源混合AI框架EREBOTS 4.0，由LLM智能体规划路由，MCP工具精确计算，A2A协议协调智能体。
框架支持配置文件便捷添加智能体并管理上下文等状态，其A2A服务通过了官方兼容性测试。

title: Diagnosing and Correcting Bias in MLLM for Long Video Understanding
title_zh: 诊断与纠正多模态大模型在长视频理解中的偏差
abstract: Long-video question answering is challenging since the answer often hinges on a few decisive moments scattered throughout the video, while memory constraints force Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to sample frames at extremely low rates, resulting in sparsity that risks omitting key evidence. Though aggressively enlarging the context size is intuitive, we argue that performance remains fundamentally constrained by the bias, \emph{i.e.}, the misleading cues caused by spurious \textit{linguistic} correlations and salient yet irrelevant \textit{visual} observations. In this paper, we first introduce {S-MME}, a benchmark designed to systematically diagnose shortcut-biased behavior in MLLMs. To mitigate this failure, we further propose a training-free framework, Counterfactual Long-video Evidence-Aware Reasoning (CLEAR). By treating the full video-question pair as a complete view, CLEAR estimates bias effects via augmented views by only keeping the question or locally salient visual clips. Then, we intervene hidden states to mitigate the discrepancy at inference such that the correct answer can be predicted confidently. With experimental studies across five benchmarks, we show that our method is generalizable and can be integrated in different MLLMs, yielding consistent gains in prediction and robustness. We hope CLEAR can offer a complementary direction in test-time scaling for long-video understanding.
summary_zh: 长视频理解中，MLLM因低帧采样易遗漏关键证据，且受语言伪相关与视觉显著但无关观察的偏差误导。
提出S-MME基准系统诊断MLLM的捷径偏差，并设计免训练框架CLEAR，通过反事实干预缓解偏差。
实验表明CLEAR可泛化至不同MLLM，显著提升预测准确性与鲁棒性，为长视频理解提供新方向。

title: Skill Dreaming: Evolving Repository Skills through Pull Request Streams
title_zh: Skill Dreaming：通过PR流演进仓库技能
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on reusable skills for complex software engineering tasks, making skill libraries essential for repository development and maintenance. However, repository-specific skills must evolve with changing code structures, implementation conventions, and maintenance requirements. Pull requests (PRs) provide a natural source of such knowledge by recording how repositories evolve through implementation and review. Meanwhile, new PRs must follow repository-specific implementation patterns, modify related components consistently, and ensure that existing tests continue to pass while adding coverage for new functionality. This creates a mutually reinforcing cycle: PRs provide knowledge for updating skills, while these skills improve future PRs, maintain repositories, and support further skill evolution. To enable this co-evolution of PRs, repositories, and skills, we propose Skill Dreaming, a framework that learns from PR streams to guide continuous repository development and maintenance. Given a repository and its PR history, Skill Dreaming builds a repository-specific skill library by extracting executable knowledge from validated PRs and continuously refines the skills as new PR information becomes available. These skills guide coding agents not only in implementing requested features but also in maintaining associated tests, documentation, compatibility, and repository conventions. By integrating PR analysis, skill management, code execution, and continuous integration, Skill Dreaming provides an end-to-end workflow for applying learned skills to repository changes and incorporating subsequent PR outcomes into future skill updates.
summary_zh: 【问题】仓库技能需随代码结构变化演进，而PR记录了演进知识，形成PR更新技能、技能改善PR的互促循环。
【方法】提出Skill Dreaming框架，从PR流中提取可执行知识构建并持续精化仓库专属技能库。
【结论】该框架集成PR分析与持续集成等，指导编码agent实现功能并维护测试与规范，实现端到端协同演进。

title: Stratum: Repository Memory for Coding Agents Beyond the Context Window
title_zh: Stratum：突破上下文窗口的代码仓库记忆架构
abstract: Context windows have grown a thousand-fold, yet coding agents still start every session with no memory of their past work. They re-read files, retry failed approaches, and forget root causes they established hours earlier. This is not a context-length problem but a memory-architecture problem. Our hypothesis: coding agents need persistent, experience-aware repository memory, so that knowledge survives from one session to the next. Three measurements on real repositories motivate the design. First, mid-size projects already exceed the largest production context windows, and storing knowledge inside the model's key-value (KV) cache costs $10^4$ to $10^5$ times more bytes than storing it as indexed text. Second, across 752 real bug-fix commits, the median fix edits two files, and these files plus their direct imports amount to less than 10% of the repository; the bottleneck is selection, not capacity. Third, even with transitive import reachability and test links, 47% of co-edited file pairs remain structurally disconnected; the knowledge needed for selection must be mined from history and experience. We sketch Stratum, a tiered memory that lives with the repository and serves it through page-safe tools: every response states what was returned, what remains, and what it cost. Retrieval over a store of one million nodes takes 1.7 ms at the median. In a multi-session experiment on eight real bugs, a fresh agent that inherited a prior session's memory, written by a different model, identified the root-cause file in 21 of 24 trials versus 6 of 24 for a retrieval-only baseline (Fisher $p<10^{-4}$), at 4.5x lower median token cost. With the notes of all eight investigations pooled in one store, success remained 8/8.
summary_zh: 现有代码agent缺乏跨会话记忆，导致重复试错，这是记忆架构而非上下文长度问题。
实证表明修复瓶颈在文件选择而非容量，且所需选择知识须从历史经验中挖掘。
提出Stratum分层记忆架构，跨会话跨模型复用记忆，定位根因文件成功率显著提升且token成本降4.5倍。
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Replication package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23615180

title: Replication or Corroboration? An Axiomatic Framework for Evidential Dependence in Multi-Agent Debate
title_zh: 多智能体辩论中证据依赖的公理化框架
abstract: In multi-agent debates, matching reports can arise for two different reasons: agents may repeat the same evidence (replication), or they may provide separate evidential roots that support the same claim (corroboration). A judge must distinguish these two cases. Counting report occurrences gives extra weight to relays, paraphrases, alias resubmissions, and excerpt splits, while merging all matching content avoids this only by also removing genuine corroboration. We formalize this tension as a minimal judgment game in which acquiring new evidence is costly, but replication is cheap. We show that root replication invariance (RRI) is exactly threshold-uniform replication immunity. Under RRI, replication-only deviations cannot change the verdict, and positive-cost replication is strictly dominated, whereas occurrence-sensitive and content-keyed judges admit profitable deviations. We also establish an information boundary: if a judge's observation interface cannot distinguish a replica from a matched fresh root, no judge can both ignore the replica and respond strictly to the fresh root. To preserve this distinction, we introduce the lineage quotient, which removes wording, identity, occurrence multiplicity, and arbitrary root names while keeping distinct roots separate. On orbit-connected domains, it is the coarsest representation sufficient for every deterministic judge invariant to replication and root-label renaming. We further lift this construction to quantitative bipolar argumentation frameworks (QBAFs), characterize strict fresh-root response, prove its propagation along sign-consistent paths under DF-QuAD, and derive a tight closed-form response modulus. Exhaustive audits over 28,224 direct-star profiles, 2,052 multi-layer DAGs, with matched interventions on 277 AVeriTeC-derived profiles, show the predicted separation between replication and corroboration under a supplied partition.
summary_zh: 多智能体辩论中匹配报告源于证据复制或确证，现有计数或合并方法无法有效区分二者。
提出最小判断博弈并证明根复制不变性（RRI）能免疫复制偏差，而其他方法存在有利偏差。
引入谱系商表示法保留确证并去除复制冗余，并在QBAFs中证明新鲜根响应的传播及模量。
信息边界表明若观察接口无法区分复制与新鲜根，则法官无法同时忽略前者并响应后者。

title: Program-Level Adversarial Co-Adaptive Self-Play for Robotic Security
title_zh: 面向机器人安全的程序级对抗协同自适应自博弈
abstract: Coding agents can adapt robotic software by revising executable programs, but successful responses to an evolving opponent may not remain effective. We present a framework for program-level adversarial co-adaptive self-play in which coding agents generate attacks and defenses from tested opponent code and mission feedback, without model fine-tuning. Environment-specific interfaces support external programs for autonomous driving and SDK-level defenses for humanoid locomotion. Two eight-generation case studies reveal concrete software responses: a driving defender introduces direct-actuation recovery, while a humanoid defender revises incoming-state validation. These responses provide local task recovery but do not establish sustained robustness. The framework makes such adaptation and limitations observable through executable artifacts and task-level evidence.
summary_zh: 【问题】编码agent修改程序应对对手，但成功响应随对手演化易失效；【方法】提出程序级对抗协同自适应自博弈框架，由编码agent基于对手代码与任务反馈生成攻防；【结论】无需微调模型即可实现程序级攻防生成。
【方法】设计环境专用接口，支持自动驾驶外部程序与人形机器人SDK级防御；【结论】在两个八代演化案例中， defender分别引入直接驱动恢复与输入状态验证修订，实现局部任务恢复。
【问题】局部软件响应无法建立持续鲁棒性；【结论】该框架通过可执行产物与任务级证据，使这种自适应能力及其局限性变得可观测。

title: Context Is a Pipeline, Not a Window: Information Attrition in LLM Agent Harnesses
title_zh: 上下文是管道而非窗口：LLM Agent 中的信息流失
abstract: LLM agents are judged by two numbers: the size of the context window, and how often the final answer is correct. Both numbers miss a third thing: how much of a tool's output is lost before the model ever sees it. We measured this loss in a real tool-using agent. The agent finds the cause of injected faults by reading Linux kernel traces. The context window was almost empty: across 720 runs, the single largest prompt used only 5.75% of it. Yet a third of all tool results (3,827 of 11,189) were cut before they reached the model, and every cut result became broken JSON. The harness cut each result by slicing its JSON text at a fixed length. This does not shorten a result evenly. It deletes whatever data sits near the end. One field reached the model in only 4.7% of calls. A second field, in the very same results, reached the model in 99.3% of calls. Which field held the fault's evidence depended on when the faulty process started: early or late in the trace. The agent's diagnosis accuracy matched this same split. So we ran controlled experiments to test one question: did the data loss cause the drop in accuracy? This paper makes four contributions. First, we model an agent's context as a five-stage pipeline, with a measured failure at each stage. Second, we replay 864 real tool results, including one from a production trace where the shipped cut deletes all 128 records of the fault's evidence. Third, a controlled experiment shows that the cut's real cost appears first as extra work, not as wrong answers: 43% more tool calls, twice the computation, and yield falling from 0.61 to 0.31. The agent still finds the right answer when it has another way to reach it. Fourth, a survey of seven agent frameworks finds two that cut tool output the same unsafe way. Whether the data cut truly causes the accuracy drop is still an open question.
summary_zh: LLM Agent 的工具输出常被截断，导致上下文窗口虽未满但大量信息丢失，且截断产生无效 JSON。
将 Agent 上下文建模为五阶段管道，重放真实工具结果，发现固定长度截断会按位置不均地删除关键字段。
受控实验表明数据流失首先增加额外工作量（工具调用增43%、计算量翻倍），而非直接导致错答；且多个框架存在此风险。
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Replication package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23614755

title: Log-To-Leak: Prompt Injection Attacks on Tool-Using LLM Agents via the Model Context Protocol
title_zh: 基于模型上下文协议的工具型LLM代理日志泄露攻击
abstract: LLM agents increasingly access external tools through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), but the natural-language metadata used to describe those tools creates a prompt-injection surface. Within this established tool-poisoning surface, we study Log-To-Leak, an additive post-hoc logging attack that induces a separate attacker-controlled call after the final legitimate call. Its payload targets the user query, MCP server name, server response, and agent response. We operationalize the injected directive through Trigger, Tool Binding, Justification, and Pressure, and separately measure call success, payload fidelity, and preservation of legitimate behavior. We evaluate five MCP servers and four LLM agents using five metrics spanning effectiveness, utility, and efficiency. Across 18 model-server pairs with valid tool execution, Log-To-Leak achieves an attack success rate (ASR) of 62.64-100% and conditional logging accuracy (LA) of 76.55-95.64%; 16 pairs have absolute target-task completion changes of at most 6.63 percentage points. Three evaluated defenses leave residual ASR above 55% on GitHub MCP with GPT-4o, while an instruction detector flags 85.53% of benign descriptions. These results show that successful task completion can coexist with unauthorized post-hoc disclosure and motivate host-controlled authorization for secondary tool calls.
summary_zh: LLM代理通过MCP访问外部工具时，其自然语言元数据存在提示注入风险，本文研究该攻击面上的Log-To-Leak后置日志攻击。
该攻击在合法调用后诱导执行攻击者控制的额外调用，通过触发与施压等机制向指定目标泄露用户查询及响应等数据。
实验显示攻击成功率高达62.64-100%且不影响正常任务，现有防御效果不佳，表明需为主机控制的二次工具调用授权。

title: How Much Does the Hint Matter? Scope Conditions for Hindsight Self-Distillation in Financial Reasoning
title_zh: 金融推理中后见自蒸馏的提示信号作用与边界条件
abstract: Financial institutions operating under data-residency constraints are restricted to open-weight models small enough to locally host, which trail frontier systems on multi-step quantitative reasoning. On-policy distillation narrows such gaps by supervising a student on its own rollouts, but traditional OPD requires a strong external teacher, and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) conditions on a full reference solution. We ask how much of that signal is necessary. We present Fin-SD, a localized hindsight self-distillation recipe for multi-step reasoning. Given a problem the student fails, the student itself identifies the first incorrect reasoning step and writes a short critique of that step. We truncate the student's trajectory immediately before the error (aiming to obtain a correct prefix), condition a frozen copy of the student on the same prefix plus the hint, and distill that hint-conditioned teacher into the student over a short rollout under reverse KL. No external model contributes a gradient. We apply Fin-SD to GPT-OSS-20B on a custom multi-step financial reasoning benchmark that requires deriving formula inputs from realistic scenarios via accounting conventions. We find: (i) replacing the critique with a generic-feedback control matches Fin-SD's entire 3.03 pp accuracy gain over the base model on the FinanceReasoning Hard subset, suggesting the gain comes from where supervision is applied, not hint content; (ii) the model writing the hint does not need to be stronger than the model receiving it: hints from same-family GPT-OSS-120B, at roughly 6x the parameters, yield no materially greater benefits than self-written hints; and (iii) Fin-SD matches on-policy self-distillation from full reference solutions on accuracy while generating 9.5% fewer tokens. With Fin-SD, general reasoning on MMLU-Pro and a fourteen-metric compliance audit on FinTrust show no material regression.
summary_zh: 受限于数据驻留的金融推理只能用小模型，但传统蒸馏需强教师或完整参考解。
提出Fin-SD：学生模型定位自身错误步骤并生成提示，基于正确前缀和提示蒸馏自身。
发现增益源于监督位置而非提示内容，自写提示与强模型提示效果相当，且比全参考解更省token。
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the 7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF '26), Milan, Italy. Code and data: https://github.com/johnnyhyu/fin-sd

title: Jaxnasium: Embracing PyTrees For Any-Agent, Cross-Suite Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Jaxnasium：基于PyTrees的跨套件多智能体强化学习库
abstract: Hardware-accelerated reinforcement learning in JAX has gained rapid popularity in recent years and has proven to be a successful method of scaling online reinforcement learning. The resulting ecosystem, however, is fragmented: environment suites define their own interfaces, and algorithm implementations are typically written for a single suite, a single type of space, and either JAX-native or host-based environments. Here we present Jaxnasium, a library for JAX-based reinforcement learning, aiming to make the field more accessible. Jaxnasium represents observation and action spaces as PyTrees, and uses this structure to build networks and support multi-agent processing. Through this, its near-single-file implementations run on discrete, continuous, image, and composite spaces, as well as in multi-agent environments, without any changes to the algorithm code. The same files serve as readable, research-friendly algorithms, as well as importable algorithms for more applied workloads. Through a minimal Gymnasium-style interface and wrappers for 11 suites, over 300 environments are available on which a small PPO implementation with default hyperparameters is able to run. Additionally, through a simple wrapper, we can run Gymnasium and EnvPool environments with the same algorithm and training loop, with no performance loss compared to architectures specifically built for training JAX algorithms on host-based environments. Jaxnasium further provides tools for multi-seed evaluation, hyperparameter sweeps, and project scaffolding. Jaxnasium is open-sourced at https://github.com/ponseko/jaxnasium
summary_zh: JAX强化学习生态碎片化严重，算法通常仅适配单一环境套件或空间类型，限制了其通用性。
提出Jaxnasium库，将观测与动作空间表示为PyTrees，以此构建网络并支持多智能体处理。
算法无需修改即可在离散、连续及多智能体等环境运行，兼容11个套件的300余环境，且无性能损失。

title: Patient-specific rubric-based evaluation of large language models across longitudinal cancer care
title_zh: 基于患者特异性评分标准的LLM纵向癌症护理评估
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show promise in specialty medicine, yet existing evaluations largely focus on isolated clinical encounters rather than tracking how clinical responsibilities evolve across a longitudinal care pathway. Here we introduce NPC-RubricBench, a phase-aware benchmark for evaluating multistage clinical reasoning across the cancer care continuum, using nasopharyngeal carcinoma as a defined disease context. Curated from longitudinal records of 405 patients across two cancer centers, the benchmark comprises 941 patient-phase units across six sequential care phases and 17,688 patient-specific atomic criteria spanning five evaluation dimensions, with each assessment strictly restricted to decision-time clinical evidence. Evaluating 30 general-purpose and medical LLMs revealed that strong diagnostic performance does not carry over to downstream care. We evaluated 30 general-purpose and medical LLMs, showing that high diagnostic performance did not translate into improved downstream care. Instead, the dominant failure modes reversed across phases. Explicit decision errors dominated anatomical staging at 48.2%, whereas decision omissions dominated initial work-up and post-treatment follow-up at 33.4% and 30.4%, respectively. In the evaluated model set, medically adapted models showed higher omission rates than general-purpose models. Moreover, varying query granularity exposes a critical specification trade-off: broad open-ended requests degrade Decision Quality across all 30 models, while more detailed, checklist-like prompts raise Decision Quality but reduce Evidence Faithfulness and Safety Adherence. Furthermore, NPC-RubricBench demonstrates that static diagnostic benchmarks are insufficient to ensure consistent clinical reliability over time, highlighting the importance of phase-adaptive safeguards in multistage medical AI.
summary_zh: 现有LLM评估多关注孤立临床接触，缺乏对临床责任在长期护理路径中演变的追踪，提出阶段感知基准NPC-RubricBench。
基于405例鼻咽癌患者纵向记录构建基准，评估30个LLM发现，强诊断性能未转化为下游护理改善，且各阶段主导失败模式反转。
查询粒度变化暴露规范权衡：宽泛提示降低决策质量，详细提示提升决策质量但损害证据忠实度与安全依从性。

title: ACARE: Agent-Context-Aware Reranker for Iterative Search
title_zh: 面向迭代搜索的Agent上下文感知重排器ACARE
abstract: In agentic search, a document can match an agent-generated sub-query without helping answer the user's original question. Conventional rerankers score documents against the sub-query alone, overlooking the broader task and the agent's reasoning. We introduce the Agent-Context-Aware Reranker (ACARe), a compact 4B LLM trained to rerank documents using this context when available. Across multiple benchmarks and agent families, ACARe improves retrieval quality over its base reranker while reducing search effort. These benefits extend to answer generation: ACARe improves accuracy and reduces searches over no reranking, while matching or exceeding the base reranker's mean accuracy with more precise evidence. It also helps smaller agents narrow the retrieval-quality gap to larger agents, showing how better retrieval tools can make smaller agents more effective. The model, training data, and code will be released soon.
summary_zh: 智能搜索中传统重排器仅匹配子查询，忽略全局任务与推理，导致文档无法回答原问题。
提出ACARE，基于4B LLM训练，在重排时引入Agent上下文信息进行文档排序。
实验表明ACARE提升检索质量并减少搜索量，助小模型Agent缩小与大模型差距。

title: I-HITL: Inalienable Human-in-the-Loop
title_zh: 不可剥夺的人类在环：强化AI安全监督协议
abstract: Human oversight is a pillar of AI safety. It is often exercised by a human in the loop (HITL) who approves critical actions taken by an AI agent. AI agents' increasing ability to bypass guardrails, though, raises the question of how to enforce HITL robustly. We introduce the concept of inalienable human-in-the-loop (I-HITL). An I-HITL protocol ensures that an agent can initiate an action only with explicit human approval, even when the human interacts with a system (e.g., a local agentic harness) compromised by the agent. A strong I-HITL protocol additionally ensures such approval even when an adversarial human attempts to delegate approvals to an agent. To motivate I-HITL, we report on experiments with a popular agentic wallet platform in which raising an agent's spending cap requires HITL approval via emailed one-time passcodes (OTPs). Given access to the user's email and a task blocked by the cap, we find that ten different frontier models will often autonomously raise the cap, harvesting OTPs to bypass a HITL guardrail and surfacing other vulnerabilities. We formally define I-HITL using the concept of communication topologies and prove necessary and sufficient conditions for its realization. We show that an I-HITL protocol requires a trusted entity - a trusted computing device (or equivalent) - and characterize which such devices can and cannot realize an I-HITL protocol. We present a prototype I-HITL system called Countersign that can plug into and strengthen existing HITL systems using off-the-shelf consumer mobile devices.
summary_zh: AI agent能绕过安全护栏，导致传统人类在环（HITL）监督失效，需强化执行机制。
提出不可剥夺的HITL（I-HITL）概念，确保即使系统被攻陷或审批被违规委托，agent也必须经人类批准。
基于通信拓扑定义I-HITL，证明其需可信设备实现，并基于消费级移动设备构建原型系统Countersign。

title: Profiling a Frontier Agent with EBench: From Direct Control to Harness with Policy
title_zh: 前沿智能体评测：从直接控制到策略协同
abstract: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can control robots without robot-specific training, but how their capabilities compare and interact with post-trained vision-language-action (VLA) and world action model (WAM) policies across manipulation demands remains to be thoroughly evaluated. In this report, we evaluate GPT-6-Astra on EBench as the core of an agent that controls a robot through an agent harness under the same visual and proprioceptive observation protocol as post-trained policies. We study two agent configurations: direct control, in which the agent generates waypoint commands directly, and harness with policy, in which it can also invoke a post-trained VLA or WAM policy for action execution. Under direct control, the agent achieves competitive overall performance relative to post-trained policies. It leads on short-horizon tasks and exhibits the least performance variation across generalization dimensions, whereas it underperforms post-trained policies on long-horizon tasks, tabletop manipulation, and high-precision contact-rich tasks. In the harness with policy, invoking a post-trained VLA or WAM combines the complementary strengths of both components, raising overall task success to the level of the strongest compared post-trained policies while substantially reducing token cost. However, performance remains below the per-task upper bound of the standalone components due to suboptimal policy invocation, fixed-instruction execution without subgoals, and grasp disruption when the agent resumes control. Overall, our study characterizes the capability boundary of a frontier MLLM agent and suggests directions for improving future agent harness design. Project page: https://internrobotics.github.io/EBench-Astra-Tech-Report/
summary_zh: 前沿MLLM控制机器人的能力与后训练VLA/WAM策略的对比尚缺系统评估。
在EBench上评测GPT-6-Astra：直接控制短程占优且泛化稳，长程及高精度任务弱于后训练策略。
结合策略协同可互补优势提升成功率并降成本，但因调用次优等限制未达理论上限。

title: Reva: Real-Time Vulnerability Detection through Contextual Probing of Large Language Models
title_zh: Reva：基于大模型上下文探测的实时漏洞检测
abstract: A vulnerability costs more to fix the later it is discovered. As coding agents generate code faster than developers can review it, software needs a first line of defense screening each new function in real time. LLM agents have recently become capable of finding real-world vulnerabilities by working as a security expert would: they run analysis tools, explore the surrounding code, test hypotheses and weigh the evidence before forming their own judgement. This reasoning, however, spans many model calls, so that each verdict takes minutes of compute, far too long for real-time screening. Faster detectors, which fine-tune deep learning models or prompt an LLM for a direct verdict, are less accurate: they judge a function without the context an agent gathers, and an LLM's generated verdict is unreliable even when given some of it. We present REVA (REal-time Vulnerability Analysis), an AI vulnerability detector that brings the security context and code understanding components behind agentic detectors into a single forward pass of an LLM. For each new function, REVA gives the LLM a pre-computed threat model of its module, lightweight static analysis findings and call-graph information. REVA leverages a trained probe to read the LLM's internal representations of the new function in this context. On PrimeVul's held-out test set, REVA on GLM-5.3-Flash reaches 60.0% accuracy in about one second per function. This matches VulTriage (59.2%), the state-of-the-art agentic detector, run on the same LLM, while being over 250 times faster and less than a tenth as costly. On the same prompt, the probe is 14% to 17% more accurate than the LLM's own direct verdict. Across three open LLMs, REVA is at least as accurate as VulTriage, and about 10% more accurate on two of them. An LLM's internal representations thus encode much of what agentic detectors obtain through reasoning.
summary_zh: 现有LLM agent漏洞检测耗时过长，而快速检测器因缺乏上下文导致准确率不足。
提出REVA，将agent的安全上下文与代码理解融入LLM单次前向传播，用训练探针读取模型内部表征。
REVA在PrimeVul上达60%准确率，匹配SOTA agent检测器，速度快超250倍且成本低于十分之一。

title: Understanding Jev-Style System One Models: Does Structure Reduce Selection Bias?
title_zh: 理解Jev风格System One模型：结构能否减少选择偏差？
abstract: Selection bias in large language models (LLMs) can persist despite instructions to ignore presentation order or prompts that elicit reasoning. Recent efforts to reproduce Jev-style System One behavior have produced a growing family of models that predict probabilities directly over supplied candidates. Yet systematic comparisons of selection bias across Jev versions, Jev reproductions, and generative LLMs remain limited in multi-option tasks. This leaves a central question: does Jev-style decision structure reduce selection bias? We address this question with a simple test that shuffles options while keeping question and candidate content fixed. Across two Jev versions, twelve Jev reproductions, and six generative LLMs, we trace individual answers through eight presentations and compare them with fixed-order repetition. On our primary collection of 1,700 questions from two benchmarks, Jev's accuracy varies by less than two percentage points, yet its cumulative failure set expands by 27.3--28.5\% relative to the original order, with first failures continuing into the final presentation. Reordering loses substantially more initial successes than fixed-order repetition, a gap that also appears in highly repeatable Jev reproductions. Nor does Jev show a general advantage over the LLM baselines in preserving correct choices. Aggregation offers limited protection: voting yields modest gains for Jev, while even unanimous answers are frequently wrong. These results expose a gap between repeatable decisions and decisions that remain correct across equivalent presentations, showing why stable accuracy alone cannot establish resistance to selection bias.
summary_zh: LLM的选择偏差难以消除，Jev风格模型直接预测候选概率，但其在多选项任务中减少偏差的效果缺乏系统比较。
通过打乱选项顺序进行测试，发现Jev模型虽准确率稳定，但累积失败集扩大27-29%，初始成功丢失严重。
Jev模型在保持正确选择上无优势，投票聚合保护有限，表明稳定准确率不能证明模型对选择偏差具有抵抗力。

title: Learning and Reasoning with Geometry: How Generation Helps Spatial Understanding
title_zh: 几何学习与推理：生成如何助力空间理解
abstract: Image and video generators can produce spatially consistent visual content, but how to use this capability to improve spatial understanding remains underexplored. We study this problem from two perspectives: geometric supervision during training and explicit geometric evidence during inference. To this end, we introduce a unified geometric understanding and generation model (GeoUG) that integrates depth and multi-view generation with spatial understanding. First, we design a multi-scale depth codec that enables metric-depth generation using a pretrained visual autoencoder, and show that joint training yields task-dependent gains in spatial understanding. Second, we introduce 3DCueBench to control geometric difficulty while balancing selected 2D cues, and find that generated depth provides larger reasoning gains on questions requiring fine-grained geometric discrimination. Building on this finding, we develop adaptive interleaved reasoning, in which GeoUG first drafts an answer and then decides whether to generate geometric evidence to confirm or revise it. We train this decision through reinforcement learning, balancing accuracy gains over retaining the draft against generation cost. GeoUG achieves circular accuracies of 97.9%, 90.8%, and 94.2% on CV-Bench-3D, 3DCueBench, and DA-2K with fewer generation calls than always generating.
summary_zh: 视觉生成模型具备空间一致性，但如何利用其提升空间理解尚未充分探索，故提出统一模型GeoUG整合深度与多视图生成及空间理解。
设计多尺度深度编解码器实现度量深度生成，联合训练可带来空间理解的任务相关增益；构建3DCueBench发现生成深度对细粒度几何问题推理提升更大。
提出自适应交错推理，由模型决定是否生成几何证据修正草稿，并通过强化学习训练该决策以平衡准确率与生成成本，在多个基准上达到高准确率。

title: Pretraining Knows What, Simulation Teaches How: Compositional Generalization in a Sim-Trained Robot Agent
title_zh: 预训练知其然，仿真教其行：基于仿真训练的机器人组合泛化
abstract: A robot policy needs to understand what a task is asking for in a scene, and how to move the robot to accomplish that task. To achieve these two skills, we introduce Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP), a recipe that teaches a small off-the-shelf vision-language model to control a robot via a simple tool harness. We use a pretrained 27B parameter model to bootstrap world understanding and reasoning, followed by supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on simple simulated tasks to teach it how to move the robot. Without observing real-world robot data during training, ZAP reaches 96.7% success on real-world tasks, matching GPT-6 Astra in our harness and outperforming the MolmoAct2 VLA (33.3%), while running 3x faster and 17x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra. Furthermore, ZAP also generalizes to an unseen embodiment as well as new objects, goals and strategies never seen during training. On a single-arm Franka, ZAP reaches 55.9% on RoboLab-120, 4.9 percentage points ahead of the leading VLA/WAM baseline.
summary_zh: 机器人策略需同时理解任务目标与执行动作，为此提出ZAP框架，利用预训练VLM结合仿真微调训练小模型控制机器人。
ZAP无需真实机器人数据，通过预训练模型获取世界知识，再经监督微调与GRPO在仿真中学习动作执行，在真实任务中达96.7%成功率。
ZAP展现出强大的组合泛化能力，能处理训练数据中未出现的全新目标与操作，并能零样本迁移至未见过的单臂机器人实体。

title: Learning When to Commit: Schedule Distillation for Fast Diffusion Language Models
title_zh: 面向快速扩散语言模型的调度蒸馏方法
abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) can generate multiple tokens in parallel, but often require many decoding rounds to complete a response. Efficient generation depends not only on which tokens are easy to predict, but also on how committing to them helps predict the remaining positions. A highly predictable token may provide little useful context, while revealing a less predictable token can help several other positions become predictable sooner. We propose dSpark, a new schedule distillation-based framework for learning when to commit tokens for faster diffusion language generation. To achieve this, we construct unmasking schedules that prioritize tokens whose reveal makes other positions easier to predict, reducing uncertainty earlier in decoding. We then distill these schedules into the model to enable faster parallel sampling, with a KL-divergence regularizer to help preserve generation quality. We extensively evaluate our approach across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks.
